We adapt the standard random coefficients logit demand model to allow for substitution between channels and consumer arbitrage across countries. We apply our framework to the European portable PC market, where geoblocking practices that restrict online cross-border trade have recently been banned. Consumers in high income countries gain most from price convergence, while consumers in other countries may be worse off. The total consumer and welfare gains from online market integration are more modest and mainly due to increased product choice rather than reduced price discrimination. (JEL F13, F14, L13, L63, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个评估市场整合影响的框架，考虑了多个分销渠道之间的溢出效应。我们调整了标准随机系数logit需求模型，以允许渠道之间的替代和消费者跨国套利。我们将该框架应用于欧洲便携式电脑市场，该市场最近禁止了限制在线跨境贸易的地理封锁做法。高收入国家的消费者从价格趋同中获益最多，而其他国家的消费者可能受损。在线市场整合带来的总消费者和福利收益较为温和，主要归因于产品选择的增加而非价格歧视的减少。(JEL F13, F14, L13, L63, L81)

records.title_en: Slope Takers in Anonymous Markets
records.title_cn: 匿名市场中的斜率接受者
records.abstract_en: We present a learning-based selection argument for Linear Bayesian Nash equilibrium in a Walrasian auction. Endowments vary stochastically; traders model residual supply as linear, estimate its slope from past trade data, and periodically update these estimates. In the standard setting with quadratic preferences, we show that this learning process converges to the unique LBN. Anonymity and statistical learning therefore support this commonly used equilibrium selection rule. (JEL D43, D44, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个基于学习的筛选论证，用于瓦尔拉斯拍卖中的线性贝叶斯纳什均衡。禀赋随机变化；交易者将剩余供给建模为线性的，从过去的交易数据中估计其斜率，并定期更新这些估计。在具有二次偏好的标准设定中，我们证明了这一学习过程收敛于唯一的LBN。因此，匿名性和统计学习支持了这一常用的均衡筛选规则。（JEL D43, D44, D83）

records.title_en: A Model of Sequential Crisis Management
records.title_cn: 序贯危机管理模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of how multiple societies respond to a common crisis. A government faces a “damned-either-way” policymaking dilemma: aggressive intervention contains the crisis, but the resulting good outcome makes people skeptical about the costly response; light intervention worsens the crisis and causes the government to be faulted for not doing enough. When multiple societies encounter the crisis sequentially, due to this policymaking dilemma, late societies may underperform despite having more information, while early societies can benefit from a dynamic counterfactual effect. (JEL D72, D82, D83, H12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个关于多个社会如何应对共同危机的模型。政府面临一个“两头不讨好”的政策制定困境：激进的干预能够控制危机，但由此产生的良好结果会让人们对高昂的应对措施持怀疑态度；轻度的干预则会加剧危机，并使政府因做得不够而受到指责。当多个社会依次遭遇危机时，由于这种政策制定困境，后来的社会尽管拥有更多信息，表现却可能不佳，而早期的社会则能从动态反事实效应中受益。（JEL D72, D82, D83, H12）

records.title_en: Trade-ins and Transaction Costs in the Market for Used Business Jets
records.title_cn: 二手公务机市场中的以旧换新与交易成本
records.abstract_en: Manufacturers of durable goods can encourage consumers facing transaction costs to upgrade by accepting used units as trade-ins. These “buyback schemes” increase demand for new units, but increase the supply of used units if trade-ins are resold. I investigate the equilibrium effects of buyback schemes in the market for business jets. I find that buyback increases manufacturer revenue by 7.2 percent at fixed prices. However, in equilibrium this revenue gain is diminished by 43 percent due to substitution away from new jets among first time buyers. I show how the size of this cannibalization effect depends on preference heterogeneity. (JEL D23, G34, L13, L62)
records.abstract_cn: 耐用品制造商可以通过接受旧产品作为以旧换新，来鼓励面临交易成本的消费者升级。这些“回购计划”增加了对新产品的需求，但如果以旧换新的产品被转售，则会增加二手产品的供应。我研究了公务机市场中回购计划的均衡效应。我发现，在固定价格下，以旧换新使制造商收入增加了7.2%。然而，在均衡状态下，由于首次购买者对新飞机的替代效应，这一收入增长被削弱了43%。我展示了这种蚕食效应的大小如何取决于偏好的异质性。（JEL D23, G34, L13, L62）

records.title_en: Price risk and small farmer maize storage in Sub‐Saharan Africa: New insights into a long‐standing puzzle
records.title_cn: 价格风险与撒哈拉以南非洲小农玉米储存：对一个长期谜题的新见解
records.abstract_en: Maize prices fluctuate across seasons in rural markets in many low income countries, and agricultural households struggle to sell their grain at an optimal time. We provide new insight into a persistent puzzle: small farmers in low‐income countries tend to sell their maize at harvest, when prices are low, rather than storing and waiting until prices increase later in the year. Our descriptive analysis uses 20 years of data from 1038 retail markets in 30 African countries to demonstrate that the lean season price (the “high price” season) fails to rise above the harvest season price (the “low price” season) 16.3% of the time on average in countries with a single maize season and between 15.9% and 24.9% on average in countries with two maize seasons. On the basis of that stylized fact, we propose that aversion to these negative returns may contribute to farmers' decisions to opt out of storage at harvest. Using a smaller dataset of 425 retail markets in 10 countries with a single maize season, we show that even moderately risk averse farmers would opt out of storage in 15.3% of market years. Farmers cannot always predict returns to storage and output price risk may dissuade farmers from storing maize for the purpose of future sales, despite credit access. Our results indicate that other mechanisms, such as forward contracts or multiyear credit, may be necessary to mitigate downside price risk.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多低收入国家的农村市场，玉米价格随季节波动，农业家庭难以在最佳时间出售其谷物。我们对一个长期存在的谜题提供了新的见解：低收入国家的小农倾向于在收获时出售玉米，此时价格较低，而不是储存并等待价格在年内晚些时候上涨。我们的描述性分析使用了来自30个非洲国家1038个零售市场的20年数据，表明在单季玉米国家，淡季价格（“高价格”季节）平均有16.3%的时间未能超过收获季节价格（“低价格”季节），而在双季玉米国家，这一比例平均在15.9%至24.9%之间。基于这一典型事实，我们提出对这些负收益的厌恶可能促使农民在收获时选择不储存。使用来自10个单季玉米国家425个零售市场的较小数据集，我们表明即使是中度风险厌恶的农民也会在15.3%的市场年份中选择不储存。农民不能总是预测储存收益，产出价格风险可能阻止农民为未来销售而储存玉米，尽管有信贷渠道。我们的结果表明，其他机制，如远期合约或多年度信贷，可能对缓解下行价格风险是必要的。

records.title_en: The impact of no‐till on agricultural land values in the United States Midwest
records.title_cn: 免耕对美国中西部农业土地价值的影响
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of no‐till practice on agricultural land values in the United States (US) Midwest. Two county‐level panel data sets—the agricultural census farmland value data and the Iowa Farmland Values Survey data—are separately merged with a novel satellite‐based data set on no‐till adoption rates to achieve the study objective. Based on linear fixed effect econometric models, recently developed “external‐instrument‐free” estimation procedures, and a number of robustness checks, we find that increasing no‐till adoption rates has a statistically significant positive effect on agricultural land values at the county level. Results from the empirical analysis support the notion that economic and environmental benefits from adopting soil conservation practices, such as no‐till, are likely capitalized into higher farmland values.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了免耕实践对美国中西部农业土地价值的影响。为实现研究目标，我们将两个县级面板数据集——农业普查农田价值数据和爱荷华州农田价值调查数据——分别与一个基于卫星的新型免耕采用率数据集进行合并。基于线性固定效应计量经济模型、近期开发的“无外部工具”估计程序以及一系列稳健性检验，我们发现免耕采用率的提高对县级农业土地价值具有统计上显著的正向影响。实证分析结果支持了这样一种观点，即采用土壤保护实践（如免耕）所带来的经济和环境效益很可能资本化为更高的农田价值。

records.title_en: More competitive than you think? Pricing and location of processing firms in agricultural markets
records.title_cn: 比你想象的更具竞争性？农产品市场中加工企业的定价与选址
records.abstract_en: The spatial distribution of production is a defining characteristic of agriculture, and the location choice in geographic space and the spatial pricing policies adopted by agricultural processing/packing firms are key determinants of the competitiveness and efficiency of agricultural product procurement markets. Spatially distributed buying firms in the presence of costly transportation of farm products creates natural oligopsony procurement markets. Although several studies have contributed to our understanding of price and output determination and the distribution of welfare in these markets, all are limited in that they address buying firms' locations or their choices of spatial pricing strategy in isolation, holding the other factor fixed, even though both would be chosen jointly in reality to comprise a firm's product‐procurement strategy. Here we overcome this limitation by using computational methods (including genetic algorithms) to study duopsony firms' joint choices of location and pricing policy. Our results differ considerably from those presented in prior literature. In general, we find that, when buyers have the flexibility to jointly choose their locations and pricing strategies, market outcomes are much more competitive and locations more efficient in terms of cost minimization than has been predicted by prior studies viewing location choice or pricing strategy in isolation.
records.abstract_cn: 生产的空间分布是农业的一个决定性特征，地理空间中的选址选择以及农业加工/包装企业采用的空间定价政策是决定农产品采购市场竞争力和效率的关键因素。在农产品运输成本高昂的情况下，空间分布的收购企业形成了自然的寡头买方垄断采购市场。尽管已有若干研究增进了我们对这些市场中价格和产量决定以及福利分配的理解，但这些研究均存在局限性，即它们孤立地处理收购企业的选址或其空间定价策略的选择，而将另一因素视为固定，尽管在现实中两者会被联合选择以构成企业的产品采购策略。在此，我们通过使用计算方法（包括遗传算法）来研究双寡头买方垄断企业在选址和定价政策上的联合选择，从而克服了这一局限性。我们的结果与先前文献中呈现的结果有显著不同。总体而言，我们发现，当买方具有灵活性地联合选择其选址和定价策略时，市场结果比先前研究孤立地看待选址选择或定价策略所预测的更具竞争性，且选址在成本最小化方面更为高效。

records.title_en: Input subsidies, credit constraints, and expectations of future transfers: Evidence from Haiti
records.title_cn: 投入补贴、信贷约束与未来转移预期：来自海地的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the effects of a subsidy program in Haiti that provided smallholders subsidies for inputs (rice seeds, fertilizer, pesticides, and specific labor tasks) using a randomized control trial. The program led to lower input use and lower yields in the year subsidies were received, and the decline in input use and yields persisted through the following year. Using data from a complementary information intervention in which randomly selected farmers were provided clarification regarding their future receipt of vouchers, we find evidence suggesting that incorrect expectations of future transfers partially explain the disappointing outcomes. In addition, instead of increasing input use, the subsidies seem to have led farmers to pay off their loans and take fewer new ones. In complex post‐emergency environments such as the one in which this program took place, input subsidies may need to be avoided, as they require considerable information to optimally design and careful coordination by many actors to achieve the expected gains.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察了海地一个为小农户提供投入品（稻种、化肥、农药及特定劳动任务）补贴的项目效果。该项目在获得补贴的当年导致投入品使用量和产量下降，且这种下降持续到了次年。利用一项补充信息干预的数据（该干预中，随机选取的农户获得了关于未来代金券领取情况的澄清），我们发现有证据表明，对未来转移的错误预期部分解释了这些令人失望的结果。此外，补贴似乎并未增加投入品使用，反而促使农户偿还贷款并减少新贷款。在诸如本项目所处的复杂灾后环境中，可能应避免使用投入补贴，因为其最优设计需要大量信息，且需多方协调才能实现预期收益。

records.title_en: Concern for animals, other farmers, or oneself? Assessing farmers' support for a policy to improve animal welfare
records.title_cn: 关心动物、其他农民还是自己？评估农民对改善动物福利政策的支持
records.abstract_en: Public acceptance of farming practices relating to animal welfare is becoming increasingly important for dairy farmers. In this study, we assess dairy farmers' willingness to pay to support a policy aimed at improving calf welfare and link this to farmers' social preferences. We conceptualize the farmer's decision into private reasons and motivations to improve animal welfare or industry reputation. Our data come from a survey with over 400 Irish dairy farmers that included an experimental component. Specifically, we utilized a contingent valuation referendum method to elicit farmers' willingness to pay. We also used a financially incentivized social value orientation scale based on competitive, individualistic, prosocial, and altruistic preferences. Our findings indicate that most farmers are supportive of a policy scheme to improve animal welfare, and higher social value orientation (i.e. more altruistic preferences) is positively associated with higher willingness to pay. More detailed analysis suggests that industry concern is associated with more altruistic preferences but not concern for animal welfare. Our findings have important policy implications as we show that the majority of farmers are willing to financially support the implementation of a policy that can help to prevent public bads.
records.abstract_cn: 公众对与动物福利相关的农业实践的接受度对奶牛养殖者变得越来越重要。在本研究中，我们评估了奶牛养殖者为支持旨在改善犊牛福利的政策而愿意支付的金额，并将其与农民的社会偏好联系起来。我们将农民的决定概念化为私人原因以及改善动物福利或行业声誉的动机。我们的数据来自一项包含实验部分的调查，涉及超过400名爱尔兰奶牛养殖者。具体来说，我们采用了条件价值评估公投方法来引出农民的支付意愿。我们还使用了基于竞争、个人主义、亲社会和他主义偏好的经济激励社会价值取向量表。我们的研究结果表明，大多数农民支持改善动物福利的政策方案，且更高的社会价值取向（即更利他的偏好）与更高的支付意愿正相关。更详细的分析表明，行业关注与更利他的偏好相关，但与动物福利关注无关。我们的发现具有重要的政策意义，因为我们表明大多数农民愿意在财务上支持实施有助于防止公共危害的政策。

records.title_en: Can cash incentives modify groundwater pumping behaviors? Evidence from an experiment in Punjab
records.title_cn: 现金激励能否改变地下水抽取行为？来自旁遮普省一项实验的证据
records.abstract_en: As groundwater levels steadily decline in India, authorities are concerned about reducing extraction for irrigation purposes without jeopardizing food security. Very low or zero prices for electricity and water in agriculture is partly responsible for overextraction, but charging higher prices is politically not feasible. In this study, we describe the results of a pilot scheme implemented in Punjab, India, where farmers who enrolled were allocated a monthly entitlement of electricity units and compensated for unused electricity. Eight hours of uninterrupted daytime electricity supply were also provided under the scheme instead of the usual mix of daytime and night‐time supply. Analyzing data from a cross‐sectional farm household survey and instrumenting for enrollment, we find that self‐reported hours of irrigation for enrolled farmers were significantly lower than for non‐enrolled ones, with no impact on rice yields. We also find a reduction in monthly electricity consumption at electricity‐feeder level due to the pilot scheme using the synthetic control method. Our results suggest that the combination of daytime electricity provision and cash incentives for unused electricity has the potential to incentivize farmers to reduce electricity consumption and irrigation hours by at least 7.5% and up to 30% without impacting paddy yields.
records.abstract_cn: 随着印度地下水位的持续下降，当局关注在不危及粮食安全的情况下减少农业灌溉用水抽取。农业用电和用水价格极低或为零，部分导致了过度抽取，但提高价格在政治上不可行。在本研究中，我们描述了在印度旁遮普省实施的一项试点计划的结果，参与该计划的农民每月获得一定额度的电力配额，并为未使用的电力获得补偿。该计划还提供每天八小时不间断的白天电力供应，而非通常的白天和夜间混合供应。通过分析横截面农户调查数据并对参与情况进行工具变量处理，我们发现参与计划的农民自我报告的灌溉小时数显著低于未参与农民，且对水稻产量没有影响。我们还使用合成控制法发现，试点计划在电力馈线层面减少了月度电力消耗。我们的结果表明，白天电力供应与未使用电力现金激励的结合，有潜力激励农民减少电力消耗和灌溉小时数，至少减少7.5%，最多减少30%，且不影响水稻产量。

records.title_en: Systemic risk, relative subsidy rates, and area yield insurance choice
records.title_cn: 系统性风险、相对补贴率与区域产量保险选择
records.abstract_en: We investigate the nature of crop yield systemic risk and its implications for farmers' area yield insurance choices. A theory‐grounded, normalized measure of systemic risk, R 2 , is developed and made amenable to empirical analysis through the logit link. The measure is estimated on a large‐scale, unit‐level corn yield dataset. We find that systemic risk explains less than half of total unit yield variability on average, suggesting that the risk management effectiveness of area yield insurance is low. By relating natural resource endowments with systemic risk, we find that more excessive heat and drought events lead to larger while more excessive precipitation events lead to smaller systemic risk. We then study whether current area yield insurance subsidy rates provide farmers with sufficient subsidy transfers to compensate for the uncovered risk exposure associated with area yield insurance. A new concept, the threshold relative area subsidy rate (TRASR), quantifies a lower bound on the ratio of area yield insurance subsidy rate over individual yield insurance subsidy rate below which risk‐averse farmers should always prefer individual yield insurance to area yield insurance. The calibrated TRASR values indicate that current area yield insurance subsidy rates discourage farmers from choosing area yield insurance over individual yield insurance, especially at low area yield insurance coverage levels. We also find that TRASR is positively correlated with systemic risk at the unit‐level of analysis, suggesting that farmers who like area yield insurance's risk management features will dislike its transfer implications and vice versa.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了作物产量系统性风险的性质及其对农户区域产量保险选择的影响。我们开发了一种基于理论的、规范化的系统性风险度量R 2，并通过logit链接使其适用于实证分析。该度量在一个大规模、单位级别的玉米产量数据集上进行了估计。我们发现，系统性风险平均解释了总单位产量变异性的一半以下，表明区域产量保险的风险管理有效性较低。通过将自然资源禀赋与系统性风险联系起来，我们发现过多的炎热和干旱事件导致系统性风险增大，而过多的降水事件导致系统性风险减小。然后，我们研究了当前区域产量保险补贴率是否为农户提供了足够的补贴转移，以补偿与区域产量保险相关的未覆盖风险暴露。一个新概念——阈值相对区域补贴率（TRASR）——量化了区域产量保险补贴率与个人产量保险补贴率之比的下限，低于该下限，风险厌恶的农户应始终偏好个人产量保险而非区域产量保险。校准后的TRASR值表明，当前区域产量保险补贴率阻碍了农户选择区域产量保险而非个人产量保险，尤其是在区域产量保险覆盖率较低的情况下。我们还发现，在单位层面的分析中，TRASR与系统性风险呈正相关，这表明喜欢区域产量保险风险管理特征的农户将不喜欢其转移含义，反之亦然。

records.title_en: Upside risk, consumption value, and market returns to food safety
records.title_cn: 上行风险、消费价值与食品安全的市场回报
records.abstract_en: We investigate the effect of a modest food safety premium on semisubsistence farmers' investment in a food safety technology. We demonstrate theoretically that in the face of production uncertainty, a market incentive below the marginal production cost of achieving the safety standard can increase food safety investment among farmers motivated by private health returns. We test this prediction through a randomized controlled trial in Kenya through which members of existing farmer groups were offered an opportunity to purchase a food safety input, and half were offered a 5% market premium for produce that met the associated regulatory standard. Access to the premium more than doubled investment in the food safety technology. In line with the model's prediction, most premium‐induced adoption was by farmers motivated by a combination of health and financial rewards.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了适度的食品安全溢价对半自给农民投资食品安全技术的影响。我们从理论上证明，在生产不确定性的情况下，低于实现安全标准边际生产成本的市场激励可以增加受私人健康回报驱动的农民对食品安全的投资。我们通过在肯尼亚进行的一项随机对照试验来检验这一预测，该试验中，现有农民团体的成员有机会购买一种食品安全投入品，其中一半人获得了符合相关监管标准的产品5%的市场溢价。获得溢价使食品安全技术的投资增加了一倍以上。与该模型的预测一致，大多数溢价诱导的采用是由健康和财务回报共同驱动的农民所为。

records.title_en: Impacts of forest conservation on local agricultural labor supply: Evidence from the Indonesian forest moratorium
records.title_cn: 森林保护对当地农业劳动力供给的影响：来自印度尼西亚森林暂停令的证据
records.abstract_en: Tropical forest conservation is critical for reducing greenhouse gas emissions and maintaining global ecosystems. Understanding the channels through which conservation affects agricultural activities and livelihoods in these regions is key to designing effective policies and promoting sustainable development. To this end, we use labor supply data from Indonesia in 2007 and 2015 combined with a matching strategy to estimate the impacts of a national forest conservation policy, the forest moratorium, on local agricultural labor. Consistent with the predictions of our theoretical model, we find robust empirical evidence that the moratorium increased local agricultural employment and slowed structural transformation away from the agricultural sector. We provide corresponding evidence of decreased household expenditure due to the moratorium. Despite the moratorium, we find significant deforestation and forest degradation within the boundaries of the moratorium‐targeted areas, suggesting that increases in local agricultural employment may partly dampen the conservation policy's effectiveness. Our work offers new insights into evaluating existing conservation policies and designing future policies for Indonesia and other resource‐dependent economies that face similar challenges in balancing economic growth with conservation.
records.abstract_cn: 热带森林保护对于减少温室气体排放和维护全球生态系统至关重要。了解保护措施影响这些地区农业活动和生计的渠道，是设计有效政策和促进可持续发展的关键。为此，我们利用印度尼西亚2007年和2015年的劳动力供给数据，结合匹配策略，评估了一项国家森林保护政策——森林暂停令——对当地农业劳动力的影响。与我们的理论模型预测一致，我们发现了强有力的实证证据表明，暂停令增加了当地农业就业，并减缓了农业部门的结构转型。我们提供了相应的证据，表明暂停令导致家庭支出减少。尽管有暂停令，我们发现在暂停令目标区域内存在显著的森林砍伐和森林退化，这表明当地农业就业的增加可能部分削弱了保护政策的有效性。我们的工作为评估现有保护政策和设计未来政策提供了新的见解，这些政策适用于印度尼西亚和其他依赖资源的经济体，它们面临着平衡经济增长与保护的类似挑战。

records.title_en: Farm support and market distortion: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 农业支持与市场扭曲：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies market distortions due to farm support policies. Using a recently implemented Price Deficiency Payments (PDP) policy in India, we examine how PDP affects farm‐gate prices and crop supply. We document a new channel, the fall in reservation price of farmers under PDP, behind the decline in farm‐gate prices. This impact depends on the magnitude of the deficiency payments and can lead to a supply glut and price crash. Empirically, the scheme led to a 4% decrease in farm‐gate prices and a 51% increase in market arrivals for black‐gram, a crop with a high magnitude of PDP. Using bid‐level data on crop auctions, we rule out collusion among the market participants, another potential channel for price crash under PDP. The effects of the policy are transitory and disappear after the policy is withdrawn. In terms of welfare effects, this scheme is associated with a monetary loss of INR 1 billion. We discuss an alternate payment scheme that can reduce such losses. In summary, our results extend the current understanding of PDP schemes and contribute to the optimal design of such policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了农业支持政策导致的市场扭曲。利用印度最近实施的价格缺口补偿（PDP）政策，我们考察了PDP如何影响农场门口价格和作物供给。我们记录了一个新渠道，即PDP下农民保留价格的下降，这是农场门口价格下跌背后的原因。这种影响取决于补偿金额的大小，并可能导致供应过剩和价格崩溃。实证上，该政策导致黑吉豆（一种PDP金额较高的作物）的农场门口价格下降了4%，市场到货量增加了51%。利用作物拍卖的出价层面数据，我们排除了市场参与者之间的共谋，这是PDP下价格崩溃的另一个潜在渠道。该政策的影响是暂时的，在政策撤销后消失。在福利效应方面，该计划与1亿印度卢比的货币损失相关。我们讨论了一种可以减少此类损失的替代支付方案。总之，我们的结果扩展了当前对PDP计划的理解，并有助于此类政策的最优设计。

records.title_en: Incentivizing and nudging farmers to spread information: Experimental evidence from Ethiopia
records.title_cn: 激励与助推农民传播信息：来自埃塞俄比亚的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Information does not flow freely through social networks. We use an experiment to study knowledge diffusion about an innovation (integrated pest management, IPM) in farmer groups in Ethiopia. Group leaders are incentivized to share knowledge with members through the conditional provision of material or social prestige rewards. We combine incentives with loss‐framed messaging to leverage loss aversion. Incentives increase diffusion effort, and combining incentives with loss‐framed messaging increases effort further. However, the treatments failed to induce follower farmers to experiment with IPM. We also document that reclaiming material rewards is difficult after a long delay, attenuating the effectiveness of the loss frame.
records.abstract_cn: 信息不会在社会网络中自由流动。我们通过一项实验研究埃塞俄比亚农民群体中关于一项创新（综合害虫管理，IPM）的知识扩散。群体领导者通过有条件地提供物质或社会声望奖励来激励其与成员分享知识。我们将激励与损失框架信息相结合，以利用损失厌恶。激励增加了扩散努力，而将激励与损失框架信息相结合则进一步增加了努力。然而，这些处理未能诱导追随农民尝试IPM。我们还记录了在长时间延迟后收回物质奖励的困难，这削弱了损失框架的有效性。

records.title_en: Getting the message out: Information and communication technologies and agricultural extension
records.title_cn: 传递信息：信息通信技术与农业推广
records.abstract_en: There has been much optimism about the potential of information and communication technologies (ICTs) to provide agricultural extension services to remote households. Yet, little is known about how different communication methods fare, and, moreover, whether different segments of the population adopt information communicated via different means equally. We conduct a randomized controlled trial comparing the effectiveness of three ICTs—radio, voice response messages, and a smartphone app—with traditional extension training in communicating fertilizer management practices across four districts in rural Nepal. We find that farmers in the smartphone app and the extension training programs are on average 8.4 and 13 percentage points more likely to adopt top dressing fertilizer practices compared to control farmers, statistically significant at the 1% and 5% levels, respectively. Farmers in the smartphone app treatment achieve the highest agronomic literacy test scores, 7.8 percentage points higher than the control, statistically significant at the 1% level. In contrast, farmers receiving radio or voice response messages were not more likely to adopt the same fertilizer recommendations nor show improved specific or general agronomic knowledge relative to control farmers. Our results suggest that smartphone apps are more cost effective at inducing farmer knowledge and technology adoption than extension trainings. Heterogeneous treatment effects, however, reveal that a targeted ICT approach may be more effective in disseminating extension advice.
records.abstract_cn: 对于信息通信技术（ICTs）在向偏远农户提供农业推广服务方面的潜力，人们一直抱有极大的乐观态度。然而，关于不同通信方式的效果如何，以及不同人群是否平等地采纳通过不同方式传播的信息，我们知之甚少。我们进行了一项随机对照试验，比较了三种信息通信技术——广播、语音应答消息和智能手机应用程序——与传统推广培训在尼泊尔农村四个地区传播肥料管理实践方面的有效性。我们发现，与对照组农户相比，智能手机应用程序组和推广培训组的农户采用追肥实践的可能性平均高出8.4和13个百分点，分别在1%和5%的水平上统计显著。智能手机应用程序处理组的农户在农艺素养测试中得分最高，比对照组高出7.8个百分点，在1%的水平上统计显著。相比之下，接受广播或语音应答消息的农户在采用相同的肥料建议方面没有更可能，也没有表现出相对于对照组农户在特定或一般农艺知识方面的改善。我们的结果表明，在诱导农户知识和采用技术方面，智能手机应用程序比推广培训更具成本效益。然而，异质性处理效应揭示，有针对性的信息通信技术方法可能在传播推广建议方面更有效。

records.title_en: How Do Institutions of Higher Education Affect Local Invention? Evidence from the Establishment of US Colleges
records.title_cn: 高等教育机构如何影响本地发明？来自美国大学设立的证据
records.abstract_en: I use narrative historical data on site selection decisions for a subset of US colleges to identify runner-up locations that were strongly considered to become the sites of new colleges. Using runner-up counties as counterfactuals in a difference-in-difference model, I find that establishing a college causes 62 percent more patents per year. Linking patents to novel college yearbook data reveals that only 12 percent of patents in a college’s county came from that college’s alumni or faculty. I find only small differences in patenting between establishing colleges and establishing other institutions as well as between colleges with different focuses on technical fields. (JEL I23, N31, N32, N71, N72, O31, O34)
records.abstract_cn: 我利用美国部分大学选址决策的叙事性历史数据，识别出曾被强烈考虑作为新大学校址的亚军地点。在双重差分模型中使用亚军县作为反事实，我发现设立一所大学每年会使专利数量增加62%。将专利与新颖的大学年鉴数据联系起来，结果显示，在大学所在县的专利中，仅有12%来自该大学的校友或教师。我发现，设立大学与设立其他机构之间，以及侧重技术领域的不同大学之间，在专利产出上仅存在微小差异。(JEL I23, N31, N32, N71, N72, O31, O34)

records.title_en: The Health Impacts of Hospital Delivery Practices
records.title_cn: 医院分娩实践的健康影响
records.abstract_en: Treatment practices vary widely across hospitals, often with little connection to patients’ medical needs. We assess impacts of these differences in delivery practices at childbirth. We find that infants quasi-randomly delivered at hospitals with higher C-section rates are born in better shape and are less likely to be readmitted, with suggestive evidence of improved survival. These benefits are driven by avoidance of prolonged labors that pose risks to infant health. In contrast, these infants are more likely to visit the emergency department for respiratory-related problems, consistent with a large observational literature linking C-section to chronic reductions in respiratory health. (JEL I11, I12, J13, J16)
records.abstract_cn: 不同医院的治疗实践差异很大，往往与患者的医疗需求关系不大。我们评估了这些分娩实践差异对分娩结果的影响。我们发现，在剖宫产率较高的医院准随机分娩的婴儿出生时状况更好，再入院的可能性更低，并有提示性证据表明生存率有所提高。这些益处源于避免了威胁婴儿健康的产程延长。相比之下，这些婴儿因呼吸相关问题就诊急诊科的可能性更高，这与大量将剖宫产与慢性呼吸健康下降联系起来的观察性文献一致。(JEL I11, I12, J13, J16)

records.title_en: Optimal Income Taxation with Spillovers from Employer Learning
records.title_cn: 雇主学习溢出效应下的最优所得税
records.abstract_en: I study optimal income taxation when human capital investment is imperfectly observable by employers. In the model, Bayesian inference about worker productivity compresses the wage distribution, lowering the private return to human capital investment. An externality arises: given the same information, employers are more optimistic about each individual if workers are generally more productive. The significance of this externality hinges on the accuracy of employers’ beliefs and the responsiveness of human capital. For the United States, taking it into account lowers optimal marginal tax rates for most workers, reducing them by a maximum of 9–13 percentage points between $50,000 and $100,000. (JEL D83, H21, H24, J24, J31, M51, M52)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了当雇主无法完全观察人力资本投资时的最优所得税。在模型中，关于工人生产率的贝叶斯推断压缩了工资分布，降低了人力资本投资的私人回报。由此产生一种外部性：在信息相同的情况下，如果工人普遍更具生产力，雇主对每个个体的看法会更加乐观。这种外部性的重要性取决于雇主信念的准确性和人力资本的响应性。对于美国而言，考虑到这一点，大多数工人的最优边际税率会降低，在9万至13万美元之间最多降低50000-100000个百分点。（JEL D83, H21, H24, J24, J31, M51, M52）

records.title_en: Pensions and Fertility: Microeconomic Evidence
records.title_cn: 养老金与生育：微观经济证据
records.abstract_en: This study identifies the causal effect of pension generosity on women’s fertility behavior. It capitalizes on Brazil’s expansion of the pension system to rural workers, whose pension wealth subsequently more than tripled. Difference-in-difference, instrumental variable, and event study methods show that the pension reform reduces the propensity of childbearing of women of fertile age by 8 percent in the short run. Completed fertility declines by 1.3 children within 20 years after the reform, reducing the contribution base of the pay-as-you-go long run. The fertility response is strongest at higher birth parities, among older women, and among mothers with sons. (JEL H55, I38, J13, J16, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 本研究识别了养老金慷慨程度对女性生育行为的因果效应。研究利用巴西将养老金体系扩展至农村劳动者，其养老金财富随后增长超过两倍。双重差分、工具变量和事件研究法表明，养老金改革在短期内使育龄女性生育倾向降低8%。改革后20年内，完成生育率下降1.3个孩子，减少了现收现付制的长期缴费基数。生育反应在较高胎次、年长女性以及有儿子的母亲中最为强烈。(JEL H55, I38, J13, J16, O15)

records.title_en: Profiting from Most-Favored-Customer Procurement Rules: Evidence from Medicaid
records.title_cn: 从最惠顾客采购规则中获利：来自医疗补助的证据
records.abstract_en: Using a difference-in-difference approach, we find that an increase to Medicaid’s minimum drug rebate under the Affordable Care Act in 2010 lowered non-Medicaid drug spending by 2.5 percent. A stylized bargaining model shows that this is likely driven by the interaction of this reform with Medicaid’s “most-favored customer” clause (MFCC). By examining the response of drugs that faced a change in incentives equivalent to the removal of Medicaid’s MFCC, we estimate that removing the Medicaid MFCC would have reduced overall 2010 non-Medicaid drug spending by an additional 3.5 percent, though it would have likely also increased Medicaid spending. (JEL C78, H51, I18, I38, L65)
records.abstract_cn: 采用双重差分方法，我们发现《平价医疗法案》在2010年提高医疗补助最低药品回扣，使非医疗补助药品支出降低了2.5%。一个程式化的议价模型表明，这很可能由该改革与医疗补助的“最惠顾客”条款（MFCC）的相互作用所驱动。通过考察那些面临等同于取消医疗补助MFCC激励变化的药品的反应，我们估计取消医疗补助MFCC将使2010年非医疗补助药品支出额外减少3.5%，尽管这也可能增加医疗补助支出。（JEL C78, H51, I18, I38, L65）

records.title_en: No Spending without Representation: School Boards and the Racial Gap in Education Finance
records.title_cn: 没有代表就没有支出：学校董事会与教育财政中的种族差距
records.abstract_en: This paper provides causal evidence that greater minority representation on school boards translates into greater investment in minority students. Focusing on California school boards, I instrument for minority (specifically, Hispanic) representation using random ballot ordering and leverage new data from a statewide capital investment program to capture intradistrict resource allocations. I show that Hispanic board members invest the marginal dollar in high-Hispanic schools within their districts. High-Hispanic schools also exhibit gains in student achievement and decreased teacher turnover. I conclude that enhancing minority representation on school boards could help combat long-standing disparities in education. JEL (H75, I21, I22, I24, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了因果证据，表明学校董事会中少数族裔代表性的增加会转化为对少数族裔学生的更多投资。以加利福尼亚州学校董事会为研究对象，我利用随机选票排序作为少数族裔（特别是西班牙裔）代表性的工具变量，并利用全州资本投资计划的新数据来捕捉学区内的资源分配。我表明，西班牙裔董事会成员将边际美元投资于其学区内的西班牙裔高占比学校。西班牙裔高占比学校的学生成绩也有所提高，教师流动率下降。我得出结论，增强学校董事会中的少数族裔代表性有助于解决长期存在的教育差距。JEL（H75，I21，I22，I24，J15）

records.title_en: Does Pay Transparency Affect the Gender Wage Gap? Evidence from Austria
records.title_cn: 薪酬透明度是否影响性别工资差距？来自奥地利的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the 2011 Austrian pay transparency law, which requires firms above a size threshold to publish internal reports on the gender pay gap. Using an event-study design, we show that the policy had no discernible effects on male and female wages, thus leaving the gender wage gap unchanged. The effects are precisely estimated, and we rule out that the policy narrowed the gender wage gap by more than 0.4 p.p.. Moreover, we do not find evidence for wage compression within establishments. We discuss several possible reasons why the reform did not reduce the gender wage gap. (JEL J16, J31, J71, K31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2011年奥地利的薪酬透明度法律，该法律要求超过规模门槛的企业发布关于性别工资差距的内部报告。使用事件研究设计，我们表明该政策对男性和女性工资没有明显影响，因此性别工资差距保持不变。这些影响被精确估计，我们排除了该政策将性别工资差距缩小超过0.4个百分点的可能性。此外，我们没有发现企业内工资压缩的证据。我们讨论了改革未能缩小性别工资差距的几个可能原因。（JEL J16, J31, J71, K31）

records.title_en: Peer Effects in Police Use of Force
records.title_cn: 警察使用武力中的同伴效应
records.abstract_en: We study the link between police officers’ on-duty injuries and their peers’ force use using a network of officers who attended the police academy together through a random lottery. On-duty injuries increase the probability of officers using force by 7 percent in the subsequent week. Officers are also more likely to injure suspects and receive complaints about neglecting victims and violating constitutional rights. The effect is concentrated in a narrow time window following the event and is not associated with significantly lower injury risk to the officer. Together, these findings suggest that emotional responses drive the effects rather than social learning. (JEL H76, J28, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用通过随机抽签共同进入警察学院的警官网络，研究了警官执勤受伤与其同伴使用武力之间的联系。执勤受伤会使警官在随后一周内使用武力的概率增加7%。警官也更有可能伤害嫌疑人，并收到关于忽视受害者和侵犯宪法权利的投诉。这种效应集中在事件发生后的一个狭窄时间窗口内，并且与警官受伤风险的显著降低无关。总之，这些发现表明情绪反应而非社会学习驱动了这些效应。(JEL H76, J28, K42)

records.title_en: Can Forward Commodity Markets Improve Spot Market Performance? Evidence from Wholesale Electricity
records.title_cn: 远期商品市场能否改善现货市场表现？来自批发电力的证据
records.abstract_en: Forward markets are believed to aggregate information about future spot prices and reduce the cost of producing the commodity. We develop a measure of the extent to which forward and spot prices agree in markets with transaction costs. Using this measure, we show that day-ahead prices better reflect real-time prices at all locations in California’s electricity market after the introduction of financial trading. We then present evidence suggesting that operating costs and input fuel use fell after the introduction of financial trading on days when the nonconvexities inherent to the production and transmission of electricity are especially relevant. (JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48)
records.abstract_cn: 远期市场被认为能够聚合关于未来现货价格的信息，并降低商品的生产成本。我们开发了一种衡量在存在交易成本的市场中远期价格与现货价格一致程度的指标。利用该指标，我们表明在引入金融交易后，加州电力市场中日前价格在所有地点更好地反映了实时价格。随后，我们提供的证据表明，在电力生产和传输固有的非凸性尤为相关的日子里，引入金融交易后运营成本和投入燃料使用量有所下降。（JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48）

records.title_en: Borrowing Costs after Sovereign Debt Relief
records.title_cn: 主权债务减免后的借贷成本
records.abstract_en: Can debt moratoria help countries weather negative shocks? We exploit the Debt Service Suspension Initiative (DSSI) to study the bond market effects of deferring official debt repayments. Using daily data on sovereign bond spreads and synthetic control methods, we show that countries eligible for official debt relief experience a larger decline in borrowing costs compared to similar, ineligible countries. This decline is stronger for countries that receive a larger relief, suggesting that the effect works through liquidity provision. By contrast, the results do not support the concern that official debt relief could generate stigma on financial markets. (JEL F34, G12, H63, O16)
records.abstract_cn: 债务暂停能否帮助国家抵御负面冲击？我们利用债务服务暂停倡议（DSSI）来研究推迟官方债务偿还对债券市场的影响。使用主权债券利差的日度数据和合成控制方法，我们表明，与类似的不符合条件国家相比，符合官方债务减免条件的国家借贷成本下降幅度更大。对于获得更大减免的国家，这种下降更为显著，表明该效应通过流动性供给发挥作用。相比之下，结果不支持官方债务减免可能在金融市场上产生污名效应的担忧。（JEL F34, G12, H63, O16）

records.title_en: Ask and You Shall Receive? Gender Differences in Regrades in College
records.title_cn: 有求必应？大学成绩复议中的性别差异
records.abstract_en: Using administrative data from a large public university, we show that male students are 18.6 percent more likely than female students to receive favorable grade changes made by instructors. Surveys of students and instructors reveal that regrade requests are prevalent and that male students are more likely to ask for regrades on the intensive margin. We corroborate the gender differences in regrade requests in an incentivized controlled experiment: we find that males have a higher willingness to pay to ask for regrades. Almost a third of the gender difference is due to gender differences in beliefs and the Big Five traits. (JEL D82, D91, I23, J16)
records.abstract_cn: 利用一所大型公立大学的行政数据，我们表明，男生获得教师有利成绩更改的可能性比女生高18.6%。对学生和教师的调查显示，成绩复议请求普遍存在，且男生在集约边际上更可能提出复议请求。我们在一个激励性对照实验中证实了复议请求中的性别差异：我们发现，男性为请求复议而支付的意愿更高。性别差异中近三分之一归因于信念和大五人格特质的性别差异。(JEL D82, D91, I23, J16)

records.title_en: Climate Change and Labor Reallocation: Evidence from Six Decades of the Indian Census
records.title_cn: 气候变化与劳动力重新配置：来自印度人口普查六十年的证据
records.abstract_en: How do rising temperatures affect long-term labor reallocation in developing economies? In this paper we examine how increases in temperature impact structural transformation and urbanization within Indian districts between 1951 and 2011. We find that rising temperatures are associated with lower shares of workers in nonagricultural sectors, with effects intensifying over a longer time frame. Supporting evidence suggests that local demand effects play an important role: declining agricultural productivity under higher temperatures reduces the demand for nonagricultural goods and services, which subsequently lowers nonagricultural labor demand. Our results illustrate that rising temperatures limit sectoral and rural-urban mobility for isolated households. (JEL J61, N35, O13, O15, O18, Q54, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 气温上升如何影响发展中经济体的长期劳动力重新配置？在本文中，我们研究了1951年至2011年间气温上升对印度各地区结构转型和城市化的影响。我们发现，气温上升与非农业部门工人占比下降相关，且这种影响在更长的时间范围内加剧。支持性证据表明，地方需求效应发挥着重要作用：高温下农业生产力下降减少了对非农业商品和服务的需求，进而降低了非农业劳动力需求。我们的结果表明，气温上升限制了孤立家庭在部门间和城乡间的流动性。（JEL J61, N35, O13, O15, O18, Q54, R23）

records.title_en: Taxing Billionaires: Estate Taxes and the Geographical Location of the Ultra-Wealthy
records.title_cn: 对亿万富翁征税：遗产税与超级富豪的地理位置
records.abstract_en: We contribute to the literature on the effect of taxes on the locational choices of wealthy individuals by examining the geographical sensitivity of the Forbes 400 richest Americans to state estate taxes. Though we find billionaires’ effective tax rates are only about half the statutory rate, their residential choices are highly sensitive to these taxes, as 35 percent of local billionaires leave states with an estate tax. This tax-induced mobility causes a large reduction in the aggregate tax base. Nonetheless, we find that the revenue benefit of an estate tax exceeds the cost for the vast majority of states. (JEL H24, H31, H71, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过考察福布斯400位最富有的美国人对州遗产税的地理敏感性，为关于税收对富人区位选择影响的文献做出贡献。尽管我们发现亿万富翁的有效税率仅为法定税率的一半左右，但他们的居住选择对这些税收高度敏感，因为35%的本地亿万富翁会离开征收遗产税的州。这种由税收引起的流动性导致总税基大幅减少。尽管如此，我们发现对于绝大多数州而言，遗产税的收入收益超过了成本。(JEL H24, H31, H71, R23)

records.title_en: Go with the Politician
records.title_cn: 跟随政治家
records.abstract_en: Chinese local leaders are frequently moved across prefectures. By combining local leader rotation data and comprehensive firm land parcel purchase data across prefectures from 2006 to 2016, this paper examines how firm–politician connections affect resource allocation and finds that a firm headquartered in a leader’s previous work prefecture purchases three times more land parcels in that leader’s new governing prefecture than the prefecture-year mean, at half the unit prices. Identification is from within-firm-year variation in various prefectures through exogenous politician rotation. Land usage efficiency is lower for these follower firms’ land parcels. Land allocation distortion is also economically sizable. (JEL D22, D72, O17, O18, P25, P26)
records.abstract_cn: 中国地方领导人经常在各地级市之间调动。通过结合地方领导人轮换数据和2006年至2016年间各地级市的企业土地购置综合数据，本文研究了企业与政治家之间的联系如何影响资源配置，并发现总部位于领导人先前工作地级市的企业，在该领导人新任地级市购买的土地地块数量是地级市年均水平的三倍，而单位价格仅为一半。识别策略来自通过外生政治家轮换引起的同一企业在不同地级市的年内变化。这些追随企业的土地地块的土地利用效率较低。土地配置扭曲在经济规模上也是显著的。(JEL D22, D72, O17, O18, P25, P26)

records.title_en: Externalities in International Tax Enforcement: Theory and Evidence
records.title_cn: 国际税收执法中的外部性：理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We show that the fiscal authorities of high-tax countries can lack the incentives to combat profit shifting to tax havens. Instead, they have incentives to focus their enforcement efforts on relocating profits booked by multinationals in other high-tax countries, crowding out the enforcement on transactions that shift profits to tax havens, and reducing the global tax payments of multinational companies. The predictions of our model are motivated and supported by the analysis of two new datasets: the universe of transfer price corrections conducted by the Danish tax authority, and new cross-country data on international tax enforcement. (JEL E62, F23, H25, H26, H87, K34)
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，高税收国家的财政当局可能缺乏打击利润转移至避税天堂的激励。相反，他们有激励将执法工作重点放在重新定位跨国公司在其他高税收国家入账的利润上，从而挤出了对将利润转移至避税天堂的交易执法，并减少了跨国公司的全球纳税额。我们模型的预测得到了两个新数据集分析的支持和激励：丹麦税务机关进行的转让定价调整全集，以及关于国际税收执法的新的跨国数据。（JEL E62, F23, H25, H26, H87, K34）

records.title_en: Coase and Cap-and-Trade: Evidence on the Independence Property from the European Carbon Market
records.title_cn: 科斯与总量管制与交易：来自欧洲碳市场独立性属性的证据
records.abstract_en: I examine the Coasean independence property in a large multinational cap-and-trade scheme for greenhouse gas emissions, the EU Emissions Trading System. I analyze whether emissions of power producers are independent from allowance allocations by leveraging a change in allocation policy for a difference-in-difference strategy. The evidence suggests that the independence property holds overall and for larger emitters and that firms respond to the loss in allocation by increasing allowance purchases. Suggestive evidence for small emitters indicates that trading costs or behavioral bias distorts their emission decisions. However, their small emission share leaves the independence property intact at the sector level. (JEL L94, L98, Q48, Q51, Q54, Q58)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了科斯独立性属性在一个大型跨国温室气体排放总量管制与交易计划——欧盟排放交易体系中的表现。我通过利用分配政策的变化进行双重差分策略，分析了电力生产者的排放是否独立于配额分配。证据表明，独立性属性总体上成立，对于较大排放者也是如此，并且企业通过增加配额购买来应对分配损失。对小排放者的提示性证据表明，交易成本或行为偏差扭曲了他们的排放决策。然而，他们的排放份额较小，使得独立性属性在部门层面保持不变。(JEL L94, L98, Q48, Q51, Q54, Q58)

records.title_en: Dynamic Privacy Choices
records.title_cn: 动态隐私选择
records.abstract_en: I study a dynamic model of consumer privacy and platform data collection. In each period consumers choose their level of platform activity. Greater activity generates more information about the consumer, thereby increasing platform profits. When the platform can commit to the future privacy policy, it collects information by committing to gradually decreasing the level of privacy protection. In the long run consumers lose privacy and receive low payoffs but choose high activity levels. In contrast, the platform with weaker commitment power may attain the commitment outcome or fail to collect any data depending on consumer expectations regarding future privacy protection. (JEL C93, D11, D82, D83, D84, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个关于消费者隐私和平台数据收集的动态模型。在每个时期，消费者选择他们的平台活动水平。更多的活动会产生关于消费者的更多信息，从而增加平台利润。当平台能够承诺未来的隐私政策时，它通过承诺逐渐降低隐私保护水平来收集信息。从长远来看，消费者失去隐私并获得低回报，但选择高活动水平。相比之下，承诺能力较弱的平台可能根据消费者对未来隐私保护的预期，达到承诺结果或无法收集任何数据。(JEL C93, D11, D82, D83, D84, L86)

records.title_en: Blind Disclosure
records.title_cn: 盲目披露
records.abstract_en: We develop and test a theory of blind disclosure. A sender chooses whether to disclose information based on a preliminary, private signal. In the unique equilibrium, contrary to the literature’s canonical unraveling result, senders disclose only if their preliminary signal exceeds a cutoff. This cutoff rule leads to partial unraveling in environments with either risk aversion or moral hazard, and disclosure decreases with uncertainty. Using unique administrative data on disclosed and undisclosed grades in a large university, we find that the model is consistent with student choices during spring 2020 to conceal letter grades by switching to optional pass-fail grades. (JEL D81, D82, I23)
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发并检验了一个盲目披露理论。发送者根据初步的私人信号选择是否披露信息。在唯一均衡中，与文献中的经典揭示结果相反，发送者仅在其初步信号超过某个临界值时才会披露。这一临界值规则在存在风险厌恶或道德风险的环境中导致部分揭示，且披露随不确定性增加而减少。利用某大型大学中已披露和未披露成绩的独特行政数据，我们发现该模型与学生在2020年春季通过转换为可选及格-不及格成绩来隐藏字母等级的选择一致。（JEL D81, D82, I23）

records.title_en: Optimal Nonlinear Pricing with Data-Sensitive Consumers
records.title_cn: 数据敏感型消费者的最优非线性定价
records.abstract_en: We study monopolistic screening when some consumers are data sensitive and incur a privacy cost if their purchase reveals information to the monopolist. The monopolist discriminates between data-sensitive and classical consumers using privacy mechanisms that consist of a direct mechanism and a privacy option. A privacy mechanism is optimal for large privacy costs and leaves classical consumers better off than data-sensitive consumers with the same valuation. When privacy preferences become public information, data-sensitive consumers and the monopolist gain, whereas classical consumers lose. Our results are relevant for policies targeting consumers’ data awareness, such as the European General Data Protection Regulation. (JEL D11, D42, D82, D83, L12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当部分消费者具有数据敏感性，且其购买行为向垄断者披露信息会带来隐私成本时的垄断者甄别问题。垄断者通过由直接机制和隐私选项组成的隐私机制来区分数据敏感型消费者和传统消费者。对于较大的隐私成本，隐私机制是最优的，并且使得具有相同估值的传统消费者比数据敏感型消费者获得更高的效用。当隐私偏好成为公开信息时，数据敏感型消费者和垄断者获益，而传统消费者受损。我们的研究结果对针对消费者数据意识的政策具有相关性，例如欧洲通用数据保护条例。（JEL D11, D42, D82, D83, L12）

records.title_en: Competition in Pricing Algorithms
records.title_cn: 定价算法中的竞争
records.abstract_en: We document new facts about pricing technology using high-frequency data, and we examine the implications for competition. Some online retailers employ technology that allows for more frequent price changes and automated responses to price changes by rivals. Motivated by these facts, we consider a model in which firms can differ in pricing frequency and choose pricing algorithms that are a function of rivals’ prices. In competitive (Markov perfect) equilibrium, the introduction of simple pricing algorithms can increase price levels, generate price dispersion, and exacerbate the price effects of mergers. (JEL D21, D22, D43, G34, L13, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用高频数据记录了关于定价技术的新事实，并考察了其对竞争的影响。一些在线零售商采用的技术允许更频繁的价格变动以及对竞争对手价格变动的自动响应。受这些事实的启发，我们考虑了一个模型，其中企业可以在定价频率上有所不同，并选择作为竞争对手价格函数的定价算法。在竞争性（马尔可夫完美）均衡中，简单定价算法的引入可以提高价格水平，产生价格离散，并加剧合并的价格效应。（JEL D21, D22, D43, G34, L13, L81）

records.title_en: Targeted Product Design
records.title_cn: 目标产品设计
records.abstract_en: We propose an intuitive representation of product design in which firms locate inside a circle and consumers in its outer circumference. Designs trade off horizontal and vertical transport costs. Our setting encompasses all linear demand rotations. Firms with lower quality or higher marginal costs choose niche designs that cater to specific consumers at the expense of alienating the rest. Firms choose intermediate designs or more polarized ones, instead, depending on the convexity of the vertical transport cost. We examine such design choices in monopoly, duopoly, and monopolistic competition settings. (JEL D21, D24, D42, D43)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种直观的产品设计表示，其中企业位于圆内，消费者位于圆周上。设计在水平与垂直运输成本之间进行权衡。我们的设定涵盖了所有线性需求旋转。质量较低或边际成本较高的企业选择利基设计，以迎合特定消费者，但代价是疏远其他消费者。相反，企业选择中间设计或更两极化的设计，这取决于垂直运输成本的凸性。我们考察了垄断、双头垄断和垄断竞争环境中的此类设计选择。（JEL D21, D24, D42, D43）

records.title_en: The Good, the Bad, and the Complex: Product Design with Imperfect Information
records.title_cn: 好、坏与复杂：不完全信息下的产品设计
records.abstract_en: We study the joint determination of product quality and complexity. In our model complexity affects how difficult it is for an agent to acquire information about product quality. An agent can accept or reject a product proposed by a designer, who can affect the quality and the complexity of the product. We find that complexity is not a necessary feature of low-quality products. An increase in designer–agent alignment leads to more complex but better-quality products. However, higher product demand or lower competition among designers leads to more complex and lower-quality products. We relate our findings to the existing empirical evidence. (JEL D82, D83, G23, L15, L51, L84)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了产品质量与复杂性的联合决定。在我们的模型中，复杂性影响代理人获取产品质量信息的难度。代理人可以接受或拒绝设计师提出的产品，而设计师可以影响产品的质量和复杂性。我们发现，复杂性并非低质量产品的必要特征。设计师与代理人之间一致性的增加会导致产品更复杂但质量更高。然而，更高的产品需求或设计师之间更低的竞争会导致产品更复杂且质量更低。我们将我们的发现与现有的经验证据联系起来。（JEL D82, D83, G23, L15, L51, L84）

records.title_en: Ad Clutter, Time Use, and Media Diversity
records.title_cn: 广告拥挤、时间使用与媒体多样性
records.abstract_en: We introduce advertising congestion along with a time use model of consumer choice among media. Both consumers and advertisers multihome. Higher equilibrium advertising levels ensue on less popular media platforms because platforms treat consumer attention as a common property resource: smaller platforms internalize less of the congestion from advertising and so advertise more. Platform entry raises the ad nuisance price to consumers and diminishes the quality of the consumption experience on all platforms. For consumer welfare this price effect of entry dominates the positive effect of more variety in some settings; thus, consumers will then be worse off after entry. (JEL D11, D43, L13, L82, M37)
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入广告拥挤以及消费者在媒体间选择的时间使用模型。消费者和广告商都进行多归属。均衡广告水平在较不流行的媒体平台上更高，因为平台将消费者注意力视为公共财产资源：较小的平台较少内化广告带来的拥挤，因此广告更多。平台进入提高了消费者的广告滋扰价格，并降低了所有平台上消费体验的质量。对于消费者福利而言，在某些情况下，这种进入的价格效应超过了更多多样性的积极效应；因此，进入后消费者的境况可能会变差。（JEL D11, D43, L13, L82, M37）

records.title_en: Reference Dependence and Attribution Bias: Evidence from Real-Effort Experiments
records.title_cn: 参考依赖与归因偏差：来自真实努力实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We document a form of attribution bias wherein people wrongly ascribe sensations of positive or negative surprise to the underlying disutility of a real-effort task. Participants in our experiments learned from experience about two unfamiliar tasks, one more onerous than the other. We manipulated expectations about which task they would face: some participants were assigned their task by chance, while others knew their assignment in advance. Hours later, we elicited willingness to work again on that same task. Participants assigned the less (more) onerous task by chance were more (less) willing to work than those who knew their assignment in advance. (JEL C91, D84, D91, M54)
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了一种归因偏差形式，即人们错误地将积极或消极惊喜的感受归因于真实努力任务的基本负效用。在我们的实验中，参与者通过经验了解了两个不熟悉的任务，其中一个比另一个更繁重。我们操纵了他们对将要面对哪个任务的预期：一些参与者通过随机方式被分配任务，而另一些则提前知道他们的分配。数小时后，我们引出了他们再次从事同一任务的意愿。通过随机方式被分配到较不（更）繁重任务的参与者比那些提前知道分配的人更（不）愿意工作。（JEL C91, D84, D91, M54）

records.title_en: The Doors of Perception: Theory and Evidence of Frame-Dependent Rationalizability
records.title_cn: 知觉之门：框架依赖理性化的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate how strategic behavior is affected by the set of notions (frames) used when thinking about the game. In our games the action set consists of visual objects: each player must privately choose one, trying to match the counterpart’s choice. We propose a model where different player-types are aware of different attributes of the action set (hence, different frames). One of the novelties is an epistemic structure that allows players to think about new frames, after initial unawareness of some attributes. To test the model, our experimental design brings about multiple frames by varying subjects’ awareness of several attributes. (JEL C72, C78, C91, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在思考博弈时所使用的概念集（框架）如何影响策略行为。在我们的博弈中，行动集由视觉对象组成：每个参与者必须私下选择一个，试图与对手的选择相匹配。我们提出了一个模型，其中不同的参与者类型意识到行动集的不同属性（因此，有不同的框架）。新颖之处之一是一种认知结构，允许参与者在最初对某些属性无意识之后，思考新的框架。为了检验该模型，我们的实验设计通过改变参与者对几个属性的意识来产生多个框架。（JEL C72, C78, C91, D83）

records.title_en: Reference Pricing as a Deterrent to Entry: Evidence from the European Pharmaceutical Market
records.title_cn: 参考定价作为进入威慑：来自欧洲药品市场的证据
records.abstract_en: External reference pricing (ERP), the practice of benchmarking domestic drug prices to foreign prices, generates an incentive for firms to withhold products from low-income countries. Using a novel moment inequality approach, we estimate a structural model to measure how ERP policies affect access to innovative drugs across Europe. We find that ERP increases entry delays in eight low-income European countries by up to one year per drug. The European Union could remove these delays without replacing ERP by compensating firms through lump-sum transfers at the cost of around €18 million per drug. (JEL L13, L51, L65)
records.abstract_cn: 外部参考定价（ERP），即根据国外价格设定国内药品价格的基准做法，会产生企业向低收入国家扣留产品的激励。我们使用一种新颖的矩不等式方法，估计了一个结构模型，以衡量ERP政策如何影响欧洲创新药物的可及性。我们发现，ERP使八个低收入欧洲国家的药品进入延迟每药最多增加一年。欧盟可以通过一次性转移支付补偿企业，以每药约18百万欧元的成本消除这些延迟，而无需替换ERP。（JEL L13, L51, L65）

records.title_en: Complexity and Procedural Choice
records.title_cn: 复杂性与程序选择
records.abstract_en: We test the core ideas of the “automata” approach to bounded rationality, using simple experimental bandit tasks. Optimality requires subjects to use a moderately complex decision procedure, but most subjects in our baseline condition instead use simpler (often suboptimal) procedures that economize on “states” in the algorithmic structure of the rule. When we artificially remove the mental costs of tracking states by having the computer track and organize past events, subjects abandon these simpler rules and use maximally complex optimal rules instead. The results thus suggest that the main type of complexity described in the automata literature fundamentally influences behavior. (JEL C91, D12, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用简单的实验性老虎机任务，检验了“自动机”方法对有限理性的核心思想。最优性要求受试者使用中等复杂度的决策程序，但我们在基线条件下的多数受试者反而使用更简单（通常次优）的程序，这些程序在规则的算法结构中节省了“状态”。当我们通过让计算机跟踪和组织过去的事件来人为地消除跟踪状态的心理成本时，受试者放弃了这些更简单的规则，转而使用最大复杂度的最优规则。因此，结果表明，自动机文献中描述的主要复杂性类型从根本上影响了行为。（JEL C91, D12, D91）

records.title_en: Biased Beliefs in Search Markets
records.title_cn: 搜索市场中的有偏信念
records.abstract_en: We study the implications of biased consumer beliefs for search market outcomes in the seminal framework due to Diamond (1971). Biased consumers base their search strategy on a belief function that specifies for any (true) distribution of utility offers in the market a possibly incorrect distribution of utility offers. If biased consumers overestimate the best offer in the market, a novel type of equilibrium may emerge in which firms make exceptionally favorable offers in order to meet biased consumers’ unreasonably high expectations, which then become partially self-fulfilling. Consequently, the presence of biased consumers may improve the welfare of all consumers. (JEL D11, D21, D83, D84)
records.abstract_cn: 我们在Diamond（1971）的开创性框架中研究消费者有偏信念对搜索市场结果的影响。有偏消费者基于一个信念函数来制定其搜索策略，该信念函数针对市场中效用报价的任何（真实）分布，指定一个可能不正确的效用报价分布。如果有偏消费者高估了市场中的最优报价，可能会出现一种新型均衡，在这种均衡中，企业提供异常优惠的报价以满足有偏消费者不切实际的高期望，这些期望随后部分地自我实现。因此，有偏消费者的存在可能改善所有消费者的福利。（JEL D11, D21, D83, D84）

records.title_en: At the Helm, Kirk or Spock? The Pros and Cons of Charismatic Leadership
records.title_cn: 掌舵者，柯克还是斯波克？魅力型领导的利与弊
records.abstract_en: Charismatic leaders are often desired. At the same time, experience, especially with demagogues, as well as social science studies, raise doubts about such leaders. This paper offers explanations for charismatic leadership’s “mixed report card.” It offers insights into why and when charismatic leadership can be effective; which, when, and why certain groups will prefer more to less charismatic leaders; and how being more charismatic can make leaders worse in other dimensions, particularly causing them to work less hard on their followers’ behalf. (JEL D72, D83, M54)
records.abstract_cn: 魅力型领导往往备受追捧。与此同时，经验（尤其是与煽动家打交道的经验）以及社会科学研究，却对这种领导提出质疑。本文为魅力型领导的“好坏参半的成绩单”提供了解释。文中探讨了魅力型领导为何以及何时能够有效；哪些群体、在何种情况下以及为何会偏好魅力程度更高而非更低的领导；以及更具魅力如何可能使领导在其他方面表现更差，尤其是导致他们不再那么努力地为追随者谋福利。（JEL D72, D83, M54）

records.title_en: Too Good to Be True? Retention Rules for Noisy Agents
records.title_cn: 好得令人难以置信？对噪声代理人的留任规则
records.abstract_en: An agent who privately knows his type seeks to be retained by a principal. Agents signal their type with some ambient noise, but can alter this noise, perhaps at some cost. Our main finding is that in equilibrium, the principal treats extreme signals in either direction with suspicion, and retains the agent if and only if the signal falls in some intermediate bounded set. In short, she follows the maxim: “if it seems too good to be true, it probably is.” We consider extensions and applications, including non-normal signal structures, dynamics with term limits, risky portfolio management, and political risk-taking. (JEL D72, D82, G11, G41)
records.abstract_cn: 一个私下知晓自己类型的代理人寻求被委托人留任。代理人通过一些环境噪声来传递其类型信号，但可以改变这种噪声，或许需要付出一定成本。我们的主要发现是，在均衡中，委托人对任一方向的极端信号持怀疑态度，并且仅当信号落在某个中间有界集合内时才留任代理人。简言之，她遵循这样的准则：“如果某事好得令人难以置信，那它很可能就是假的。”我们考虑了扩展和应用，包括非正态信号结构、有任期限制的动态、风险投资组合管理以及政治风险承担。（JEL D72, D82, G11, G41）

records.title_en: Learning by Choosing: Career Concerns with Observable Actions
records.title_cn: 选择中学习：可观察行动下的职业关注
records.abstract_en: This paper explores potential inefficiencies of incomplete contracts in a dynamic career concerns context. In a firm-worker relationship, the worker performs public tasks that have trade-offs between productivity and informativeness. We show that the first-best outcome can be obtained with short-term contracts if the wage can depend on the task choice. This provides an explanation for wage jumps at promotions—the worker is assigned the more productive but less informative task after promotion. If task choice is not contractible, then inefficiency arises: the worker has an endogenous bias toward informativeness, while the firm is biased toward productivity. (JEL D82, D83, D86, J24, J31, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了动态职业关注背景下不完全契约的潜在低效率。在企业与工人的关系中，工人执行公共任务，这些任务在生产率和信息量之间存在权衡。我们表明，如果工资可以依赖于任务选择，那么短期契约可以实现最优结果。这为晋升时的工资跃升提供了一种解释——晋升后，工人被分配到生产率更高但信息量更少的任务。如果任务选择不可契约化，则会出现低效率：工人对信息量存在内生偏好，而企业则偏向于生产率。（JEL D82, D83, D86, J24, J31, M51）

records.title_en: Relative Wealth Concerns, Executive Compensation, and Managerial Risk-Taking
records.title_cn: 相对财富关注、高管薪酬与管理层风险承担
records.abstract_en: This paper theoretically examines how relative wealth concerns affect equilibrium contracting and systemic risk-taking. We find that such externalities can generate pay for luck as an equilibrium strategy. In expectation of pay for luck in other firms, tying managerial pay to luck provides insurance to managers against a compensation shortfall relative to executive peers. We also show that an effort-inducing mechanism exists: managers have additional incentives to exert effort in utilizing investment opportunities, which helps them keep up with their peers during industry movements; however, pay for luck that is efficient within firms can nonetheless exacerbate aggregate fluctuations, especially during periods of heightened market risk. (JEL D81, D82, D86, G51, M12, M52)
records.abstract_cn: 本文从理论上考察了相对财富关注如何影响均衡契约和系统性风险承担。我们发现，这种外部性可以产生为运气付费作为均衡策略。预期到其他公司存在为运气付费，将管理层薪酬与运气挂钩为管理者提供了相对于同行高管薪酬缺口的保险。我们还表明，存在一种努力激励机制：管理者在利用投资机会方面有额外的努力激励，这有助于他们在行业变动中跟上同行；然而，公司内部有效的为运气付费却可能加剧总体波动，尤其是在市场风险加剧时期。（JEL D81, D82, D86, G51, M12, M52）

records.title_en: Raising the Bar: Certification Thresholds and Market Outcomes
records.title_cn: 提高门槛：认证阈值与市场结果
records.abstract_en: Certification of sellers by trusted third parties helps alleviate information asymmetries in markets, yet little is known about the impact of a certification’s threshold on market outcomes. Exploiting a policy change on eBay, we study how a more selective certification threshold affects the distribution of quality and incumbent behavior. We develop a stylized model that shows how changes in selectivity change the distribution of quality and prices in markets. Using rich data from hundreds of online categories on eBay.com , we find support for the model’s hypotheses. Our results help inform the design of certification selectivity in electronic and other markets. (JEL D82, L11, L15, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 由可信第三方对卖家进行认证有助于缓解市场中的信息不对称，然而关于认证阈值对市场结果的影响却知之甚少。利用eBay上的一项政策变化，我们研究了更具选择性的认证阈值如何影响质量分布和现有卖家行为。我们构建了一个简化模型，展示了选择性变化如何改变市场中的质量分布和价格。利用来自eBay.com上数百个在线类别的丰富数据，我们找到了支持模型假设的证据。我们的结果有助于为电子市场及其他市场的认证选择性设计提供信息。(JEL D82, L11, L15, L86)

records.title_en: Stable and Efficient Resource Allocation with Contracts
records.title_cn: 契约下的稳定与高效资源分配
records.abstract_en: Consider indivisible-object allocation with contracts, such as college admissions, where contracts specify majors. Can a designer guarantee a stable and (student) efficient matching? I show that contracts put stability and efficiency at odds; a necessary condition to ensure these properties is student-lexicographic priorities—schools must rank contracts from “second-tier” students consecutively. I present the weakest restriction guaranteeing stability and efficiency, and characterize necessary and sufficient conditions for any mechanism within a general class to deliver a stable and efficient matching in an incentive compatible manner. I apply this result to two well-known mechanisms: deferred acceptance and top trading cycles. (JEL C78, D82, D86, I23)
records.abstract_cn: 考虑不可分割物品与契约的分配问题，例如大学录取，其中契约指定专业。设计者能否保证稳定且（学生）高效的匹配？我表明契约使稳定性与效率相互冲突；确保这些性质的必要条件是学生字典序优先级——学校必须将来自“二流”学生的契约连续排序。我提出了保证稳定性与效率的最弱限制，并刻画了一般类机制中任何机制以激励相容方式提供稳定且高效匹配的充分必要条件。我将此结果应用于两个著名机制：延迟接受和顶层交易循环。（JEL C78, D82, D86, I23）

records.title_en: Optimal Task Scheduling under Adverse Selection and Hidden Actions
records.title_cn: 逆向选择与隐藏行动下的最优任务调度
records.abstract_en: A Principal owns a project consisting of several tasks. Tasks differ, both in their innate success probabilities and their incremental benefits. Moreover, only specialists can perform these tasks. Subject to moral hazard and adverse selection, in what order should the Principal commission the tasks, and when should she terminate the project? What investments into changing tasks’ characteristics yield the highest marginal profit? These are typical issues that arise in sequencing R&D activities and other sequential production processes. We show that, despite informational constraints, a simple index—a task’s effective marginal contribution—determines the optimal schedule/mechanism. (JEL D82, L23, L24, L65, M11, O31)
records.abstract_cn: 委托人拥有一个由若干任务组成的项目。任务在固有成功概率和增量收益方面各不相同。此外，只有专家才能执行这些任务。在道德风险和逆向选择的约束下，委托人应按照什么顺序委托任务，以及何时终止项目？对改变任务特征的投资中，哪些能产生最高的边际利润？这些是排序研发活动和其他顺序生产过程中出现的典型问题。我们表明，尽管存在信息约束，一个简单的指标——任务的有效边际贡献——决定了最优调度/机制。（JEL D82, L23, L24, L65, M11, O31）

records.title_en: Markets with Within-Type Adverse Selection
records.title_cn: 具有类型内逆向选择的市场
records.abstract_en: We study bilateral trade with a seller owning multiple units of a good, where each unit is of binary quality. The seller privately knows her “type”—defined by the number of lemons that she owns—and which units in her endowments are the lemons (“ within-type adverse selection”). We characterize the set of informationally constrained Pareto optimal allocations and show that every such allocation must involve a trade characterized by a threshold λ ∗ , with types having less (more) than λ ∗ units of lemons selling only their lemons (selling their entire endowment). We provide conditions for a distribution shift that give Pareto-improving allocations. (JEL D82, D86, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个卖方拥有多单位商品的双边贸易，其中每个单位具有二元质量。卖方私下知道她的“类型”——由她拥有的次品数量定义——以及在她的禀赋中哪些单位是次品（“类型内逆向选择”）。我们刻画了信息约束下帕累托最优配置的集合，并表明每个这样的配置必须涉及以阈值 λ ∗ 为特征的贸易，其中拥有少于（多于）λ ∗ 个次品的类型仅出售其次品（出售其全部禀赋）。我们提供了分布变化的条件，这些条件给出帕累托改进的配置。（JEL D82, D86, L15）

records.title_en: Craig Gundersen
records.title_cn: 克雷格·冈德森
records.abstract_en: Craig Gundersen is the Snee Family Endowed Chair at the Baylor Collaborative on Hunger and Poverty and a professor in the Department of Economics at Baylor University. Prior to joining Baylor, he was ACES Distinguished Professor in the Department of Agricultural and Consumer Economics at University of Illinois and, before that, he had positions at Iowa State University and USDA, Economic Research Service. Gundersen is currently also on the technical advisory group for Feeding America, the lead researcher on Feeding America's Map the Meal Gap project, a Round Table Fellow of the Farm Foundation, and a faculty affiliate of the Wilson Sheehan Lab for Economic Opportunities at the University of Notre Dame. From 2018 to 2022 he was the managing editor for Applied Economic Perspectives and Policy. For over 25 years, Gundersen's research has concentrated on the causes and consequences of food insecurity and on the evaluation of food assistance programs, with an emphasis on the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP, formerly known as the Food Stamp Program). In terms of the causes of food insecurity, his work has included, for example, examinations of the multigenerational households, American Indians, and food bank clients. Of particular note is his invention of Map the Meal Gap, which has become the standard tool to portray the geography of food insecurity in the U.S. He also has the two most cited review papers in this area with one of them recognized as the Outstanding Paper in the 2011 volume of AEPP. In terms of the consequences of food insecurity, his work has concentrated on dispelling myths of the connection between food insecurity and obesity, on the myriad negative health outcomes of food insecurity among seniors, and on the impacts of food insecurity on mortality and health care costs. He also has the most cited review paper on the consequences of food insecurity. With respect to his work evaluating food assistance programs, his work was the first to show that, after controlling for nonrandom selection into SNAP, recipients are less likely to be food insecure than eligible nonrecipients. This result was verified in further papers he co-authored including ones that also addressed misreporting of SNAP receipt. Gundersen's research has been published in top journals across a number of fields including in ag economics (e.g., AEPP, Food Policy, AJAE), economics (e.g., Journal of Human Resources, Journal of Econometrics, Journal of Health Economics), statistics (e.g., Journal of the American Statistical Association), nutrition (e.g., Journal of Nutrition), and medicine (e.g., New England Journal of Medicine, Canadian Medical Association Journal). His research has been funded by over $20 million in external funding from over 25 grants. These funds have come from several sources including the National Institute for Food and Agriculture (NIFA), Economic Research Service (ERS), Food and Nutrition Service (FNS), Foundation for Food and Agriculture Research (FFAR), and Canadian Institutes for Health Research (CIHR). The stature of his research and the importance of the topics he pursues has led Gundersen to frequently in the media and in presentations to policymakers and program administrators.
records.abstract_cn: 克雷格·冈德森是贝勒大学饥饿与贫困合作组织的斯尼家族讲席教授，同时也是贝勒大学经济系的教授。在加入贝勒大学之前，他曾在伊利诺伊大学农业与消费经济系担任ACES杰出教授，更早之前，他在爱荷华州立大学和美国农业部经济研究局任职。冈德森目前还是美国消除饥饿组织技术咨询小组成员、该组织“绘制膳食缺口”项目的首席研究员、农场基金会圆桌会议研究员，以及圣母大学威尔逊·希恩经济机会实验室的教职附属人员。从2018年到2022年，他担任《应用经济展望与政策》杂志的主编。超过25年来，冈德森的研究集中于食物不安全的原因和后果，以及对食品援助项目的评估，重点关注补充营养援助计划（SNAP，前身为食品券计划）。在食物不安全的原因方面，他的工作包括例如对多代同堂家庭、美国印第安人和食物银行客户的研究。特别值得一提的是，他发明了“绘制膳食缺口”工具，该工具已成为描绘美国食物不安全地理分布的标准工具。他还拥有该领域被引用最多的两篇综述论文，其中一篇被评为《应用经济展望与政策》2011年卷的杰出论文。在食物不安全的后果方面，他的工作集中于破除食物不安全与肥胖之间关联的迷思、研究老年人食物不安全带来的众多负面健康结果，以及食物不安全对死亡率和医疗保健成本的影响。他还拥有关于食物不安全后果的被引用最多的综述论文。在评估食品援助项目的工作中，他的研究首次表明，在控制SNAP参与的非随机选择后，受助者比符合条件的非受助者更不可能面临食物不安全。这一结果在他合著的其他论文中得到了验证，包括那些也处理SNAP领取误报问题的论文。冈德森的研究发表在多个领域的顶级期刊上，包括农业经济学（如《应用经济展望与政策》、《食品政策》、《美国农业经济学杂志》）、经济学（如《人力资源杂志》、《计量经济学杂志》、《健康经济学杂志》）、统计学（如《美国统计协会杂志》）、营养学（如《营养杂志》）和医学（如《新英格兰医学杂志》、《加拿大医学会杂志》）。他的研究获得了超过20万美元的外部资助，来自超过25项拨款。这些资金来自多个来源，包括国家食品与农业研究所（NIFA）、经济研究局（ERS）、食品与营养服务局（FNS）、食品与农业研究基金会（FFAR）和加拿大健康研究所（CIHR）。他的研究地位和他所研究主题的重要性，使得冈德森经常出现在媒体上，并向政策制定者和项目管理者做报告。

records.title_en: A call for justice work in agricultural and applied economics
records.title_cn: 呼吁农业与应用经济学中的正义工作
records.abstract_en: This presidential address calls the membership to explore ways of doing justice work in their research, teaching, extension, and outreach activities. By sharing my story and developing a content analysis of presidential addresses and invited papers published in the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association journals, I demonstrate how race has shaped my work and the need for additional work in this area. Through this example, I hope that members of the profession will find new inspiration to do justice work.
records.abstract_cn: 这篇主席致辞呼吁成员们在研究、教学、推广和外联活动中探索开展正义工作的方式。通过分享我的个人经历，并对农业与应用经济学协会期刊上发表的主席致辞和特邀论文进行内容分析，我展示了种族如何塑造了我的工作，以及在该领域开展更多工作的必要性。通过这个例子，我希望本专业的成员能找到新的灵感来开展正义工作。

records.title_en: Outsourcing the dry season: Cattle ranchers' responses to weather shocks in the Brazilian Amazon
records.title_cn: 外包旱季：巴西亚马逊地区养牛户对天气冲击的应对
records.abstract_en: Livestock production plays a vital role in the global economy, yet little is known about how climate change will affect the industry. Studies of crop agriculture may not translate to livestock agriculture due to differences in the set of potential adaptation strategies. Ranchers' responses to changing weather and climate are particularly relevant in the Brazilian Amazon, where the dry season is increasing by as much as 0.6 days per year. A longer dry season increases production risks as animals may succumb to starvation, lack of water, or heat stress. I pair transaction data and weather shocks to show that ranchers strategically sold animals prior to the dry season, in response to two predictors of an extreme dry season: sporadic rainfall and high temperatures prior to the dry season. Ranchers sold animals for both fattening and slaughter in response to sporadic rainfall prior. Nearly half of animals initially sold for fattening were sold for slaughter 90 days later. In contrast, ranchers responded to high temperatures solely by selling for slaughter, suggesting that current on‐farm technologies are insufficient to prevent losses from heat stress. The overall supply increased in years with sporadic rainfall and high temperatures, but the supply fell by a greater amount the following year. My results suggest that farmers are currently not fully insulated from the effects of a severe dry season. As severe dry seasons become more frequent, the industry will likely increasingly rely on feedlots and need additional methods to cope with heat stress.
records.abstract_cn: 畜牧业在全球经济中扮演着重要角色，但关于气候变化将如何影响该行业的研究却很少。由于潜在的适应策略组合不同，针对农作物农业的研究可能无法直接适用于畜牧业。在巴西亚马逊地区，养牛户对天气和气候变化的应对尤为相关，因为该地区的旱季每年增加多达0.6天。更长的旱季会增加生产风险，因为动物可能因饥饿、缺水或热应激而死亡。我将交易数据与天气冲击相结合，表明养牛户在旱季之前战略性出售动物，以应对极端旱季的两个预测指标：旱季前的零星降雨和高温。养牛户针对之前的零星降雨出售用于育肥和屠宰的动物。最初出售用于育肥的动物中，近一半在90天后被出售用于屠宰。相比之下，养牛户仅通过出售用于屠宰来应对高温，这表明当前的农场技术不足以防止热应激造成的损失。在零星降雨和高温的年份，总供应量增加，但次年供应量下降幅度更大。我的结果表明，农民目前并未完全免受严重旱季的影响。随着严重旱季变得更加频繁，该行业可能将越来越依赖育肥场，并需要额外的方法来应对热应激。

records.title_en: Sectoral wage gaps and gender in rural India †
records.title_cn: 印度农村的部门工资差距与性别
records.abstract_en: Using detailed monthly household panel data from rural India, I analyze sectoral wage gaps for men and women. I show that the wage gap across the non‐farm and farm sectors is much higher for women than for men. Relative to men, women also work less time in non‐farm wage employment than in farm wage employment. Taken together, these findings suggest that constraints are preventing women from reallocating their time to more remunerative wage employment opportunities. Women are less likely to work outside of their own village in the non‐farm sector, yet the wage gap is driven by higher caste and married women. These results are consistent with a lack of local non‐farm employment opportunities interacting with barriers to labor mobility for women but not men.
records.abstract_cn: 利用印度农村详细的月度家庭面板数据，我分析了男性和女性的部门工资差距。我表明，非农部门与农业部门之间的工资差距，女性远高于男性。相对于男性，女性在非农工资就业上的时间也少于农业工资就业。综合来看，这些发现表明存在制约因素，阻碍女性将时间重新分配到报酬更高的工资就业机会上。女性在非农部门中更不可能在本村以外工作，然而工资差距却由高种姓和已婚女性驱动。这些结果与当地非农就业机会缺乏以及女性（而非男性）劳动力流动障碍相互作用的情况一致。

records.title_en: On export duration puzzles
records.title_cn: 关于出口持续期的谜题
records.abstract_en: We investigate two puzzles in the export duration literature. The first puzzle has to do with the frequent entries and exits of firms in export markets, which are at odds with the large fixed export costs in such markets. We introduce convex production technologies in a trade model to show how variable marginal costs create direct linkages between export markets. As fixed export costs vary across destinations, more productive firms need not necessarily export to more destinations. Cost convexity implies that the probability of supplying a given export market is adversely affected by positive export shocks in other markets. This is supported by our empirical analysis of bilateral flows for over 200 agri‐food products to 176 destinations originating from six large exporting countries. The second puzzle has to do with the paradoxical effect of tariffs reported in empirical export duration studies. When endogeneity is addressed, tariffs increase the probability of an export failure.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了出口持续期文献中的两个谜题。第一个谜题与企业在出口市场中频繁进入和退出有关，这与该市场中巨大的固定出口成本相矛盾。我们在贸易模型中引入凸性生产技术，以展示可变边际成本如何在出口市场之间建立直接联系。由于固定出口成本因目的地而异，生产率更高的企业不一定出口到更多目的地。成本凸性意味着，供应某一出口市场的概率会受到其他市场正向出口冲击的不利影响。我们对来自六个主要出口国、涵盖超过200种农产品和食品、出口至176个目的地的双边流量进行的实证分析支持了这一观点。第二个谜题涉及实证出口持续期研究中报告的关税悖论效应。当处理内生性后，关税增加了出口失败的概率。

records.title_en: Unemployment benefits, food insecurity, and supplemental nutrition assistance program spending
records.title_cn: 失业救济、粮食不安全和补充营养援助计划支出
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of unemployment insurance (UI) expansions on household food insecurity in the United States using the Food Security Supplement to the Current Population Survey for 1999–2017. We exploit the plausibly exogenous variation in state maximum weekly UI benefits across states and over time. The two‐part model demonstrates that a $100 increase in state weekly UI benefits reduces the likelihood of food insecurity among UI‐eligible families by 5.6% and the severity of food insecurity conditional on being food insecure by 6.3%. We further present strong evidence of program substitution between UI and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), which is the largest food assistance program with the stated goal of reducing food insecurity. Specifically, for every dollar spent on UI, 4–11 cents can be saved on SNAP, thereby reinforcing the social benefits of an UI expansion .
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用1999-2017当前人口调查的粮食安全补充资料，探讨了失业保险（UI）扩大对美国家庭粮食不安全的影响。我们利用各州和不同时间段内各州最大每周失业保险福利的看似合理的外生变化。两部分模型表明，州每周失业保险福利增加100美元，可使符合失业保险资格的家庭出现粮食不安全的可能性降低5.6%，并将以粮食不安全为条件的粮食不安全的严重程度降低6.3%。我们进一步提供了 UI 和补充营养援助计划 (SNAP) 之间计划替代的有力证据，该计划是最大的粮食援助计划，其既定目标是减少粮食不安全。具体来说，每在失业保险上花费一美元，就可以在 SNAP 上节省 4-11 美分，从而增强失业保险扩展的社会效益。

records.title_en: Assessing the affordability of nutrient‐adequate diets
records.title_cn: 评估营养充足饮食的可负担性
records.abstract_en: The cost and affordability of least‐cost healthy diets by time and place are increasingly used as a proxy for access to nutrient‐adequate diets. Recent work has focused on the nutrient requirements of individuals, although most food and antipoverty programs target whole households. This raises the question of how the cost of a nutrient‐adequate diet can be measured for an entire household. This study identifies upper and lower bounds on the feasibility, cost, and affordability of meeting all household members' nutrient requirements using 2013–2017 survey data from Malawi. Findings show only a minority of households can afford the nutrient‐adequate diet at either bound, with 20% of households able to afford the (upper bound) shared diets and 38% the individualized (lower bound) diets. Individualized diets are more frequently feasible with locally available foods (90% vs. 60% of the time) and exhibit more moderate seasonal fluctuation. To meet all members' needs, a shared diet requires a more nutrient‐dense combination of foods that is more costly and exhibits more seasonality in diet cost than any one food group or the individualized diets. The findings further help adjudicate the extent to which nutritional behavioral change programs versus broader agricultural and food policies can be relied upon to improve individual access to healthy diets.
records.abstract_cn: 按时间和地点计算的最低成本健康饮食的成本和可负担性，越来越被用作获取营养充足饮食的代理指标。近期研究聚焦于个体的营养需求，尽管大多数食品和反贫困项目针对的是整个家庭。这提出了一个问题：如何衡量整个家庭的营养充足饮食成本。本研究利用马拉维2013-2017年的调查数据，确定了满足所有家庭成员营养需求的可行性、成本和可负担性的上下界。研究发现，只有少数家庭能够负担得起任一界限下的营养充足饮食，其中20%的家庭能够负担得起（上界）共享饮食，38%的家庭能够负担得起个体化（下界）饮食。个体化饮食在本地可得食品中更常可行（90%对60%的时间），并且表现出更温和的季节性波动。为满足所有成员的需求，共享饮食需要更营养密集的食物组合，其成本更高，且饮食成本的季节性比任何单一食物组或个体化饮食都更明显。这些发现进一步有助于评判营养行为改变项目与更广泛的农业和食品政策在多大程度上可被依赖以改善个体获取健康饮食的机会。

records.title_en: Was the trip worth it? Consistency between decision and experienced utility assessments of recreational nature visits
records.title_cn: 这次旅行值得吗？休闲自然访问的决策效用与体验效用评估之间的一致性
records.abstract_en: This paper assesses the relationship between decision utility and experienced utility of recreational nature visits. The former is measured as the travel cost to reach that site as routinely used by the travel cost method (TCM), and the latter is operationalized through visit‐related subjective well‐being (SWB). As such, the analysis is a test of convergent validity by examining whether ex ante TCM‐based assessment of recreational value reflecting decision utility corresponds to stated ex post SWB, reflecting experienced utility. It explores to what extent utility revealed by counts of nature visits are associated with self‐reported, visit‐related SWB relating to that same visited site. The analysis uses two existing datasets providing information on (i) 3672 recreational visits to green/blue spaces in England over the course of four years and (ii) 5937 recreational visits to bluespace sites across 14 European countries over one year. Results show a positive association between travel cost and visit‐related SWB while controlling for trip frequency and a large set of covariates, suggesting convergent validity of the two utility concepts. A breakdown by travel mode suggests this relationship only holds for trips involving motorized transport and is not present for habitual, chore‐like walking visits to the recreational site.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了休闲自然访问的决策效用与体验效用之间的关系。前者通过旅行成本法（TCM）常规使用的到达该地点的旅行成本来衡量，后者则通过访问相关的主观幸福感（SWB）来操作化。因此，该分析是对收敛效度的检验，通过考察基于TCM的事前休闲价值评估（反映决策效用）是否与陈述的事后SWB（反映体验效用）相对应。它探讨了由自然访问次数揭示的效用在多大程度上与自我报告的、与访问地点相关的SWB相关联。分析使用了两个现有数据集，分别提供（i）英格兰四年间3672次对绿色/蓝色空间的休闲访问信息，以及（ii）14个欧洲国家一年内5937次对蓝色空间地点的休闲访问信息。结果表明，在控制访问频率和大量协变量的情况下，旅行成本与访问相关SWB之间存在正相关关系，表明这两种效用概念具有收敛效度。按出行方式细分表明，这种关系仅适用于涉及机动化交通的出行，而对于习惯性的、像家务活一样的步行访问休闲地点的情况则不存在。

records.title_en: Incorporating historical weather information in crop insurance rating
records.title_cn: 在农作物保险定价中纳入历史天气信息
records.abstract_en: Crop insurance programs rely on conditional predictive distributions of loss random variables (e.g., yield, revenue, loss costs, etc.) to determine probabilities and magnitudes of loss. The loss variables may be related to stochastic variables that are not known at the time the policy is priced. Such is the case for weather; weather is stochastic, realizations are not known when the crop insurance policy is sold, and there is often additional historical information on weather relative to the loss variable itself. We provide a Bayesian methodology for incorporating historical weather information in crop insurance rating. We apply the method in empirical applications to county‐level U.S. corn yields and loss cost ratios in the Midwest. The historical weather‐conditioned distributions differ from those based on shorter samples. In the yield distribution setting, additional temporal weather information leads to economic gains relative to other rating approaches; the magnitude of these gains increases with the amount of historical weather information included in the analysis.
