records.abstract_cn: 农作物保险计划依赖于损失随机变量（如产量、收入、损失成本等）的条件预测分布来确定损失的概率和幅度。损失变量可能与保单定价时未知的随机变量相关。天气就是这种情况；天气是随机的，农作物保险单出售时实现值未知，而且相对于损失变量本身，通常有额外的历史天气信息。我们提供了一种贝叶斯方法，用于在农作物保险定价中纳入历史天气信息。我们在美国中西部县级玉米产量和损失成本比率的实证应用中应用了该方法。基于历史天气条件的分布与基于较短样本的分布不同。在产量分布设定中，额外的时序天气信息相对于其他定价方法带来了经济收益；这些收益的幅度随着分析中包含的历史天气信息量的增加而增加。

records.title_en: The impacts of tropical storms on food prices: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 热带风暴对食品价格的影响：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Climate change is a major source of external shocks to the economy. In this article, we estimate the short‐term impacts of tropical storms on food prices. After matching the track records of tropical storms with retail prices of food products during 1998 and 2012 in China, we find that tropical storms lead to food prices increasing by 2.3%, and the effect lasts more than one month. The positive impacts on prices mainly concentrate on fresh vegetable products. One main channel of price increases caused by tropical storms is the supply‐side shock to the transportation and distribution system. We find limited evidence of price increases driven by demand‐side shocks such as food displacement and food composition changes. The impacts of tropical storms on food price increases lead to a total loss amounting to $92 million each year on average. This study contributes to literature evaluating the price impacts caused by tropical storms and provides policy implications on enhancing food supply resilience.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化是经济外部冲击的主要来源。在本文中，我们估计了热带风暴对食品价格的短期影响。将1998年至2012年间中国的热带风暴路径记录与食品零售价格匹配后，我们发现热带风暴导致食品价格上涨2.3%，且该效应持续超过一个月。价格的正向影响主要集中在新鲜蔬菜产品上。热带风暴导致价格上涨的一个主要渠道是运输和分销系统的供给侧冲击。我们发现的证据有限，表明需求侧冲击（如食品转移和食品构成变化）驱动价格上涨。热带风暴对食品价格上涨的影响导致年均总损失达92万美元。本研究为评估热带风暴引起的价格影响的文献做出了贡献，并为增强食品供应韧性提供了政策启示。

records.title_en: Economic impacts of food safety incidents in a modern supply chain: E. coli in the romaine lettuce industry
records.title_cn: 现代供应链中食品安全事件的经济影响：长叶生菜行业中的大肠杆菌事件
records.abstract_en: Food‐safety incidents disrupt impacted markets, cause destruction of edible product, shake consumer confidence, and impose economic losses upon participants across the implicated supply chain. Despite the prevalence of such incidents, we know surprisingly little about their supply chain impacts, especially in modern produce markets where contracts may impede the diffusion of price impacts through the supply chain. The November 2018 E. coli incident for romaine lettuce in Central California roiled North American produce markets throughout the fall of 2018 and well into 2019. Our study of the economic impacts of this incident benefited from access to disaggregate information on prices and sales for romaine and substitute leafy greens at all stages of the supply chain, enabling us to overcome data limitations that have impeded prior studies. We decompose impacts from the incident into price and quantity components. Romaine growers were largely protected from damage due to fixed‐price provisions in grower‐processor contracts. Economic losses were incurred mostly by romaine shippers and processors, and grocery retailers who pulled saleable product from the supply chain and lost sales during and well after the incident due to reduced consumer demand. We estimate that the total societal loss from the incident was in the range of $276–$343 million. Widespread and long‐lasting impacts from a food‐safety incident demonstrate the economic benefit of industries adopting mandatory food‐safety standards and improved traceability to minimize the occurrence and impacts of such incidents.
records.abstract_cn: 食品安全事件扰乱受影响市场，导致可食用产品被销毁，动摇消费者信心，并给相关供应链上的参与者带来经济损失。尽管此类事件频发，但我们对它们在供应链中的影响知之甚少，尤其是在现代农产品市场中，合同可能阻碍价格影响在供应链中的传导。2018年十一月发生在加利福尼亚中部长叶生菜上的大肠杆菌事件，在2018年秋季乃至2019年全年扰乱了北美农产品市场。我们对该事件经济影响的研究得益于获取了供应链各阶段长叶生菜及替代叶菜的价格和销售的细分信息，从而克服了以往研究受数据限制的障碍。我们将事件的影响分解为价格和数量两部分。由于种植者与加工商合同中固定价格条款的规定，长叶生菜种植者基本免受损害。经济损失主要由长叶生菜托运商和加工商承担，以及那些在事件期间及之后因消费者需求减少而将可销售产品撤出供应链并遭受销售损失的杂货零售商。我们估计，该事件造成的总社会损失在276亿至343亿美元之间。食品安全事件广泛而持久的影响表明，行业采用强制性食品安全标准和改进可追溯性以尽量减少此类事件的发生和影响，具有经济上的益处。

records.title_en: The Achilles heel of the U.S. food industries: Exposure to labor and upstream industries in the supply chain
records.title_cn: 美国食品工业的致命弱点：供应链中劳动力和上游行业的暴露度
records.abstract_en: The modern‐day food industries are part of a complex agri‐food supply chain, where food production has become efficient yet potentially vulnerable to supply chain risks. The COVID‐19 pandemic is a testament to that end. This article measures and identifies the U.S. food manufacturing industries' vulnerability to upstream industries and labor occupations by ( a ) calculating a food industry's diversification of intermediate input purchases across upstream industries, ( b ) quantifying the relative exposure of food manufacturing in a given industry and location to upstream input suppliers and labor occupations, and ( c ) estimating each food industry's gross output elasticity of inputs. This article also explores geographic heterogeneity in food industries' vulnerability. Among our results, we find evidence that the animal processing industry's output is relatively vulnerable to production labor, consistent with the observed disruptions to the meatpacking sector during COVID‐19, which were largely caused by labor issues. Our results may help academics and practitioners to understand food industries' vulnerabilities to upstream industries and labor occupations.
records.abstract_cn: 现代食品工业是复杂农业食品供应链的一部分，食品生产已变得高效，但可能面临供应链风险。COVID-19疫情便是明证。本文通过以下方式衡量和识别美国食品制造业对上游行业和劳动力职业的脆弱性：（a）计算食品行业在上游行业中的中间投入品购买多样化程度，（b）量化特定行业和地点的食品制造业对上游投入供应商和劳动力职业的相对暴露度，以及（c）估算每个食品行业的总产出投入弹性。本文还探讨了食品行业脆弱性的地理异质性。在我们的结果中，我们发现动物加工业的产出相对容易受到生产劳动力的影响，这与COVID-19疫情期间肉类加工部门观察到的中断一致，这些中断主要由劳动力问题引起。我们的结果可能有助于学者和从业者理解食品行业对上游行业和劳动力职业的脆弱性。

records.title_en: Farm labor supply and fruit and vegetable production
records.title_cn: 农业劳动力供给与果蔬生产
records.abstract_en: This study provides econometric estimates of the effects of reductions in farm labor supply on the production of hand‐harvested fruits and vegetables. Using crop production and employment data from California counties, we estimate panel regressions linking farm employment to crop production outcomes. Because we exploit variation in equilibrium employment, as opposed to exogenous variation in the labor supply curve, we use an equilibrium displacement model to identify the most likely sources of estimation bias and conclude that our regression estimates should be interpreted as upper bounds for the effect of interest. Our results indicate that a 10% decrease in the farm labor supply (in terms of the number of workers) causes at most a 4.2% reduction in production in the top 10 fruit and vegetable producing counties. Production effects are channeled primarily through a reduction in harvested acreage, although we also uncover some effects on yield.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究提供了关于农业劳动力供给减少对手工采摘果蔬生产影响的计量经济学估计。利用加利福尼亚各县的作物生产和就业数据，我们估计了将农业就业与作物生产结果联系起来的面板回归。由于我们利用的是均衡就业的变化，而非劳动力供给曲线的外生变化，我们使用均衡位移模型来识别最可能的估计偏差来源，并得出结论，我们的回归估计应被解释为所关注效应的上界。我们的结果表明，农业劳动力供给（以工人数量计）减少10%最多导致前10个果蔬生产县的生产减少4.2%。生产效应主要通过收获面积的减少来传导，尽管我们也发现了一些对单产的影响。

records.title_en: Trade uncorked: Genetic distance and taste‐related barriers in wine trade
records.title_cn: 贸易开瓶：基因距离与葡萄酒贸易中的口味相关壁垒
records.abstract_en: A nascent literature explores the impact of taste differences on trade. In gravity model estimations, the coefficient on geographic distance is large because it tends to capture such (usually unobservable) preference‐related frictions. We examine this question in the context of French wine, that is, a cultural good characterized by a great variety of types (i.e. accommodating a large heterogeneity in wine tastes) and of quality levels (from cheap table wine to the finest grands crus ). A series of gravity models are estimated using the universe of French bottled wine exports by detailed appellation between 1998 and 2015. We use genetic distance as a proxy for taste differences inherited from biology and culture. We show that this interpretation is not ruled out by other possible roles of genetic distance on trade (i.e., microgeography or non‐gustatory cultural dimensions such as trust). We find that genetic distance has an independent effect on trade, explaining between 20% and 40% of the coefficient on geographic distance. Dynamic estimates confirm this result and establish both the persistent and contemporaneous effects of genetic differences. A heterogeneous analysis also corroborates previous findings in the literature showing that high‐tier goods tend to escape gravity. In addition, we find that premium wines escape the home bias associated with taste differences, possibly illustrating that luxury wines have become global iconic products purchased for status and investment motives rather than for gustatory pleasure.
records.abstract_cn: 一个新兴的文献探讨了口味差异对贸易的影响。在引力模型估计中，地理距离的系数很大，因为它往往捕捉了这类（通常不可观测的）与偏好相关的摩擦。我们在法国葡萄酒的背景下研究这个问题，即一种以类型多样（即容纳葡萄酒口味的巨大异质性）和质量等级（从廉价餐酒到最顶级的特级园）为特征的文化产品。我们使用1998年至2015年间法国瓶装葡萄酒按详细产区划分的全部出口数据，估计了一系列引力模型。我们使用基因距离作为从生物学和文化中继承的口味差异的代理变量。我们表明，这种解释并未被基因距离对贸易的其他可能作用（即微观地理或非味觉的文化维度，如信任）所排除。我们发现基因距离对贸易有独立影响，解释了地理距离系数的20%至40%。动态估计证实了这一结果，并确立了基因差异的持续性和同期效应。异质性分析也证实了文献中的先前发现，表明高端商品往往逃脱引力效应。此外，我们发现优质葡萄酒逃脱了与口味差异相关的本土偏好，这可能说明奢侈葡萄酒已成为全球标志性产品，购买动机是地位和投资，而非味觉享受。

records.title_en: Housing booms and H‐2A agricultural guest worker employment
records.title_cn: 住房繁荣与H-2A农业客工就业
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of changes in housing demand on H‐2A employment within commuting zones from 2001 to 2017. Agricultural employers who demonstrate that no workers in the domestic labor market are willing or able to perform a seasonal or temporary farm job can apply for certification to hire guest workers through the H‐2A visa program. H‐2A employment grew more than 450% between 2001 and 2019 from 45,000 to 258,000. This is one of the first papers to econometrically examine causal factors that contributed to the growth of H‐2A employment. We find that a 1% increase in housing demand leads to a 0.40%–0.97% increase in H‐2A employment. We also show suggestive evidence that changes in housing demand affect H‐2A employment through shifts in the demand for workers in nonfarm industries that pull workers from the agricultural sector. Consistent with previous literature, we show that positive housing demand shocks lead to increased employment in construction and other nontradable sectors that traditionally hire immigrant workers. We also find positive effects of housing demand on local farm wages, consistent with an inward shift in the local farm labor supply during housing booms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了2001年至2017年间通勤区内住房需求变化对H-2A就业的影响。农业雇主若能证明国内劳动力市场上没有工人愿意或能够从事季节性临时农业工作，即可申请通过H-2A签证计划认证雇佣客工。H-2A就业在2001年至2019年间增长了超过450%，从45,000人增至258,000人。本文是首批运用计量经济学方法研究H-2A就业增长因果因素的论文之一。我们发现住房需求每增加1%，H-2A就业增加0.40%至0.97%。我们还提供了提示性证据，表明住房需求变化通过非农行业对工人的需求变化影响H-2A就业，这些非农行业从农业部门吸引工人。与以往文献一致，我们表明正向住房需求冲击导致建筑业和其他传统上雇佣移民工人的非贸易部门就业增加。我们还发现住房需求对当地农业工资有正向影响，这与住房繁荣期间当地农业劳动力供给向内转移一致。

records.title_en: Environmental Preferences and Technological Choices: Is Market Competition Clean or Dirty?
records.title_cn: 环境偏好与技术选择：市场竞争是清洁的还是肮脏的？
records.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of consumers’ environmental concerns and market competition on firms’ decisions to innovate in “clean” technologies. Agents care about their consumption and environmental footprint; firms pursue greener products to soften price competition. Acting as complements, these forces determine R&D, pollution, and welfare. We test the theory using panel data on patents by 7,060 automobile sector firms in 25 countries, environmental willingness to pay, and competition. As predicted, exposure to prosocial attitudes fosters clean innovation, all the more so where competition is strong. Plausible increases in both together can spur it as much as a large fuel price increase. (JEL D22, L62, O31, O34, Q52, Q53, Q54)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了消费者的环境关注和市场竞争对企业创新“清洁”技术决策的影响。行为主体关心其消费和环境足迹；企业追求更环保的产品以缓和价格竞争。这些力量作为互补因素，决定了研发、污染和福利。我们使用来自25个国家7,060家汽车行业企业的专利面板数据、环境支付意愿和竞争来检验该理论。正如预测的那样，亲社会态度的暴露促进了清洁创新，在竞争激烈的地方更是如此。两者同时合理增加可以像大幅提高燃油价格一样刺激清洁创新。(JEL D22, L62, O31, O34, Q52, Q53, Q54)

records.title_en: Isolating Personal Knowledge Spillovers: Coinventor Deaths and Spatial Citation Differentials
records.title_cn: 隔离个人知识溢出：共同发明人死亡与空间引文差异
records.abstract_en: We propose a new method to estimate and isolate the localization of knowledge spillovers due to the physical presence of a person, using after-application but pre-grant deaths of differently located coinventors of the same patent. The approach estimates the differences in local citations between the deceased and still-living inventors at increasingly distant radii. Patents receive 26 percent fewer citations from within a radius of 20 miles around the deceased, relative to still-living coinventors. Differences attenuate with time and distance, are stronger when still-living coinventors live farther from the deceased, and hold for a subsample of possibly premature deaths. (JEL O31, O33, O34, R32)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新方法，用于估计和隔离因个人实际存在而产生的知识溢出本地化效应，该方法利用同一专利的不同地理位置共同发明人在申请后但授权前的死亡案例。该估计方法比较了在逐渐增大的距离半径内，已故与仍在世的发明人获得的本地引文差异。与仍在世的共同发明人相比，专利在已故发明人周围20英里半径内获得的引文减少了26%。这种差异随时间与距离而减弱，当仍在世的共同发明人居住地离已故者更远时差异更强，并且在可能过早死亡的子样本中依然成立。(JEL O31, O33, O34, R32)

records.title_en: Proximity to the Frontier, Markups, and the Response of Innovation to Foreign Competition: Evidence from Matched Production-Innovation Surveys in Chile
records.title_cn: 接近前沿、加成率与创新对外国竞争的反应：来自智利匹配的生产-创新调查的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper employs a matched firm production-innovation panel dataset from Chile to explore the response of firm innovation to the increased competition arising from the China shock. The data cover a wider range of innovation inputs and outputs than previously possible and allow generating measures of markups and efficiency (TFPQ) that correspond closely to the concepts of rents and technological leadership envisaged in the Schumpeterian literature. Except for the 10 percent most productive plants that see an increase in quality, increased competition depresses most measures of innovation. These differences are exacerbated when interacted with plant-level movements in rents. (JEL D24, L25, L60, O14, O19, O31, O34)
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用智利匹配的企业生产-创新面板数据集，探讨企业创新对中国冲击带来的竞争加剧的反应。数据涵盖的创新投入和产出范围比以往更广，并能够生成与熊彼特文献中设想的租金和技术领先概念密切对应的加成率和效率（TFPQ）度量。除了生产率最高的10%工厂的质量有所提高外，竞争加剧抑制了大多数创新指标。当与工厂层面的租金变动交互时，这些差异更加显著。（JEL D24, L25, L60, O14, O19, O31, O34）

records.title_en: Macroeconomic Dynamics with Rigid Wage Contracts
records.title_cn: 刚性工资合同下的宏观经济动态
records.abstract_en: We adapt the wage contracting structure in Chari (1983) to a dynamic, balanced-growth setting with recontracting as in Calvo (1983). The resulting wage-rigidity framework dampens income effects in the short run, thus allowing significant responses of hours to aggregate shocks. In reduced form, the model dynamics are similar to that in Jaimovich and Rebelo (2009), with their habit parameter replaced by our probability of wage-contract resetting. That is, if wage contracts are reset frequently, labor supply behaves in accordance with King, Plosser, and Rebelo (1988) preferences, whereas if they are never reset, we obtain the setting in Greenwood, Hercowitz, and Huffman (1988). (JEL E24, J22, J23, J24, J31, J41)
records.abstract_cn: 我们将Chari（1983）中的工资合同结构适应到具有Calvo（1983）式重新签约的动态平衡增长环境中。由此产生的工资刚性框架在短期内抑制了收入效应，从而使工作时间对总冲击产生显著反应。在简化形式下，模型动态类似于Jaimovich和Rebelo（2009）中的情况，其习惯参数被我们的工资合同重置概率所替代。也就是说，如果工资合同频繁重置，劳动供给行为符合King、Plosser和Rebelo（1988）的偏好；而如果从不重置，则得到Greenwood、Hercowitz和Huffman（1988）中的设定。（JEL E24, J22, J23, J24, J31, J41）

records.title_en: Understanding the Ownership Structure of Corporate Bonds
records.title_cn: 理解公司债券的所有权结构
records.abstract_en: Insurers are the largest institutional investors of corporate bonds. However, a standard theory of insurance markets, in which insurers maximize firm value subject to regulatory or risk constraints, predicts no allocation to corporate bonds. We resolve this puzzle in an equilibrium asset pricing model with leverage-constrained households and institutional investors. Insurers have relatively cheap access to leverage through their underwriting activity. They hold a leveraged portfolio of low-beta assets in equilibrium, relaxing other investors’ leverage constraints. The model explains recent empirical findings on insurers’ portfolio choice and its impact on asset prices. (JEL G11, G12, G22, G23)
records.abstract_cn: 保险公司是公司债券最大的机构投资者。然而，一个标准的保险市场理论，即保险公司在监管或风险约束下最大化公司价值，预测其不会配置公司债券。我们在一个具有杠杆约束的家庭和机构投资者的均衡资产定价模型中解决了这个难题。保险公司通过其承保活动获得相对便宜的杠杆。在均衡中，他们持有低贝塔资产的杠杆组合，从而放松了其他投资者的杠杆约束。该模型解释了近期关于保险公司投资组合选择及其对资产价格影响的实证发现。（JEL G11, G12, G22, G23）

records.title_en: Intergenerational Persistence in Child Mortality
records.title_cn: 儿童死亡率的代际持续性
records.abstract_en: We study the intergenerational persistence of inequality by estimating grandmother-mother associations in the loss of a child, using pooled data from 119 Demographic and Health Surveys in 44 developing countries. Compared with compatriots of the same age, women with at least one sibling who died in childhood face 39 percent higher odds of having experienced at least one own-child death, or 7 percentage points at age 49. Place fixed effects reduce estimated mortality persistence by 47 percent; socioeconomic covariates explain far less. Within countries over time, persistence falls with aggregate child mortality, so that mortality decline disproportionately benefits high-mortality lineages. (JEL I12, J13, J16, J62, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过使用来自44个发展中国家的119项人口与健康调查的合并数据，估计祖母-母亲在子女死亡方面的关联，研究不平等的代际持续性。与同龄同胞相比，至少有一名兄弟姐妹在童年时期死亡的女性，其经历过至少一名亲生子女死亡的概率高出39%，即在49岁时高出7个百分点。地点固定效应将估计的死亡率持续性降低了47%；社会经济协变量解释的差异要少得多。在国家内部随时间推移，持续性随总体儿童死亡率下降而降低，因此死亡率的下降不成比例地惠及高死亡率谱系。(JEL I12, J13, J16, J62, O15)

records.title_en: Robust Information Transmission
records.title_cn: 稳健信息传递
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates robust information transmission between a sender and a receiver in the Crawford and Sobel (1982) model. We characterize behavior that remains equilibrium behavior independently of the form of a small communication cost. Under standard conditions, we find that an equilibrium outcome is robust if and only if it features a maximal number of on-path actions and each is induced by a single message. The result extends regardless of the direction of the bias, the number of available messages, or whether the objectives of the sender and the receiver are aligned. (JEL D82, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了Crawford和Sobel（1982）模型中发送者与接收者之间的稳健信息传递。我们刻画了在小额沟通成本的形式下仍保持均衡行为的行为特征。在标准条件下，我们发现一个均衡结果具有稳健性当且仅当它包含最大数量的路径行动，且每个行动由单一信息诱导。该结果无论偏差方向、可用信息数量或发送者与接收者目标是否一致均成立。（JEL D82, D83）

records.title_en: Cognitive Decline, Limited Awareness, Imperfect Agency, and Financial Well-Being
records.title_cn: 认知衰退、有限意识、不完全代理与财务福祉
records.abstract_en: Cognitive decline may lead older Americans to make poor financial decisions. Preventing poor decisions may require timely transfer of financial control to a reliable agent. Cognitive decline, however, can develop unnoticed, creating the possibility of suboptimal timing of the transfer of control. This paper presents survey-based evidence that older Americans with significant wealth regard suboptimal timing of the transfer of control, in particular delay due to unnoticed cognitive decline, as a substantial risk to financial well-being. This paper provides a theoretical framework to model such a lack of awareness and the resulting welfare loss. (JEL G51, G53, H55, J14, J26, J32)
records.abstract_cn: 认知衰退可能导致美国老年人做出糟糕的财务决策。防止糟糕决策可能需要及时将财务控制权转移给可靠的代理人。然而，认知衰退可能在不知不觉中发展，从而产生控制权转移时机次优的可能性。本文提供的基于调查的证据表明，拥有大量财富的美国老年人将控制权转移的次优时机，特别是因未察觉的认知衰退而导致的延迟，视为对财务福祉的重大风险。本文提供了一个理论框架来模拟这种缺乏意识及其导致的福利损失。（JEL G51, G53, H55, J14, J26, J32）

records.title_en: The Agglomeration of Urban Amenities: Evidence from Milan Restaurants
records.title_cn: 城市便利设施的集聚：来自米兰餐厅的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate agglomeration externalities in Milan’s restaurant sector using the abolition of a unique regulation that restricted where restaurants could locate. In 2005, Milan abolished a minimum distance requirement that had kept the number of establishments artificially constant across neighborhoods. We find that after 2005, the geographical concentration of restaurants increased sharply and at an accelerating rate. Consistent with the existence of strong and self-sustaining agglomeration externalities, restaurants agglomerated in some neighborhoods and deserted others, leading to a growing divergence in local amenities across neighborhoods. Restaurants located in neighborhoods that experienced large increases in agglomeration reacted by increasing product differentiation. (JEL D62, L83, L88, R32, R52)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项限制餐厅选址的独特法规的废除，估计了米兰餐饮业的集聚外部性。2005年，米兰废除了最低距离要求，该要求曾使各街区的餐厅数量人为地保持恒定。我们发现，2005年之后，餐厅的地理集中度急剧上升，并以加速的速度上升。与强大且自我维持的集聚外部性的存在相一致，餐厅在某些街区集聚，而在其他街区则被遗弃，导致各街区本地便利设施的差异不断扩大。位于集聚程度大幅增加街区的餐厅，其反应是增加产品差异化。(JEL D62, L83, L88, R32, R52)

records.title_en: Reputation and Partial Default
records.title_cn: 声誉与部分违约
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a continuous-time reputation model of sovereign debt allowing for both varying levels of partial default and full default. In it, a government can be a nonstrategic commitment type or a strategic opportunistic type, and a government’s reputation is its equilibrium Bayesian posterior of being the commitment type. Our equilibrium has that for bond levels reachable by both types without defaulting, bigger partial defaults (or bigger haircuts for bond holders) imply higher interest rates for subsequent bond issuances, as in the data. (JEL D83, E32, E43, G12, H63)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个主权债务的连续时间声誉模型，允许不同程度的部分违约和完全违约。在该模型中，政府可以是非战略性的承诺类型或战略性的机会主义类型，而政府的声誉是其作为承诺类型的均衡贝叶斯后验概率。我们的均衡表明，对于两种类型在不违约情况下均可达到的债券水平，较大的部分违约（或对债券持有人的较大减记）意味着后续债券发行的利率更高，这与数据相符。（JEL D83, E32, E43, G12, H63）

records.title_en: Pandemic Schooling Mode and Student Test Scores: Evidence from US School Districts
records.title_cn: 疫情教学模式与学生考试成绩：来自美国学区的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of district-level schooling mode (in-person versus hybrid or virtual learning) in the 2020–2021 school year on students’ pass rates on standardized tests in grades 3–8 across 11 states. Pass rates declined from 2019 to 2021: an average of 12.8 percentage points in math and 6.8 in English language arts (ELA). Focusing on within-state, within–commuting zone variation in schooling mode, we estimate that districts with full in-person learning had significantly smaller declines (13.4 pp in math, 8.3 in ELA). The value to in-person learning was larger for districts with larger populations of Black students. (JEL H75, I12, I18, I21, I28, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了2020-2021学年学区层面的教学模式（线下教学与混合或线上学习）对11个州3-8年级学生标准化考试通过率的影响。从2019年到2021年，通过率有所下降：数学平均下降12.8个百分点，英语语言艺术（ELA）平均下降6.8个百分点。聚焦于州内和通勤区内的教学模式差异，我们估计，完全线下教学的学区的下降幅度显著更小（数学下降13.4个百分点，ELA下降8.3个百分点）。对于黑人学生比例较大的学区，线下教学的价值更大。（JEL H75, I12, I18, I21, I28, J15）

records.title_en: Status Quo Property Protection in Politico-Legal Systems
records.title_cn: 政治法律体系中的现状财产保护
records.abstract_en: This paper models status quo (SQ) protection of property rights. A politico-legal system determines eligibility of citizen groups for protection. A ruling authority can reallocate property if and only if reallocation is preferable to the status quo for one such group. Along the solution path, SQ protections distort allocations across different assets and different property owners. Asset distortions vanish in the limit as the path converges to a stationary assignment. Ownership distortions vanish in the limit if no individuals belong to every eligible group. If the authority is self-interested, systemic protection of vulnerable groups may be welfare improving. (JEL D72, H13, K11, P14)
records.abstract_cn: 本文对财产权的现状（SQ）保护进行建模。政治法律体系决定公民群体获得保护的资格。当且仅当重新分配对某一此类群体而言优于现状时，统治当局才能重新分配财产。沿着解路径，SQ保护会扭曲不同资产和不同财产所有者之间的配置。当路径收敛至平稳分配时，资产扭曲在极限中消失。如果没有任何个体属于所有合格群体，则所有权扭曲在极限中消失。如果当局是自利的，对弱势群体的系统性保护可能改善福利。（JEL D72, H13, K11, P14）

records.title_en: Technical Change and Superstar Effects: Evidence from the Rollout of Television
records.title_cn: 技术变革与超级明星效应：来自电视推广的证据
records.abstract_en: Technical change that extends market scale can generate winner-take-all dynamics, with large income growth among top earners. I test this “superstar model” in the entertainer labor market, where the historic rollout of television creates a natural experiment in scale-related technological change. The resulting inequality changes are consistent with superstar theory: the launch of a local TV station skews the entertainer wage distribution sharply to the right, with the biggest impact at the very top of the distribution, while negatively impacting workers below the star level. The findings provide evidence of superstar effects and distinguish such effects from popular alternative models. (JEL D31, J31, J44, L82, L88, O33)
records.abstract_cn: 扩大市场规模的技术变革可以产生赢家通吃的动态，顶尖收入者的收入大幅增长。我在演艺人员劳动力市场中检验了这一“超级明星模型”，其中电视的历史推广创造了与规模相关的技术变革的自然实验。由此产生的收入不平等变化与超级明星理论一致：地方电视台的开播使演艺人员的工资分布急剧右偏，对分布最顶端的影响最大，同时对明星水平以下的工人产生负面影响。这些发现提供了超级明星效应的证据，并将此类效应与流行的替代模型区分开来。(JEL D31, J31, J44, L82, L88, O33)

records.title_en: National and Global Impacts of Genetically Modified Crops
records.title_cn: 转基因作物的国家与全球影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of genetically modified (GM) crops on countrywide yields, harvested area, and trade using a triple-differences rollout design that exploits variation in the availability of GM seeds across crops, countries, and time. We find positive impacts on yields, especially in poor countries. Our estimates imply that without GM crops, the world would have needed 3.4 percent additional cropland to keep global agricultural output at its 2019 level. We also find that bans on GM cultivation have limited the global gain from GM adoption to one-third of its potential. Poor countries would benefit most from lifting such bans. (JEL O13, Q15, Q16, Q17, Q18)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用三重差分推广设计，通过作物、国家和时间上转基因种子可用性的变化，估计了转基因作物对国家产量、收获面积和贸易的影响。我们发现转基因作物对产量有积极影响，尤其是在贫穷国家。我们的估计表明，如果没有转基因作物，世界将需要额外3.4%的耕地来维持2019年的全球农业产出水平。我们还发现，转基因种植禁令将全球从转基因采用中获得的收益限制在了其潜力的三分之一。贫穷国家将从解除此类禁令中获益最多。（JEL O13, Q15, Q16, Q17, Q18）

records.title_en: A Note on Temporary Supply Shocks with Aggregate Demand Inertia
records.title_cn: 关于具有总需求惯性的暂时性供给冲击的注记
records.abstract_en: We study optimal monetary policy during temporary supply contractions when aggregate demand has inertia and the central bank is concerned about future constraints on expansionary policy. In this environment, it is optimal to run the economy hot until supply recovers. However, the policy does not remain loose throughout the low-supply phase. Overall, when the initial aggregate demand is low, the goal is to frontload the rate cuts to raise demand in anticipation of the recovery of supply. If inflation also has inertia, the central bank still overheats the economy during the low-supply phase but gradually cools it down over time. (JEL E12, E21, E23, E31, E43, E52)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在总需求具有惯性且中央银行担忧未来扩张性政策受限的情况下，暂时性供给收缩期间的最优货币政策。在这种环境下，最优政策是让经济过热运行直至供给恢复。然而，政策在整个低供给阶段并非始终保持宽松。总体而言，当初始总需求较低时，目标是提前降息以提高需求，为供给恢复做准备。如果通胀也具有惯性，中央银行在低供给阶段仍会使经济过热，但会随时间逐渐降温。（JEL E12, E21, E23, E31, E43, E52）

records.title_en: Should We Tax Capital Income or Wealth?
records.title_cn: 我们应该对资本收入还是财富征税？
records.abstract_en: We study optimal capital income and wealth taxation in an economy that reproduces the importance of private businesses for output and inequality. If entrepreneurs are subject to collateral constraints, they face heterogeneous rates of return, which generate a meaningful distinction between capital income and wealth taxation. We find that taxing capital income is preferable to taxing wealth because the efficiency gains from wealth taxation are swamped by the redistributional benefits of taxing the profits of richer entrepreneurs. Consequently, the gains from taxing wealth are modest. This conclusion is robust to the planner’s preference for redistribution and allowing for nonlinear taxes. (JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, H25, K34, L26)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个再现私人企业对产出和不平等重要性的经济中的最优资本收入和财富税。如果企业家面临抵押品约束，他们面临不同的回报率，这产生了资本收入税和财富税之间的有意义区别。我们发现，对资本收入征税优于对财富征税，因为财富税的效率收益被对更富有的企业家的利润征税的再分配收益所淹没。因此，财富税的收益是适度的。这一结论对规划者的再分配偏好和允许非线性税收是稳健的。（JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, H25, K34, L26）

records.title_en: Influence Motives in Social Signaling: Evidence from COVID-19 Vaccinations in Germany
records.title_cn: 社会信号中的影响动机：来自德国COVID-19疫苗接种的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate whether a desire to influence others’ choices affects our own behavior. To separate such influence motives from social pressure, we study participants’ willingness to register for a COVID-19 vaccination in a field experiment in Germany. We vary whether participants’ registration decisions are shared with a peer, to activate social pressure, and whether peers are informed before their own decision, to isolate influence motives. We find that influence motives double participants’ registration likelihood, an effect driven by individuals with ex ante trust in the vaccine. Despite anticipating to influence their peers, participants cannot alter peer behavior in the experiment. (JEL C93, D12, D82, D91, I12, I18)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究影响他人选择的愿望是否会影响我们自己的行为。为了将这种影响动机与社会压力区分开来，我们在德国的一项实地实验中研究了参与者注册COVID-19疫苗接种的意愿。我们变化参与者的注册决定是否与同伴分享，以激活社会压力，以及同伴是否在参与者自己决定之前被告知，以隔离影响动机。我们发现影响动机使参与者的注册可能性翻倍，这一效应由事前信任疫苗的个体驱动。尽管参与者预期会影响同伴，但在实验中他们无法改变同伴的行为。(JEL C93, D12, D82, D91, I12, I18)

records.title_en: Estimating the Optimal Inflation Target from Trends in Relative Prices
records.title_cn: 从相对价格趋势估计最优通胀目标
records.abstract_en: We derive closed-form expressions for the optimal inflation target under Calvo and menu-cost frictions in a model featuring a product life cycle and multiple sources of heterogeneity across goods. We show that both frictions deliver the same optimal target and how it can be estimated from observed trends in relative prices. Using micro price data underlying the CPI in the United Kingdom, we document that relative prices fall over the product lifetime in most expenditure items. This causes the optimal inflation target to be positive, with our baseline estimate for the United Kingdom being equal to 2.6 percent in 2016. The optimal target has steadily increased over the prior two decades due to an acceleration in the rates of relative price decline over time. (JEL C51, D15, E31, L11)
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有产品生命周期和商品间多种异质性来源的模型中，推导了Calvo摩擦和菜单成本摩擦下最优通胀目标的闭式表达式。我们表明，这两种摩擦产生相同的最优目标，并说明如何从观察到的相对价格趋势中估计该目标。利用英国CPI背后的微观价格数据，我们记录了大多数支出项目中相对价格在产品生命周期内下降的情况。这导致最优通胀目标为正，我们对英国的基线估计在2016年等于2.6%。由于相对价格下降率随时间加速，最优目标在过去二十年中稳步上升。(JEL C51, D15, E31, L11)

records.title_en: Measuring the Cost of Living in Mexico and the United States
records.title_cn: 衡量墨西哥和美国的生活成本
records.abstract_en: We use a dataset with prices and spending on consumer packaged goods matched at the bar code level across the United States and Mexico to measure the price index in Mexico relative to the United States. Mexican prices relative to the United States are 23 percent lower compared to the International Comparisons Project’s (ICP) price index. We decompose the 23 percent gap into the biases from imputation, sampling, quality, and variety. Quality bias increases Mexican prices by 48 percent. Imputation, sampling, and variety bias lowers Mexican prices by 11 percent, 13 percent, and 33 percent, respectively. (JEL C43, E31, I31, O11, O12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个在条形码级别上匹配美国和墨西哥的消费品价格和支出数据集，来衡量墨西哥相对于美国的价格指数。与国际比较项目（ICP）的价格指数相比，墨西哥相对于美国的价格低23%。我们将这23%的差距分解为插补、抽样、质量和品种的偏差。质量偏差使墨西哥价格提高48%。插补、抽样和品种偏差分别使墨西哥价格降低11%、13%和33%。（JEL C43, E31, I31, O11, O12）

records.title_en: Macroeconomic Implications of Uniform Pricing
records.title_cn: 统一定价的宏观经济影响
records.abstract_en: We compile a new database of grocery prices in Argentina. We find uniform pricing both within and across regions—i.e., prices almost do not vary within the stores of a chain. In line with uniform pricing, prices in stores of chains operating in one region react to changes in regional employment while prices in multiregion chains do not. Using a quantitative regional model with multiregion firms and uniform pricing, we find a one-half smaller elasticity of prices to a regional than an aggregate shock. This result highlights that some caution may be necessary when using regional shocks to estimate aggregate elasticities. (JEL D22, L11, L81, O14, O18, R32)
records.abstract_cn: 我们编制了一个阿根廷杂货价格的新数据库。我们发现，无论是在区域内还是跨区域，价格都是统一的——即，同一连锁店内的价格几乎没有差异。与统一定价一致，在单一区域经营的连锁店的价格会对区域就业变化作出反应，而跨区域连锁店的价格则不会。利用一个包含跨区域企业和统一定价的定量区域模型，我们发现价格对区域冲击的弹性是对总体冲击弹性的一半。这一结果强调，在使用区域冲击来估计总体弹性时可能需要谨慎。(JEL D22, L11, L81, O14, O18, R32)

records.title_en: How Does Consumption Respond to News about Inflation? Field Evidence from a Randomized Control Trial
records.title_cn: 消费如何响应通胀新闻？来自随机对照试验的实地证据
records.abstract_en: We implement a survey of Dutch households in which random subsets of respondents receive information about inflation. The resulting exogenously generated variation in inflation expectations is used to assess how expectations affect consumption decisions. The causal effects of reduced inflation expectations on nondurable spending are imprecisely estimated, but there is a sharp positive effect on durable spending. This is likely driven by the fact that Dutch households seem to become more optimistic about their real income and aggregate spending when they decrease their inflation expectations. We find little role for cognitive or financial constraints in explaining spending responses. (JEL C83, D12, D83, D84, E21, E31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们对荷兰家庭进行了一项调查，其中随机抽取的受访者子集收到有关通胀的信息。由此产生的外生性通胀预期变化被用来评估预期如何影响消费决策。降低通胀预期对非耐用品支出的因果效应估计不精确，但对耐用品支出有显著的正向影响。这很可能是因为荷兰家庭在降低通胀预期时，对其实际收入和总支出变得更加乐观。我们发现认知或金融约束在解释支出反应方面的作用很小。(JEL C83, D12, D83, D84, E21, E31)

records.title_en: Efficient Consolidation of Incentives for Education and Retirement Savings
records.title_cn: 教育与退休储蓄激励的有效整合
records.abstract_en: We study optimal tax policies with human capital investment and retirement savings for present-biased agents. Agents are heterogeneous in their innate ability and make risky education investments, which determines their labor productivity. We demonstrate that the optimal distortions vary with education status. In particular, the optimal policy encourages human capital investment with savings incentives. Our implementation uses income-contingent student loans and existing retirement policies, augmented by a new tax instrument that subsidizes retirement savings for college graduates. The instrument mimics the latest policy proposals by allowing employers to offer 401(k) matching contributions proportional to student loans repayment. (JEL G51, H21, H24, I26, J24, J26)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了针对现时偏差代理人的最优税收政策，其中涉及人力资本投资和退休储蓄。代理人先天能力各异，并进行有风险的教育投资，这决定了他们的劳动生产率。我们证明，最优扭曲随教育状况而变化。特别是，最优政策通过储蓄激励鼓励人力资本投资。我们的实施方案采用收入或有学生贷款和现有退休政策，并辅以一项新的税收工具，该工具为大学毕业生提供退休储蓄补贴。该工具模仿了最新的政策建议，允许雇主提供与学生贷款偿还成比例的401(k)匹配缴款。(JEL G51, H21, H24, I26, J24, J26)

records.title_en: Human Capital Accumulation at Work: Estimates for the World and Implications for Development
records.title_cn: 工作中的人力资本积累：全球估计及其对发展的启示
records.abstract_en: We (i) study wage-experience profiles and obtain measures of returns to potential work experience using data from about 24 million individuals in 1,084 surveys and census samples across 145 countries; (ii) show that workers in developed countries accumulate twice as much human capital at work as those in developing countries; (iii) use a simple accounting framework to find that the contribution of work experience and education to human capital accumulation and economic development might be equally important; and (iv) employ panel regressions to investigate how changes in the returns over time correlate with several factors such as economic recessions, transitions, and human capital stocks. (JEL D12, I25, I26, J24, J31, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们（i）利用来自24个国家约1084万人的145项调查和人口普查样本数据，研究工资-经验曲线并获得潜在工作经验回报的度量；（ii）表明发达国家工人在工作中积累的人力资本是发展中国家的两倍；（iii）使用一个简单的核算框架发现，工作经验与教育对人力资本积累和经济发展的贡献可能同等重要；（iv）采用面板回归来研究回报随时间的变化如何与经济衰退、转型和人力资本存量等因素相关。（JEL D12, I25, I26, J24, J31, O15）

records.title_en: The Rise of Niche Consumption
records.title_cn: 小众消费的兴起
records.abstract_en: Over the last 15 years, individual households have concentrated their spending on a few preferred products. However, this is not driven by “superstar” products capturing larger market shares. Instead, households increasingly purchase different products from each other. As a result, aggregate spending concentration has decreased. We develop a model of heterogeneous household demand and use it to conclude that increasing product variety drives these divergent trends. When more products are available, households select products better matched to their tastes. This delivers welfare gains from selection equal to about half a percent per year in the categories covered by our data. (JEL D12, D91, E21, L66)
records.abstract_cn: 在过去15年中，个体家庭将支出集中在少数偏好的产品上。然而，这并非由“超级明星”产品占据更大市场份额所驱动。相反，家庭之间购买的产品日益不同。因此，总体支出集中度有所下降。我们开发了一个异质性家庭需求模型，并利用该模型得出结论：产品多样性的增加推动了这些分化趋势。当更多产品可用时，家庭会选择更符合其品味的产品。这带来的选择福利收益在我们数据覆盖的类别中每年约为半个百分点。（JEL D12, D91, E21, L66）

records.title_en: The Macroeconomic Impact of Europe’s Carbon Taxes
records.title_cn: 欧洲碳税的宏观经济影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate the macroeconomic impacts of carbon taxes on GDP and employment growth rates using 30 years of data on carbon taxation in various European countries. We find no evidence for a negative impact on employment or GDP growth but rather find a zero to modest positive impact. We also find a cumulative emissions reduction on the order of 4 to 6 percent for a $40/ton CO 2 tax covering 30 percent of emissions. Reductions would likely be greater for a broad-based US carbon tax since European carbon taxes typically do not cover those sectors with the lowest marginal abatement costs. (JEL E23, E24, H23, Q54, Q58)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用欧洲各国30年的碳税数据估算了碳税对 GDP 和就业增长率的宏观经济影响。我们没有发现任何证据表明对就业或 GDP 增长有负面影响，而是发现了零到适度的积极影响。我们还发现，对于覆盖 30% 排放量的 40 美元/吨二氧化碳 2 税，累积排放量减少量约为 4 至 6%。对于基础广泛的美国碳税来说，削减幅度可能更大，因为欧洲碳税通常不涵盖边际减排成本最低的部门。 （JEL E23、E24、H23、Q54、Q58）

records.title_en: The Causal Effects of Lockdown Policies on Health and Macroeconomic Outcomes
records.title_cn: 封锁政策对健康和宏观经济结果的因果效应
records.abstract_en: We assess the causal impact of pandemic-induced lockdowns on health and macroeconomic outcomes and measure the trade-off between containing the spread of a pandemic and economic activity. To do so, we estimate an epidemiological model with time-varying parameters and use its output as information for estimating SVARs and LPs that quantify the causal effects of nonpharmaceutical policy interventions. We apply our approach to Belgian data for the COVID-19 pandemic during 2020. We find that additional government-mandated mobility curtailments would have reduced deaths at a very small cost in terms of GDP. (JEL E23, H51, I12, I15, I18)
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了疫情引发的封锁对健康和宏观经济结果的因果影响，并衡量了遏制疫情传播与经济活动之间的权衡。为此，我们估计了一个具有时变参数的流行病学模型，并将其输出作为估计SVAR和LP的信息，以量化非药物政策干预的因果效应。我们将该方法应用于比利时2020年COVID-19大流行的数据。我们发现，额外的政府强制出行限制将以非常小的GDP成本减少死亡人数。(JEL E23, H51, I12, I15, I18)

records.title_en: The Intensive Margin in Trade: How Big and How Important?
records.title_cn: 贸易中的集约边际：有多大，有多重要？
records.abstract_en: In benchmark trade models that feature a constant trade elasticity, bilateral exports vary entirely on the intensive margin (exports per firm) or entirely on the extensive margin (number of firms). Our empirical analysis documents that roughly one-half of this variation occurs along each margin, implying that the trade elasticity is not constant. We estimate a generalized Melitz model with a joint log-normal distribution for firm productivity, fixed costs, and demand shifters. Using exact-hat algebra, we quantify how trade costs affect trade flows and welfare. Welfare effects are similar to those in the Melitz-Pareto model, but implied trade flows differ significantly. (JEL D22, D24, D43, F12, F14, L13)
records.abstract_cn: 在具有恒定贸易弹性的基准贸易模型中，双边出口完全在集约边际（每家企业出口额）或完全在扩展边际（企业数量）上变化。我们的实证分析表明，这种变化大约有一半发生在每个边际上，这意味着贸易弹性不是恒定的。我们估计了一个广义的Melitz模型，其中企业生产率、固定成本和需求转移因子服从联合对数正态分布。使用精确帽子代数，我们量化了贸易成本如何影响贸易流量和福利。福利效应与Melitz-Pareto模型中的相似，但隐含的贸易流量显著不同。（JEL D22, D24, D43, F12, F14, L13）

records.title_en: Has the Information Channel of Monetary Policy Disappeared? Revisiting the Empirical Evidence
records.title_cn: 货币政策的信息渠道是否已经消失？重新审视经验证据
records.abstract_en: Does the Federal Reserve have an “information advantage” in forecasting macroeconomic variables beyond what is known to private sector forecasters? And are market participants reacting only to monetary policy shocks or also to information on the future state of the economy that the Federal Reserve communicates in its announcements via an “information channel”? This paper investigates the evolution of both the information advantage and the information channel over time. Although they appear to be important historically, we find substantially weaker empirical evidence of their presence in recent years once instabilities are accounted for. (JEL C53, E32, E37, E47, E52, E58)
records.abstract_cn: 美联储在预测宏观经济变量方面是否拥有超出私营部门预测者已知信息的“信息优势”？市场参与者是否仅仅对货币政策冲击做出反应，还是也对美联储通过“信息渠道”在其公告中传达的未来经济状况信息做出反应？本文研究了信息优势和信息渠道随时间的演变。尽管它们在历史上似乎很重要，但我们发现，在考虑不稳定性之后，近年来它们存在的经验证据明显减弱。（JEL C53, E32, E37, E47, E52, E58）

records.title_en: Labor Market Responses to Unemployment Insurance: The Role of Heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场对失业保险的反应：异质性的作用
records.abstract_en: We document considerable scope of heterogeneity within the unemployed, especially when they are divided along eligibility for and receipt of unemployment insurance (UI). We study the implications of this heterogeneity on UI’s insurance-incentive trade-off using a heterogeneous-agent job search model capable of matching the wealth and income differences that distinguish UI recipients from nonrecipients. Insurance benefits are larger for UI recipients who are predominantly wealth poor. Meanwhile, incentive costs are nonmonotonic in wealth because the poorest individuals, who value employment, exhibit weak responses. Differential elasticities imply that accounting for the composition of recipients is material to the evaluation of UI’s insurance-incentive trade-off. (JEL D91, E24, E32, J64, J65)
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了失业者内部存在显著的异质性，尤其是当他们根据失业保险（UI）的资格和领取情况进行划分时。我们使用一个能够匹配UI领取者与非领取者之间财富和收入差异的异质性代理人工作搜索模型，研究这种异质性对UI的保险-激励权衡的影响。保险福利对主要是财富匮乏的UI领取者来说更大。同时，激励成本在财富方面是非单调的，因为最贫穷的个体，他们重视就业，表现出较弱的反应。差异弹性意味着，考虑领取者的构成对于评估UI的保险-激励权衡至关重要。（JEL D91, E24, E32, J64, J65）

records.title_en: When Sarah Meets Lawrence: The Effects of Coeducation on Women’s College Major Choices
records.title_cn: 当莎拉遇见劳伦斯：男女同校对女性大学专业选择的影响
records.abstract_en: We leverage variation in the adoption of coeducation by US women’s colleges to study how exposure to a mixed-gender collegiate environment affects women’s human capital investments. Our event-study analyses of newly collected historical data find a 3.0–3.5 percentage point (30–33 percent) decline in the share of women majoring in STEM fields. While coeducation caused a large influx of male peers and a modest increase in male faculty, we find no evidence that it altered the composition of the female student body or other gender-neutral inputs. Extrapolation of our main estimate suggests that coeducational environments explain 36 percent of the current gender gap in STEM majors. (JEL I23, I26, J16, J24)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国女子学院采用男女同校教育的差异来研究接触混合性别大学环境如何影响女性的人力资本投资。我们对新收集的历史数据进行的事件研究分析发现，女性选择STEM专业的比例下降了3.0-3.5个百分点（30-33%）。虽然男女同校导致了大量男性同龄人的涌入和男性教师的适度增加，但我们没有发现证据表明它改变了女性学生群体的构成或其他性别中性的投入。我们主要估计的外推表明，男女同校环境解释了当前STEM专业性别差距的36%。（JEL I23, I26, J16, J24）

records.title_en: Uncovering Peer Effects in Social and Academic Skills
records.title_cn: 揭示社交与学业技能中的同伴效应
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of adolescent peers who are central in their social network on the formation of social skills and academic performance of fellow students. I conduct a novel large-scale field experiment at selective public boarding schools in Peru with two treatments: (i) more socially central versus less socially central peers, and (ii) higher-achieving versus lower-achieving peers. Peer effects are more pronounced for social skills than academic performance, and both vary by gender. While socially central peers lead boys to better social skills, higher-achieving peers decrease girls' test scores. Gender differences in self-confidence can explain both findings. (JEL C93, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在社交网络中处于中心地位的青少年同伴对同伴学生社交技能形成和学业表现的影响。我在秘鲁的精英公立寄宿学校进行了一项新颖的大规模实地实验，包含两种处理：（i）社交中心性较高与较低的同伴，以及（ii）学业成绩较高与较低的同伴。同伴效应对社交技能的影响比对学业表现更为显著，且两者均因性别而异。社交中心性高的同伴能提升男生的社交技能，而学业成绩高的同伴则降低了女生的考试成绩。性别在自信心上的差异可以解释这两个发现。（JEL C93, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15, Z13）

records.title_en: Does Discipline Decrease Police Misconduct? Evidence from Chicago Civilian Allegations
records.title_cn: 纪律处分是否会减少警察不当行为？来自芝加哥平民指控的证据
records.abstract_en: Reformers are calling for greater oversight of police behavior, in part through enhanced use of civilian complaints. However, others counter that greater oversight could chill effective policing. We assess police officer response to administrative determinations of misconduct. Using Chicago data, we find strong evidence that a sustained allegation reduces that officer’s future misconduct. We find no evidence that this effect is driven by incapacitation, such as assignment to desk duty, or by officer disengagement. We conclude that our findings are most consistent with improved officer conduct, in part from oversight and officer concerns over promotion, salary, and desirable assignments. (JEL H76, J45, K42, M54)
records.abstract_cn: 改革者呼吁加强对警察行为的监督，部分通过增强对平民投诉的使用。然而，其他人反驳说，加强监督可能会抑制有效的警务工作。我们评估了警察对行政不当行为认定的反应。利用芝加哥的数据，我们发现强有力的证据表明，持续的指控会减少该警官未来的不当行为。我们没有发现证据表明这种效应是由失能（如被分配到文职工作）或警官脱离工作所驱动的。我们得出结论，我们的发现与警官行为的改善最为一致，部分原因在于监督以及警官对晋升、薪水和理想工作安排的担忧。（JEL H76, J45, K42, M54）

records.title_en: Halfway Home? Residential Housing and Reincarceration
records.title_cn: 中途之家？住宅住房与再监禁
records.abstract_en: Every year, hundreds of thousands of people are released from prison. For many, the transition back to society includes a mandatory stay in residential housing. I estimate the effect of residential housing on reincarceration using administrative data from Iowa. I address selection into residential housing by instrumenting for residential housing assignment with the recommendation rate of randomly assigned case managers. I find no evidence that Iowa’s costly investment in residential housing results in reduced reincarceration relative to parole. Instead, residential housing increases reincarceration due to violent crimes and technical violations, while decreasing drug and public order crimes. (JEL K42, R23, R31, R38)
records.abstract_cn: 每年，数十万人从监狱获释。对许多人来说，重返社会的过渡包括强制性的住宅住房居住。我使用爱荷华州的行政数据估计住宅住房对再监禁的影响。我通过使用随机分配的案件管理员的推荐率作为住宅住房分配的工具变量来解决住宅住房的选择性问题。我没有发现证据表明爱荷华州在住宅住房上的昂贵投资相对于假释能减少再监禁。相反，住宅住房增加了因暴力犯罪和技术违规导致的再监禁，同时减少了毒品和公共秩序犯罪。（JEL K42, R23, R31, R38）

records.title_en: Does Cash Bail Deter Misconduct?
records.title_cn: 现金保释能否遏制违法行为？
records.abstract_en: Courts routinely use low cash bail as a financial incentive to ensure released defendants appear in court and abstain from crime. This can create burdens for defendants with little empirical evidence on its efficacy. We exploit a prosecutor-driven reform that led to a sharp reduction in low cash bail and pretrial supervision, with no effect on pretrial detention, to test whether such incentive mechanisms succeed at their intended purpose. We find no evidence that financial collateral has a deterrent effect on failure to appear or pretrial crime. This paper also contributes to the literature on legal actor discretion, showing that nonbinding reforms may have limited impact on jail populations. (JEL K41, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 法院通常使用低额现金保释作为经济激励，以确保被释放的被告出庭并避免犯罪。这可能给被告带来负担，而其有效性缺乏实证证据。我们利用一项由检察官推动的改革，该改革导致低额现金保释和审前监管大幅减少，但对审前拘留没有影响，以检验此类激励机制是否达到预期目的。我们没有发现财务抵押对未出庭或审前犯罪具有威慑作用的证据。本文还对法律行为者自由裁量权的文献做出了贡献，表明非约束性改革可能对监狱人口的影响有限。（JEL K41, K42）

records.title_en: When Do Politicians Appeal Broadly? The Economic Consequences of Electoral Rules in Brazil
records.title_cn: 政治家何时广泛诉求？巴西选举规则的经济后果
records.abstract_en: Electoral rules determine how voters’ preferences are aggregated and translated into political representation. Using a regression discontinuity design, I contrast single- and two-round elections in Brazil. In two-round elections, the eventual winner must obtain at least 50 percent of the vote. I show that two-round elections provide incentives for candidates to secure a broader base of support and provide public goods more broadly. Candidates represent a more geographically diverse group of voters, public schools have more resources, and there is less variation in resources across schools. Effects appear to be driven by strategic responses of candidates rather than differential entry into races. (JEL D72, H41, H75, I21, I28, O15, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 选举规则决定了选民的偏好如何被汇总并转化为政治代表。利用断点回归设计，我对比了巴西的单轮和两轮选举。在两轮选举中，最终获胜者必须获得至少50%的选票。我表明，两轮选举激励候选人确保更广泛的支持基础，并更广泛地提供公共物品。候选人代表更地理多样化的选民群体，公立学校拥有更多资源，且学校间资源差异较小。这些效应似乎是由候选人的策略性回应而非参选者的差异进入所驱动。（JEL D72, H41, H75, I21, I28, O15, O17）

records.title_en: School Attendance Boundaries and the Segregation of Public Schools in the United States
records.title_cn: 学校招生边界与美国公立学校的隔离
records.abstract_en: School segregation is determined both by residential sorting and local policies, such as the drawing of attendance boundaries and school siting. This paper develops an approach to understanding the relative importance of these factors by calculating the distance-minimizing assignment of students to schools and assessing whether actual assignments differ systematically by race. Using census data and attendance boundary maps for nearly 1,600 school districts, I find that attendance boundaries create 5 percent more integration than a distance-minimizing baseline, while school siting plays almost no role. Residential segregation alone explains more than 100 percent of school segregation in the United States. (JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 学校隔离既由居住分化决定，也由地方政策（如招生边界的划定和学校选址）决定。本文通过计算学生到学校距离最小化的分配方案，并评估实际分配是否因种族而存在系统性差异，提出了一种理解这些因素相对重要性的方法。利用近1,600个学区的普查数据和招生边界图，我发现招生边界比距离最小化基线多创造了5%的融合，而学校选址几乎不起作用。仅居住隔离就解释了美国学校隔离的100%以上。（JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, R23）

records.title_en: Working Their Way Up? US Immigrants’ Changing Labor Market Assimilation in the Age of Mass Migration
records.title_cn: 他们是否在向上流动？大规模移民时代美国移民劳动力市场同化的变迁
records.abstract_en: Whether immigrants advance in labor markets during their lifetimes relative to natives is a fundamental question in the economics of immigration. We examine linked census records for five cohorts spanning 1850–1940, when immigration to the United States was at its peak. We find a U-shaped pattern of assimilation: immigrants were “catching up” to natives in the early and later cohorts, but not in between. This change was not due to shifts in immigrants’ source countries. Instead, it was rooted in men’s early-career occupations, which we associate with structural change, strengthening complementarities, and large immigration waves in the 1840s and 1900s. (JEL J15, J24, J61, J82, N31, N32)
records.abstract_cn: 移民在其一生中相对于本地人在劳动力市场上是否有所进步，是移民经济学中的一个基本问题。我们考察了跨越1850-1940年的五个队列的关联人口普查记录，当时美国移民达到顶峰。我们发现同化呈U型模式：移民在早期和后期队列中“追赶”本地人，但在中间时期则不然。这一变化并非源于移民来源国的转变，而是根植于男性早期职业，我们将其与结构性变化、互补性增强以及1840年和1900年的大规模移民浪潮联系起来。(JEL J15, J24, J61, J82, N31, N32)

records.title_en: From Hashtag to Hate Crime: Twitter and Antiminority Sentiment
records.title_cn: 从标签到仇恨犯罪：推特与反少数族裔情绪
records.abstract_en: We study whether social media can amplify antiminority sentiment with a focus on Donald Trump’s political rise. Using an instrumental variable strategy based on Twitter’s early adopters at the South by Southwest festival in 2007, we find that higher Twitter use in a county is associated with a sizeable increase in anti-Muslim hate crimes after the 2016 presidential primaries. Trump’s tweets about Muslims predict increases in xenophobic tweets by his followers, cable news mentions of Muslims, and hate crimes on the following days. These results suggest that social media content can affect real-life out-comes. (JEL D72, J15, K42, L82, Z12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究社交媒体是否能放大反少数族裔情绪，重点关注唐纳德·特朗普的政治崛起。利用基于2007年西南偏南音乐节上推特早期采用者的工具变量策略，我们发现，一个县的推特使用率越高，2016年总统初选后反穆斯林仇恨犯罪的数量就越大。特朗普关于穆斯林的推文预测了其追随者仇外推文、有线新闻对穆斯林的提及以及随后几天仇恨犯罪的增加。这些结果表明，社交媒体内容可以影响现实生活中的结果。(JEL D72, J15, K42, L82, Z12)

records.title_en: Adverse Selection in Low-Income Health Insurance Markets: Evidence from an RCT in Pakistan
records.title_cn: 低收入健康保险市场中的逆向选择：来自巴基斯坦随机对照试验的证据
records.abstract_en: We present robust evidence on adverse selection in hospitalization insurance for low-income individuals that received first-time access to insurance. A large randomized control trial from Pakistan allows us to separate adverse selection from moral hazard, estimate how selection changes at different points of the demand curve, and test simple measures to limit adverse selection. The results reveal substantial selection in individual policies, leading to welfare losses and the threat of a market breakdown. Bundling insurance policies at the household level or higher almost eliminates adverse selection, thus mitigating its welfare consequences and facilitating sustainable insurance supply. (JEL D82, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于低收入个体首次获得住院保险时逆向选择的稳健证据。一项来自巴基斯坦的大型随机对照试验使我们能够将逆向选择与道德风险区分开来，估计选择在不同需求曲线点上的变化，并测试限制逆向选择的简单措施。结果揭示了个人保单中存在显著的选择，导致福利损失和市场崩溃的威胁。在家庭层面或更高层面捆绑保险单几乎消除了逆向选择，从而减轻了其福利后果并促进了可持续的保险供给。(JEL D82, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)

records.title_en: What Difference Does a Health Plan Make? Evidence from Random Plan Assignment in Medicaid
records.title_cn: 健康计划有何不同？来自医疗补助计划中随机计划分配的证据
records.abstract_en: Exploiting the random assignment of Medicaid beneficiaries to managed care plans, we find substantial plan-specific spending effects despite plans having identical cost sharing. Enrollment in the lowest-spending plan reduces spending by at least 25 percent—primarily through quantity reductions—relative to enrollment in the highest-spending plan. Rather than reducing “wasteful” spending, lower-spending plans broadly reduce medical service provision—including the provision of low-cost, high-value care—and worsen beneficiary satisfaction and health. Consumer demand follows spending: a 10 percent increase in plan-specific spending is associated with a 40 percent increase in market share. These facts have implications for the government’s contracting problem and program cost growth. (JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, I38)
records.abstract_cn: 利用医疗补助受益人被随机分配到管理式护理计划的这一情况，我们发现尽管计划具有相同的成本分摊，但存在显著的特定计划支出效应。加入支出最低的计划相对于加入支出最高的计划，可使支出至少减少25%——主要通过数量减少实现。支出较低的计划并非减少“浪费性”支出，而是广泛减少了医疗服务提供——包括提供低成本、高价值的护理——并降低了受益人的满意度和健康状况。消费者需求随支出变化：特定计划支出增加10%与市场份额增加40%相关。这些事实对政府的签约问题和项目成本增长具有启示意义。(JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, I38)

records.title_en: Generic Aversion and Observational Learning in the Over-the-Counter Drug Market
records.title_cn: 非处方药市场中的仿制药厌恶与观察学习
records.abstract_en: Through a labeling intervention at a national retailer, we test three hypotheses for consumer aversion to generic over-the-counter drugs: lack of information on the comparability of generic and brand drugs, inattention to their price differences, and uncertainty about generic quality that can be reduced with information on peer purchase rates. With a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that posted information on the purchases of other customers increases generic purchase shares significantly, while other treatments have mixed results. Consumers without prior generic purchases appear particularly responsive to this information. These findings have policy implications for promoting evidence-based, cost-effective choices. (JEL D12, D83, L65, L81, M37)
records.abstract_cn: 通过在一家全国性零售商处进行的标签干预，我们检验了消费者对非处方仿制药厌恶的三个假设：缺乏关于仿制药和品牌药可比性的信息、对其价格差异的忽视，以及可以通过同伴购买率信息减少的仿制药质量不确定性。采用双重差分策略，我们发现张贴其他顾客购买信息显著提高了仿制药购买份额，而其他处理的效果不一。先前没有仿制药购买经历的消费者对这一信息似乎尤为敏感。这些发现对促进基于证据的、成本有效的选择具有政策意义。（JEL D12, D83, L65, L81, M37）

records.title_en: The US farm credit system and agricultural development: Evidence from an early expansion, 1920–1940
records.title_cn: 美国农业信贷体系与农业发展：来自早期扩张的证据，1920-1940年
records.abstract_en: I explore the impact of the Production Credit Associations (PCAs), an arm of the early Farm Credit System, on agricultural yield and input use following the farm crisis of the 1920s. Like many low‐ and middle‐income countries today, farmers in the early 20th century United States found it difficult to access credit. The PCAs were established in 1933 and significantly increased the supply of short‐term credit available to farmers. Using distance from the serving PCA as a proxy for credit access, I find that counties within 30 km of a PCA had 7% to 14% higher crop revenue per acre and 9% higher corn yields than counties more than 60 km from a PCA. These areas also had a small but statistically significant increase in the use of tractors (1% to 2%). These results provide crucial evidence of the impact of government‐sponsored enterprises on the early US agricultural economy and its use as a cost‐effective tool to address market frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我探讨了生产信贷协会（PCAs）——早期农业信贷体系的一个分支——在1920年农业危机后对农业产量和投入品使用的影响。与当今许多低收入和中等收入国家一样，20世纪初美国的农民难以获得信贷。生产信贷协会成立于1933年，显著增加了农民可获得的短期信贷供应。以距服务PCA的距离作为信贷获取的代理变量，我发现距PCA 30公里以内的县，其每英亩作物收入比距PCA超过60公里的县高7%至14%，玉米单产高9%。这些地区的拖拉机使用量也有小幅但统计上显著的增加（1%至2%）。这些结果提供了关键证据，表明政府资助企业对早期美国农业经济的影响，以及其作为解决市场摩擦的成本效益工具的作用。

records.title_en: The influence of the Environmental Quality Incentives Program on local water quality
records.title_cn: 环境质量激励计划对当地水质的影响
records.abstract_en: The Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP) is the primary conservation program on working agricultural land. The United States Department of Agriculture obligated over $15 billion through EQIP cost‐sharing contracts during the fiscal years 2009–2019. The voluntary nature of the program and the lack of performance assessment have led to speculations regarding the effectiveness of the program in delivering environmental benefits, in particular for improving water quality. This study provides quantitative estimates of the influence of EQIP payments on local water quality at a national scale. We link monitoring station level water quality readings with EQIP contract data and exploit the direction of river flow for identification. The estimated effects of EQIP vary across water quality measures. Estimates indicate that EQIP payments have significantly reduced biochemical oxygen demand and nitrogen, indicating improvements in water quality, but increased total suspended solids, fecal coliform, and phosphorus, suggesting that the implementation of certain conservation practices might have increased soil erosion and pathogen transfer, especially in watersheds with more agricultural production.
records.abstract_cn: 环境质量激励计划（EQIP）是农业用地上的主要保护计划。在15-2009财政年度，美国农业部通过EQIP成本分摊合同承诺了超过2019亿美元。该计划的自愿性质以及缺乏绩效评估，引发了关于该计划在提供环境效益（尤其是改善水质）方面有效性的猜测。本研究在全国范围内提供了EQIP支付对当地水质影响的定量估计。我们将监测站级别的水质读数与EQIP合同数据相关联，并利用河流流向进行识别。EQIP的估计效应因水质指标而异。估计表明，EQIP支付显著降低了生化需氧量和氮，表明水质改善，但增加了总悬浮固体、粪大肠菌群和磷，这表明某些保护措施的实施可能增加了土壤侵蚀和病原体转移，尤其是在农业生产较多的流域。

records.title_en: Gender and mechanization: Evidence from Indian agriculture
records.title_cn: 性别与机械化：来自印度农业的证据
records.abstract_en: Technological change in production processes with gendered division of labor across tasks, such as agriculture, can have a differential impact on women's and men's labor. Using exogenous variation in the extent of loamy soil, which is more amenable to deep tillage than clayey soil and therefore more likely to see adoption of tractor‐driven equipment for primary tilling, we show that mechanization led to significantly greater decline in women's than men's labor on Indian farms during 1999–2011. Reduced demand for labor in weeding, a task often undertaken by women, explains our findings. The estimates suggest that a 10% increase in mechanized tilling led to a 5% fall in women's farm labor use, with no accompanying increase in their non‐farm sector employment. Our results highlight the gendered impact of technological change in contexts where there is task based gender division of labor with limited opportunities for women to diversify their workforce participation.
records.abstract_cn: 在生产过程中，任务按性别分工（如农业）的技术变革可能对女性和男性的劳动产生不同影响。利用壤土（比黏土更适合深耕，因此更可能采用拖拉机驱动的设备进行初次耕作）程度的外生变异，我们表明机械化导致印度农场女性劳动比男性劳动下降得更显著，时间跨度为1999-2011年。除草（通常由女性承担的任务）劳动需求的减少解释了我们的发现。估计表明，机械化耕作每增加10%，女性农场劳动使用量下降5%，而其非农部门就业并未相应增加。我们的结果凸显了在基于任务的性别分工且女性劳动力多样化机会有限的情况下，技术变革的性别影响。

records.title_en: Agglomeration bonus and endogenous group formation
records.title_cn: 集聚奖励与内生群体形成
records.abstract_en: Agglomeration bonus schemes are envisioned to incentivize the connectivity of habitat conservation across landowners. Assuming full cooperation among landowners at the landscape scale, the bulk of the literature theoretically finds that agglomeration bonus schemes are more cost effective in achieving biodiversity conservation than spatially homogenous payments. However, it may be rational for landowners not to cooperate all together but, rather, to cooperate within smaller groups. Here, we analyze the cost effectiveness of agglomeration bonus schemes when such partial cooperation is allowed, that is, when cooperation is endogenously chosen. We introduce a spatially explicit ecological‐economic model within a coalition formation game to assess how landowners form stable coalition structures and how this affects biodiversity conservation under a wide range of (i) degrees of spatial cost autocorrelation, (ii) bonuses and flat‐rate payments, (iii) species dispersal rates, and (iv) coordination costs. We find that agglomeration bonus schemes are more cost effective than homogenous payments only for low public expenditures. This condition is not identified if full cooperation is assumed. We find, however, that full cooperation never emerges and hence that such an assumption leads to an overestimation of the cost effectiveness of agglomeration bonus schemes. Moreover, we find that the cost effectiveness of agglomeration bonus schemes increases when the spatial cost autocorrelation and species dispersal rate decrease. Finally, coordination costs do not affect the cost effectiveness of the agglomeration bonus scheme but they have implications for its design because of their impact on coalition formation.
records.abstract_cn: 集聚奖励计划旨在激励土地所有者之间栖息地保护的连通性。假设土地所有者在景观尺度上完全合作，大部分文献理论上发现，集聚奖励计划在实现生物多样性保护方面比空间同质支付更具成本效益。然而，土地所有者可能不全部合作，而是在较小的群体内合作，这可能是理性的。在这里，我们分析了当允许这种部分合作时，即合作是内生选择时，集聚奖励计划的成本效益。我们在联盟形成博弈中引入了一个空间显式的生态经济模型，以评估土地所有者如何形成稳定的联盟结构，以及这在广泛的（i）空间成本自相关程度，（ii）奖金和固定费率支付，（iii）物种扩散速率，以及（iv）协调成本下如何影响生物多样性保护。我们发现，集聚奖励计划仅在公共支出较低时比同质支付更具成本效益。如果假设完全合作，则无法识别这一条件。然而，我们发现完全合作从未出现，因此这种假设导致对集聚奖励计划成本效益的高估。此外，我们发现，当空间成本自相关和物种扩散速率降低时，集聚奖励计划的成本效益增加。最后，协调成本不影响集聚奖励计划的成本效益，但由于其对联盟形成的影响，对其设计有影响。

records.title_en: School breakfast and student behavior
records.title_cn: 学校早餐与学生行为
records.abstract_en: The School Breakfast Program (SBP) is one of the largest nutrition assistance programs serving school‐aged children in the US. It provides reimbursement to states for the operation of breakfast programs in schools. Student participation in the SBP is, however, much lower than the National School Lunch Program (NSLP). Because missing breakfast could result in hunger that could then influence children's interpersonal relations and classroom behavior (i.e., disciplinary infractions), some schools have implemented breakfast after the bell (BAB), which encompasses alternative breakfast delivery methods that make breakfast available to children after the school day commences. We use a difference‐in‐differences design with variation in BAB exposure across grades to study the effect on children's behavior. We find that infractions drop after schools adopted BAB. Moreover, the impact of BAB on behavior is more pronounced among minority children and those eligible for free and reduced‐price meals.
records.abstract_cn: 学校早餐计划（SBP）是美国为学龄儿童提供服务的最大营养援助计划之一。它为各州运营学校早餐计划提供报销。然而，学生参与SBP的比例远低于全国学校午餐计划（NSLP）。由于不吃早餐可能导致饥饿，进而影响儿童的人际关系和课堂行为（即违纪行为），一些学校实施了铃后早餐（BAB），其中包括替代性早餐提供方式，使儿童在学校上课开始后也能获得早餐。我们采用双重差分设计，利用不同年级BAB暴露的差异来研究其对儿童行为的影响。我们发现，在学校采用BAB后，违纪行为有所下降。此外，BAB对行为的影响在少数族裔儿童和符合免费或减价餐资格的儿童中更为显著。

records.title_en: A dynamic analysis of the distribution of commodity futures and spot prices
records.title_cn: 商品期货与现货价格分布的动态分析
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of futures markets and their dynamic effects on the stability of commodity prices. The analysis is based on combining two econometric approaches: a quantile vector autoregression (QVAR) model of the marginal distributions of futures and spot prices, and a copula of their joint distribution. Applied to the US soybean and corn markets over the period of 1980–2019, the econometric investigation finds evidence of nonlinear price dynamics that depend on the maturity of the futures contract and documents how marginal price distributions and associated moments evolve over time. Based on the estimates of the QVAR model, we provide evidence of local instability in the upper tail of the price distributions. We find that the futures market helps stabilize the market under nearby futures contract maturity. We document the presence of nonlinear cointegration relationships between futures and spot price. Relying on a copula, we find a positive contemporaneous codependence between futures price and spot price across all quantiles, codependence that varies with the futures contract maturity. We also present evidence of a time‐varying basis that affects the convergence properties of the futures and spot price. Our findings shed new light on the joint determination of futures and spot price in commodity markets.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了期货市场的作用及其对商品价格稳定性的动态影响。分析基于结合两种计量经济学方法：期货和现货价格边际分布的分位数向量自回归（QVAR）模型，以及它们联合分布的copula。应用于1980-2019年期间的美国大豆和玉米市场，计量经济学调查发现了依赖于期货合约到期日的非线性价格动态证据，并记录了边际价格分布及相关矩随时间演变的方式。基于QVAR模型的估计，我们提供了价格分布上尾局部不稳定的证据。我们发现，在近期期货合约到期日下，期货市场有助于稳定市场。我们记录了期货与现货价格之间存在非线性协整关系。利用copula，我们发现期货价格与现货价格在所有分位数上存在正的同时相依性，这种相依性随期货合约到期日而变化。我们还提供了随时间变化的基础影响期货和现货价格收敛性质的证据。我们的发现为商品市场中期货和现货价格的联合决定提供了新的视角。

records.title_en: Collective investment in a common pool resource: Grower associations and food safety guidelines
records.title_cn: 公共池资源中的集体投资：种植者协会与食品安全指南
records.abstract_en: Common pool resources often face overexploitation, but collective action can counteract that tendency. We investigate collective investment in reputation for produce food safety, a common pool resource because of limited branding and traceability, by U.S. commodity organizations. We use a unique dataset constructed with data from U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Drug Administration, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and industry to provide novel evidence on collective investment in common pool resources. Notably, only large shocks to reputation such as foodborne disease outbreaks resulting in hospitalization increase the likelihood of food safety guideline adoption. Adoption of food safety guidelines by government‐backed organizations results in improvements in some food safety outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 公共池资源常常面临过度开发，但集体行动可以抵消这种趋势。我们研究了美国商品组织在农产品食品安全声誉方面的集体投资，由于品牌和可追溯性有限，这被视为一种公共池资源。我们利用由美国农业部、食品药品监督管理局、疾病控制与预防中心及行业数据构建的独特数据集，为公共池资源中的集体投资提供了新的证据。值得注意的是，只有诸如导致住院的食源性疾病爆发等对声誉的重大冲击，才会增加食品安全指南采纳的可能性。政府支持的组织采纳食品安全指南，会改善某些食品安全结果。

records.title_en: Markups and export behavior: Firm‐level evidence from the French food processing industry
records.title_cn: 加成率与出口行为：来自法国食品加工业的企业层面证据
records.abstract_en: The relationship between a firm's markups and its export behavior is highly relevant to individual firms' strategic decisions as well as to governments' policies regarding competition. We investigate the impact of markups on firms' decisions to export and resulting export intensity in the French food processing industry. Moreover, we assess the effect of entry into and remaining in the export market on firms' markups and evaluate differences in markups between exporters and non‐exporters. Our results suggest that higher markups lead to both increased participation in the export market and greater export intensity. In addition, we find that firms obtain higher markups by entering and remaining in the export market. Finally, our results suggest that exporters generate higher markups, on average, than non‐exporters. Similar results are found when controlling for differences in firms' productivity. Our findings suggest that trade policies designed to increase firms' participation in export markets, such as limits to border restrictions, may counteract domestic competition policies targeted at price–cost margins.
records.abstract_cn: 企业的加成率与其出口行为之间的关系，对单个企业的战略决策以及政府的竞争政策都具有高度相关性。我们研究了加成率对法国食品加工业企业出口决策及由此产生的出口强度的影响。此外，我们评估了进入并留在出口市场对企业加成率的影响，并评估了出口商与非出口商之间加成率的差异。我们的结果表明，较高的加成率既导致出口市场参与度的提高，也导致出口强度的增加。此外，我们发现企业通过进入并留在出口市场而获得更高的加成率。最后，我们的结果表明，平均而言，出口商比非出口商产生更高的加成率。在控制企业生产率差异后，结果相似。我们的研究结果表明，旨在提高企业参与出口市场的贸易政策，如限制边境壁垒，可能会抵消针对价格-成本边际的国内竞争政策。

records.title_en: Switching cost and store choice
records.title_cn: 转换成本与商店选择
records.abstract_en: Switching costs are generally regarded as anticompetitive as firms can raise prices to “locked‐in” consumers, at least up to the cost of switching to a lower‐priced alternative. However, there is some evidence, both theoretical and empirical, that tends to show the opposite. Namely, suppliers, anticipating the pool of rents potentially available, compete aggressively to acquire non‐switching consumers. Moreover, fixed shopping costs and uncertain prices imply that there is a “real option” value embedded in consumers’ shopping behavior, and which must be priced in and compensated if consumers are to switch stores. We argue that retail prices are lower when retailers use programs designed to increase customer retention, or “stickiness.” We test our theory using a panel of household‐level, store‐choice data. Contrary to the conventional wisdom, we find that loyalty is pro‐competitive and leads to lower prices than would otherwise be the case. We also find that approximately 50% of the cumulative loyalty effect is attributable to the existence of a real option due to price uncertainty and that switching costs are substantial and comprise around 12% of the average cost of a basket of groceries.
records.abstract_cn: 转换成本通常被视为反竞争的，因为企业可以向“锁定”的消费者提高价格，至少提高到转向低价替代品的成本。然而，有一些理论和实证证据倾向于显示相反的情况。即，供应商预期到潜在可获得的租金池，会积极竞争以获取非转换消费者。此外，固定的购物成本和不确定的价格意味着消费者的购物行为中嵌入了“实物期权”价值，如果消费者要转换商店，必须对此定价并给予补偿。我们认为，当零售商使用旨在提高客户保留率或“粘性”的计划时，零售价格会更低。我们使用家庭层面的商店选择数据面板来检验我们的理论。与传统观点相反，我们发现忠诚度是促进竞争的，并导致价格低于其他情况下的水平。我们还发现，累计忠诚度效应中约有50%可归因于价格不确定性导致的实物期权的存在，且转换成本相当可观，约占平均一篮子杂货成本的12%。

records.title_en: Measuring the American farm size distribution
records.title_cn: 衡量美国农场规模分布
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a measure of farm size as a share‐weighted sum of farm sizes, called the Share Weighted Size Index (SWSI), which introduces new evidence of farm consolidation from 1959 to 2017. Our Share Weighted Size Index provides more reasonable estimates of the entire farm size distribution than simple averages and is useful for comparing farm size across crops at one point in time or for comparing farm sizes for a given crop over time. Although previous measures have relied on confidential or hard‐to‐access farm‐level records, the Share Weighted Size Index is derived exclusively from publicly available Census of Agriculture data. Unlike average farm size, the Share Weighted Size Index reveals consistent evidence of rising farm size, the importance of returns to scale for most commodities, and the rising importance of specialization on a small number of crops within farms. Contrary to past studies that argued rising off‐farm wages increase farm size, we find evidence that proximity to off‐farm opportunities results in smaller farms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种农场规模的衡量方法，即作为农场规模份额加权总和的份额加权规模指数（SWSI），该指数引入了从1959年到2017年农场整合的新证据。我们的份额加权规模指数比简单平均值更能合理估计整个农场规模分布，并且有助于在某一时点比较不同作物的农场规模，或随时间比较给定作物的农场规模。尽管以往的衡量方法依赖于保密或难以获取的农场层面记录，但份额加权规模指数完全来源于公开可得的农业普查数据。与平均农场规模不同，份额加权规模指数揭示了一致的农场规模上升证据、规模报酬对大多数商品的重要性，以及农场内少数作物专业化程度不断提高的重要性。与过去认为非农工资上升会增加农场规模的研究相反，我们发现接近非农就业机会会导致农场规模缩小的证据。

records.title_en: When does voluntary coordination work? Evidence from area‐wide pest management
records.title_cn: 自愿协调何时有效？来自区域病虫害管理的证据
records.abstract_en: We introduce the “coordination frontier” (CF), a simple practical tool to assess the likelihood of success of voluntary coordination in situations where, ex ante, the collective action solution provides an appealing alternative (e.g., for pest and disease control). We demonstrate the value of information conveyed by the CF, explain how to construct the CF from experimental data, and show how to apply the CF in practice. We illustrate the concept with an application to data from a framed field economic experiment, which was designed to elicit the preferences of Florida's citrus growers regarding their willingness to coordinate actions to combat citrus greening disease. This is a highly relevant case study not only because of the significant impact caused by citrus greening on Florida's citrus industry but also because a voluntary area‐wide pest management program to control it had been established in 2010 and eventually failed; a similar program is now in place in California, where the disease spread is at an earlier stage. Had the CF been available in Florida, estimates of the (aggregate) chances of successful coordination could have been shared with growers to update their beliefs regarding the chances of successful coordination to help reduce strategic uncertainty. Policymakers in California could use the CF in such way and devise ways to encourage participation to increase the chances of reaching a desired coordination threshold.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了“协调前沿”（CF），这是一个简单实用的工具，用于评估在事前集体行动解决方案提供有吸引力替代方案（例如病虫害防治）的情况下自愿协调成功的可能性。我们展示了CF所传达信息的价值，解释了如何从实验数据构建CF，并展示了如何在实践中应用CF。我们通过一个框架性实地经济实验的数据应用来说明这一概念，该实验旨在揭示佛罗里达州柑橘种植者关于协调行动以对抗柑橘绿化病的意愿。这是一个高度相关的案例研究，不仅因为柑橘绿化病对佛罗里达州柑橘产业造成了重大影响，还因为一项旨在控制该病的自愿区域病虫害管理计划于2010年建立并最终失败；类似的计划目前已在加利福尼亚州实施，那里的疾病传播尚处于早期阶段。如果佛罗里达州当时有CF，就可以与种植者分享（总体）协调成功机会的估计值，以更新他们对协调成功可能性的信念，从而帮助减少战略不确定性。加利福尼亚州的政策制定者可以以这种方式使用CF，并设计鼓励参与的方法，以提高达到期望协调阈值的可能性。

records.title_en: Productive Workfare? Evidence from Ethiopia's Productive Safety Net Program
records.title_cn: 生产性以工代赈？来自埃塞俄比亚生产安全网计划的证据
records.abstract_en: Public works programs have long been a popular policy tool to reduce poverty and build productive infrastructure. Although an extensive literature has documented the effect of these programs on poverty, there is virtually no evidence on the productive effect of the infrastructure. This paper attempts to start filling this gap in the context of the Productive Safety Net Program—a large‐scale public works program implemented in Ethiopia since 2005. Under the program, millions of beneficiaries received social transfers conditional on their participation in activities such as land improvements and soil and water conservation measures. We examine the value of these activities using a satellite‐based indicator of agricultural productivity and (reweighted) difference‐in‐differences estimates. Results show that the program is associated with limited changes in agricultural productivity. The upper bound of the main estimate is equivalent to a 2.2% increase in agricultural yield. This contrasts with existing narratives and calls for more research on the productive effects of public works.
records.abstract_cn: 公共工程计划长期以来一直是减少贫困和建设生产性基础设施的流行政策工具。尽管大量文献记录了这些计划对贫困的影响，但几乎没有关于基础设施生产性影响的证据。本文试图在埃塞俄比亚自2005年以来实施的大规模公共工程计划——生产安全网计划的背景下开始填补这一空白。在该计划下，数百万受益者获得了社会转移支付，条件是他们参与土地改良和水土保持措施等活动。我们使用基于卫星的农业生产力指标和（重新加权的）双重差分估计来检验这些活动的价值。结果表明，该计划与农业生产力的有限变化相关。主要估计的上限相当于农业产量增加2.2%。这与现有叙述形成对比，并呼吁对公共工程的生产性影响进行更多研究。

records.title_en: Unintended environmental consequences of place‐based economic policies
records.title_cn: 地方经济政策的意外环境后果
records.abstract_en: We examine the environmental consequences of two regional economic development (RED) policies that aimed to develop the economy of the relatively underdeveloped upper Pearl River (UPR) regions in Guangdong Province, China. Applying the triple‐difference analysis to annual county‐industry‐level data, we find that the two RED policies caused higher growth in industries with high water pollution than in industries with less water pollution in the UPR regions. The second RED policy with environmental regulations was effective in restraining the new entry of firms in high‐pollution industries into the UPR regions but failed to drive existing high‐pollution firms out of the UPR regions. Firms' location decisions were driven by the more favorable tax regimes and less stringent pollution regulations in the UPR regions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了中国广东省旨在发展相对欠发达的珠江上游（UPR）地区的两项区域经济发展（RED）政策的环境后果。将三重差分分析应用于年度县-行业层面数据，我们发现这两项RED政策在UPR地区导致了高水污染行业比低水污染行业更高的增长。带有环境法规的第二项RED政策在抑制高污染行业新企业进入UPR地区方面有效，但未能将现有高污染企业驱离UPR地区。企业的选址决策受到UPR地区更优惠的税收制度和较不严格的污染法规的驱动。

records.title_en: The impact of India's demonetization on domestic agricultural trade
records.title_cn: 印度废钞令对国内农产品贸易的影响
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of an extreme monetary shock, India's demonetization of 2016, on domestic agricultural trade. Using data from around 3000 regulated markets for 35 major crops, we find that trade value fell by 16.3–16.8% in the short run, settling at 11.8–12.1% after eight months, driven primarily by a decline in prices. Triple difference estimates suggest sharpest impacts for kharif crops, perishables and crops with minimal government intervention. Markets far away from banks fared worse. Our results suggest that the implosion of value of agricultural trade domestically persisted two growing seasons beyond the one that coincided with the shock, whereas existing findings suggest that the negative impact on the economy as a whole dissipates in that time.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了极端货币冲击——印度2016年废钞令——对国内农产品贸易的影响。利用约3000个监管市场中35种主要作物的数据，我们发现贸易额在短期内下降了16.3-16.8%，八个月后稳定在11.8-12.1%的降幅，这主要是由价格下跌驱动的。三重差分估计表明，对哈里夫作物、易腐作物和政府干预最少的作物影响最为显著。远离银行的市场表现更差。我们的结果表明，国内农产品贸易价值的崩溃在冲击发生后的两个种植季节中持续存在，而现有研究则表明，整个经济的负面影响在那时已经消散。

records.title_en: Modeling transaction costs in household adoption of landscape conservation practices
records.title_cn: 家庭采纳景观保护实践中的交易成本建模
records.abstract_en: Many conservation programs provide economic incentives for landscape best management practices adopted by households. These programs typically include multiple administrative procedures that impose transaction costs, such as requirements for project design and inspections. The literature provides little insight on the relative influence of common transaction costs such as these on best management practice adoption. This paper develops a model to estimate the simultaneous effects of multiple transaction costs linked to common administrative requirements within residential cost‐share incentive programs. The model decomposes the magnitudes and effects of different transaction costs that vary across agents and programs, as a function of requirements for project design, contracting, inspections, and payments. It further identifies the types of program changes that would cause the greatest increases in efficiency due to transaction cost attenuation, measured as reductions in agents’ willingness to accept to adopt best management practices.
