Togetherness takes the form of joint leisure and joint care for children. Using revealed preference conditions and Dutch data over the years 2009–2012, we find that households are willing to pay €1.20 per hour—10 percent of the average wage—to convert private leisure to joint leisure and €2.10 per hour to convert private childcare to joint childcare. Our results suggest togetherness is an important component of household time use despite being overlooked in the economics literature. (JEL D12, D13, J12, J13, J16, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 与配偶共度时光是婚姻的一大收益。我们将经典的家庭集体模型扩展，允许配偶之间的共处。共处表现为共同休闲和共同照顾孩子。利用显示性偏好条件和荷兰2009-2012年的数据，我们发现家庭愿意为将私人休闲转换为共同休闲支付每小时1.20欧元——占平均工资的10%——以及为将私人育儿转换为共同育儿支付每小时2.10欧元。我们的结果表明，尽管共处在经济学文献中被忽视，但它是家庭时间使用的重要组成部分。(JEL D12, D13, J12, J13, J16, J22)

records.title_en: Ten Isn’t Large! Group Size and Coordination in a Large-Scale Experiment
records.title_cn: 十并不大！大规模实验中的群体规模与协调
records.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence on coordination within large groups that could proxy the atomistic nature of real-world markets. We use a bank run game where the two pure-strategy equilibria can be ranked by payoff and risk dominance and a sequence of public announcements introduces stochastic sunspot equilibria. We find systematic group size effects that theory fails to predict. When the payoff-dominant strategy is risky enough, the behavior of small groups is uninformative of the behavior in large groups: unlike smaller groups of size ten, larger groups exclusively coordinate on the Pareto-inferior strategy and never coordinate on sunspots. (JEL C92, D83, D91, G21)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于大群体内协调的实验证据，这些群体可以代表现实世界市场的原子性质。我们使用一个银行挤兑博弈，其中两个纯策略均衡可以按支付和风险优势排序，一系列公开公告引入了随机太阳黑子均衡。我们发现了理论无法预测的系统性群体规模效应。当支付占优策略足够有风险时，小群体的行为无法反映大群体的行为：与规模为十的较小群体不同，较大群体完全协调于帕累托劣势策略，并且从不协调于太阳黑子。（JEL C92, D83, D91, G21）

records.title_en: The Effects of Time Preferences on Cooperation: Experimental Evidence from Infinitely Repeated Games
records.title_cn: 时间偏好对合作的影响：来自无限重复博弈的实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of time preferences on cooperation in an infinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma game experiment. Subjects play repeated games in the lab, all decisions at once, but stage game payoffs are paid over an extended period of time. Changing the time window of stage game payoffs (weekly or monthly) varies discount factors, and a delay for the first-stage game payoffs eliminates/weakens present bias. First, subjects with weekly payments cooperate more than subjects with monthly payments—higher discount factors promote greater cooperation. Second, the rate of cooperation is higher when there is a delay—present bias reduces cooperation. (JEL C72, C73, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过无限重复囚徒困境博弈实验研究时间偏好对合作的影响。受试者在实验室中进行重复博弈，所有决策一次性做出，但阶段博弈收益在较长时间内分期支付。改变阶段博弈收益的时间窗口（每周或每月）会改变贴现因子，而第一阶段博弈收益的延迟支付则消除或削弱了现时偏误。首先，每周支付的受试者比每月支付的受试者合作更多——更高的贴现因子促进更多合作。其次，存在延迟时合作率更高——现时偏误降低合作。（JEL C72, C73, D91）

records.title_en: Implications of Unequal Discounting in Dynamic Contracting
records.title_cn: 动态契约中不等贴现的含义
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a canonical dynamic screening problem where the agent has Markovian private information and limited commitment and the principal and the agent have different discount factors. Unequal discounting captures unequal access to capital markets. In comparison to standard models of dynamic mechanism design, the principal no longer finds it optimal to maximally back-load the agent’s information rents: a new force of inter-temporal cost of incentive provision pushes toward front-loading agents’ payoffs. The optimal contract settles into a cycle with infinite memory. The introduction of unequal discounting renders the standard relaxed-problem approach invalid for certain parameters. A simple and approximately optimal contract is then provided. (JEL D21, D61, D82, D86, L14)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个典型的动态筛选问题，其中代理人具有马尔可夫私人信息和有限承诺，且委托人与代理人具有不同的贴现因子。不等贴现反映了进入资本市场的机会不平等。与标准动态机制设计模型相比，委托人不再认为最大化地延迟代理人的信息租金是最优的：一种新的跨期激励提供成本力量推动代理人报酬的前置。最优契约进入一个具有无限记忆的周期。不等贴现的引入使得标准的松弛问题方法在某些参数下失效。随后提供了一个简单且近似最优的契约。（JEL D21, D61, D82, D86, L14）

records.title_en: Moral Hazard and Efficiency in a Frictional Market
records.title_cn: 摩擦市场中的道德风险与效率
records.abstract_en: Principals seek to trade with homogeneous agents by posting incentive contracts, which direct their search. Search and moral hazard interact in equilibrium. If using transfers to compensate agents failing to contract, the equilibrium allocation is always constrained-welfare-optimal in contrast to the one-to-one principal-agent problem. Search frictions thus correct that inefficiency because search requires internalizing the utility of agents. Incentives are weaker than in bilateral contracting, and agents enjoy more efficient risk sharing. With a constraint on transfers the allocation may become inefficient; principal competition results in overinsurance of the agents, too little effort in equilibrium, and excessive entry by principals. (JEL D82, D83, D86)
records.abstract_cn: 委托人通过发布激励合同来寻求与同质代理人交易，这些合同引导着他们的搜索。搜索与道德风险在均衡中相互作用。如果使用转移支付来补偿未能签约的代理人，均衡配置总是受约束的福利最优，这与一对一的委托-代理问题形成对比。因此，搜索摩擦纠正了这种无效率，因为搜索要求内化代理人的效用。激励比双边缔约时更弱，代理人享受更有效的风险分担。在转移支付受限的情况下，配置可能变得无效率；委托人竞争导致对代理人的过度保险、均衡中的努力不足以及委托人的过度进入。（JEL D82, D83, D86）

records.title_en: Ghosting the Tax Authority: Fake Firms and Tax Fraud in Ecuador
records.title_cn: 幽灵税务：厄瓜多尔的虚假企业与逃税
records.abstract_en: An important but poorly understood form of firm tax evasion arises from “ghost firms”—fake firms that issue fraudulent receipts so that their clients can claim false deductions. We provide a unique window into this global phenomenon using transaction-level tax data from Ecuador. Five percent of firms use ghost invoices annually. Among these firms, ghost transactions comprise 14 percent of purchases. Ghost transactions are prevalent among large firms and firms with high-income owners and exhibit suspicious patterns, such as bunching below financial system thresholds. An innovative enforcement intervention targeting ghost clients rather than ghosts themselves led to substantial tax recovery. (JEL D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14)
records.abstract_cn: 一种重要但鲜为人知的企业逃税形式源于“幽灵企业”——即开具虚假收据以便客户虚报扣除额的虚假企业。我们利用厄瓜多尔的交易级税务数据，为这一全球现象提供了一个独特的视角。每年有百分之五的企业使用幽灵发票。在这些企业中，幽灵交易占采购额的14%。幽灵交易在大型企业和拥有高收入所有者的企业中普遍存在，并表现出可疑的模式，例如在金融系统门槛以下聚集。一项针对幽灵客户而非幽灵本身的创新执法干预措施带来了可观的税收追回。(JEL D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14)

records.title_en: Detecting Mother-Father Differences in Spending on Children: A New Approach Using Willingness-to-Pay Elicitation
records.title_cn: 检测父母在子女支出上的差异：一种使用支付意愿诱导的新方法
records.abstract_en: This paper tests whether mothers and fathers differ in their spending on daughters relative to sons by comparing their willingness to pay (WTP) for specific goods for their children. This method, which we apply in Uganda, offers more precision than the standard method of examining expenditure effects of mothers’ versus fathers’ income. We find that fathers have a lower WTP for their daughters’ than their sons’ human capital but mothers do not. Altruism plays a role: fathers’ but not mothers’ WTP for goods that simply bring joy to their daughters is lower than their WTP for such goods for sons. (JEL D64, G51, J12, J13, J16, O12)
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过比较父母为子女特定商品支付意愿（WTP），检验母亲和父亲在女儿相对于儿子的支出上是否存在差异。我们在乌干达应用了这种方法，它比检验母亲与父亲收入支出效应的标准方法更为精确。我们发现，父亲对女儿人力资本的支付意愿低于对儿子的，但母亲并非如此。利他主义发挥作用：父亲对仅为女儿带来快乐商品的支付意愿低于对儿子的，而母亲则没有。（JEL D64, G51, J12, J13, J16, O12）

records.title_en: Herd Design
records.title_cn: 羊群设计
records.abstract_en: The classic herding model examines the asymptotic behavior of agents who observe their predecessors’ actions as well as a private signal from an exogenous information structure. In this paper, we introduce a self-interested sender into the model and study her problem of designing this information structure. If agents cannot observe each other, the model reduces to Bayesian persuasion. However, when agents observe predecessors’ actions, they may learn from them, potentially harming the sender. We identify necessary and sufficient conditions under which the sender can nevertheless obtain the same utility as when the agents are unable to observe each other. (JEL D82, D83, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 经典羊群模型考察了观察前人行动以及来自外生信息结构的私人信号的代理人的渐近行为。在本文中，我们将一个自利的发送者引入模型，并研究她设计这一信息结构的问题。如果代理人无法相互观察，该模型简化为贝叶斯说服。然而，当代理人观察前人的行动时，他们可能从中学习，这可能损害发送者的利益。我们确定了发送者仍然能够获得与代理人无法相互观察时相同效用的必要且充分条件。(JEL D82, D83, D91)

records.title_en: The Impact of Host Language Proficiency on Migrants’ Employment Outcomes
records.title_cn: 东道国语言熟练度对移民就业结果的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the economic gains from proficiency in the host country’s language on migrants’ employment outcomes by exploiting the exogenous placement of refugees to Swiss cantons and a sharp language border dividing German- and French-speaking regions. Using administrative data on African refugees who applied for Swiss asylum between 2008 and 2017, I compare French-speaking refugees assigned to the French-speaking region to French-speaking refugees assigned to the German-speaking region and adjust for common regional differences with outcomes from English-speaking African refugees. The results suggest that language proficiency more than doubles the employment level in the first five years after arrival. (JEL J15, J24, J31, J82, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过利用难民被外生安置到瑞士各州以及分隔德语区和法语区的清晰语言边界，估计了掌握东道国语言对移民就业结果的经济收益。使用关于在2008年至2017年间申请瑞士庇护的非洲难民的管理数据，我将被安置到法语区的法语难民与被安置到德语区的法语难民进行比较，并利用来自英语非洲难民的结果调整常见的区域差异。结果表明，语言熟练度使抵达后前五年的就业水平提高了一倍以上。(JEL J15, J24, J31, J82, R23)

records.title_en: Global Innovation and Knowledge Diffusion
records.title_cn: 全球创新与知识扩散
records.abstract_en: We develop a Ricardian model of trade where countries innovate ideas that diffuse globally. Our key result provides necessary and sufficient conditions for innovation and diffusion to generate max-stable Fréchet productivity, linking generalized extreme value expenditure to knowledge flows. Innovation makes a country technologically distinct, reducing its substitutability with other countries. In contrast, diffusion generates technological similarity, increasing head-to-head competition and substitutability. In an innovation-only model where countries do not share ideas, productivities are independent across countries and expenditure is CES. Consequently, departures from CES reveal diffusion patterns. (JEL F11, O31, O33, O41)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个李嘉图贸易模型，其中各国创新出在全球扩散的思想。我们的关键结果为创新和扩散生成最大稳定弗雷歇生产率提供了充分必要条件，将广义极值支出与知识流动联系起来。创新使一个国家在技术上独特，降低了其与其他国家的可替代性。相反，扩散产生技术相似性，增加了正面竞争和可替代性。在一个仅创新模型中，各国不共享思想，生产率在国家间独立，支出为CES形式。因此，偏离CES揭示了扩散模式。(JEL F11, O31, O33, O41)

records.title_en: Dishonesty and Public Employment
records.title_cn: 不诚实行为与公共部门就业
records.abstract_en: We exploit a natural experiment to study the causal link between dishonest behavior and public employment. When military conscription was mandatory in Argentina, eligibility was determined by both a lottery and a medical examination. To avoid conscription, individuals at risk of being drafted had strong incentives to cheat in their medical examination. These incentives varied with the lottery number. Exploiting this exogenous variation, we first present evidence of cheating in medical examinations. We then show that individuals with a higher probability of having cheated in health checks exhibit a higher propensity to occupy nonmeritocratic public sector jobs later in life. (JEL D91, J45, K42, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项自然实验来研究不诚实行为与公共部门就业之间的因果关系。当阿根廷实行义务兵役制时，资格由抽签和体检共同决定。为了避免服兵役，有被征召风险的人有强烈动机在体检中作弊。这些动机随抽签号码而变化。利用这种外生变异，我们首先提供了体检中作弊的证据。然后我们表明，在健康检查中作弊概率较高的个体，在以后的生活中更倾向于担任非精英选拔的公共部门职位。(JEL D91, J45, K42, O15)

records.title_en: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Reduces Crime and Violence over Ten Years: Experimental Evidence
records.title_cn: 认知行为疗法在十年内减少犯罪和暴力：实验证据
records.abstract_en: Several small, short-term, or nonexperimental studies show that cognitive behavioral–informed interventions reduce antisocial behaviors over one to two years, but persistence research is rare. We followed 999 high-risk men in Liberia ten years after randomization into eight weeks of low-cost, nonspecialist-led therapy; $200 cash; both; or neither. A decade later, antisocial behaviors (such as robbery and drug selling) fell 0.2 standard deviations from therapy alone—significantly greater than the one-year impacts. Meanwhile, men who received therapy plus cash were 0.25 standard deviations less antisocial—similar to one-year results. In both cases, impacts were concentrated in men exhibiting highest baseline risk. (JEL D91, K42, O15, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 几项小型、短期或非实验性研究表明，认知行为知情干预在一到两年内减少反社会行为，但持续性研究很少。我们在利比里亚对999名高风险男性进行了随机分组，分为八周低成本、非专业主导的治疗；200美元现金；两者兼有；或两者皆无，并随访十年。十年后，仅接受治疗的反社会行为（如抢劫和贩毒）下降了0.2个标准差——显著大于一年期的影响。同时，接受治疗加现金的男性反社会行为减少了0.25个标准差——与一年期结果相似。在两种情况下，影响集中在基线风险最高的男性中。（JEL D91, K42, O15, O17）

records.title_en: Hiring Frictions and the Promise of Online Job Portals: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 招聘摩擦与在线求职门户的前景：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite the growing prominence of online job portals, firms remain reluctant to hire outside traditional recruitment networks. We find that experimentally providing firms with a combination of advertising and the ability to verify applicant identity increases portal-based hiring by 68 percent and the likelihood of filling a vacancy by 11 percent. Advertising attracts more skilled applicants, while verification enables the screening of unfamiliar applicants. Portal-based hires are retained beyond the standard assessment period, suggesting that they are well suited to the vacancies. Firms assigned only advertising also attract more skilled applicants, but providing neither advertising nor verification alone increases hiring. (JEL D22, J23, J24, J63, M51, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 尽管在线求职门户日益重要，企业仍不愿在传统招聘网络之外进行招聘。我们发现，实验性地向企业提供广告和验证申请人身份的能力相结合，可使基于门户的招聘增加68%，填补空缺职位的可能性增加11%。广告吸引更多技能娴熟的申请人，而验证则能筛选不熟悉的申请人。基于门户的招聘在标准评估期后仍被保留，表明他们非常适合空缺职位。仅被分配广告的企业也吸引了更多技能娴熟的申请人，但仅提供广告或仅提供验证均不能增加招聘。(JEL D22, J23, J24, J63, M51, O15)

records.title_en: Mistakes in Future Consumption, High MPCs Now
records.title_cn: 未来消费中的错误，当前高边际消费倾向
records.abstract_en: In a canonical intertemporal consumption model, future consumption mistakes (in response to saving changes) lead to higher current marginal propensities to consume (MPCs). These mistakes increase the value of changing current consumption relative to changing saving, as additional saving will not be spent optimally. Various behavioral biases can cause these mistakes, such as inattention, present bias, diagnostic expectations, and near-rationality (epsilon-mistakes). This result helps explain the empirical puzzle of high-liquidity consumers’ high MPCs. In my approach, predictions of sophistication (anticipation of future mistakes) can be derived independently of the underlying biases. (JEL D15, D91, E21)
records.abstract_cn: 在一个典型的跨期消费模型中，未来消费错误（对储蓄变化的反应）会导致当前更高的边际消费倾向（MPCs）。这些错误增加了改变当前消费相对于改变储蓄的价值，因为额外的储蓄将不会被最优地花费。各种行为偏差可能导致这些错误，如注意力不集中、现时偏差、诊断性预期和近似理性（epsilon-错误）。这一结果有助于解释高流动性消费者高MPCs的经验之谜。在我的方法中，对复杂性的预测（对未来错误的预期）可以独立于潜在的偏差得出。（JEL D15, D91, E21）

records.title_en: How does the development of digital finance affect small business tax compliance? Empirical evidence from China
records.title_cn: 数字金融发展如何影响小企业税收遵从？来自中国的经验证据
records.abstract_en: How will the development of digital finance affect corporate tax compliance? In the digital economic age, this is a crucial issue. Using the 2011–2015 national tax survey database (NTSD) and the Peking University digital finance index, this paper examines the causal relationship between digital finance and small business tax compliance. Our baseline results show that each standard deviation increase in the digital finance index reduces the level of tax noncompliance by 7.5% for small businesses. We exclude the interference of contemporaneous policies, utilize a specification design based on neighboring cities across provincial borders, and employ instrumental variable estimation methods to jointly alleviate concerns about endogeneity. Furthermore, mechanism analysis shows that digital finance impacts small business tax noncompliance by easing corporate financing constraints and capturing tax-related “digital information”. Finally, we analyze the heterogeneous effects of digital finance development. The effects on tax noncompliance are weaker for large firms (placebo group), small businesses supported by the government's industrial policy, and small businesses located in poor credit environment areas.
records.abstract_cn: 数字金融的发展将如何影响企业税收遵从？在数字经济时代，这是一个至关重要的问题。利用2011-2015年全国税收调查数据库（NTSD）和北京大学数字金融指数，本文考察了数字金融与小企业税收遵从之间的因果关系。我们的基准结果表明，数字金融指数每增加一个标准差，小企业的税收不遵从水平降低7.5%。我们排除了同期政策的干扰，利用基于省界相邻城市的规格设计，并采用工具变量估计方法，共同缓解了内生性问题。此外，机制分析表明，数字金融通过缓解企业融资约束和获取涉税“数字信息”来影响小企业的税收不遵从。最后，我们分析了数字金融发展的异质性效应。对于大企业（安慰剂组）、受政府产业政策支持的小企业以及位于信用环境较差地区的小企业，其对税收不遵从的影响较弱。

records.title_en: Family size, labor supply, and job prestige: Evidence from three decennial censuses in China
records.title_cn: 家庭规模、劳动供给与职业声望：来自中国三次人口普查的证据
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the relationship between family size and parents’ labor market performance, measured by labor supply and occupational prestige scores, based on three census waves in 1990, 2000, and 2010. To address the endogeneity problem of family size, we use the indicator of twins at first birth as an instrumental variable. Our results suggest that in nuclear households, family size affects the labor market performance only of mothers, not of fathers, with the negative effects fading and gradually disappearing over time. More specifically, an increase in family size decreases female labor supply in the 1990 wave, leads to lower prestige scores among working mothers in the 2000 wave, and has no impact on labor supply or occupational prestige scores in the 2010 wave. Our subsample analysis indicates that the negative effects of family size are more severe for parents of households with all children under seven years old and for husbands or wives with lower education level than that of their partners. In addition, we find that the negative effects of family size on parental labor market outcomes are not observed in extended households, especially when no grandparents are aged 65 years or older.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究基于1990年、2000年和2010年的三次人口普查数据，考察了家庭规模与父母劳动力市场表现（以劳动供给和职业声望得分衡量）之间的关系。为解决家庭规模的内生性问题，我们使用头胎双胞胎作为工具变量。结果表明，在核心家庭中，家庭规模仅影响母亲的劳动力市场表现，而不影响父亲，且负面影响随时间逐渐减弱并最终消失。具体而言，家庭规模增加在1990年降低了女性劳动供给，在2000年导致在职母亲的职业声望得分降低，而在2010年对劳动供给或职业声望得分均无影响。我们的子样本分析表明，家庭规模的负面影响对于所有子女均在七岁以下的家庭中的父母，以及教育水平低于配偶的丈夫或妻子更为严重。此外，我们发现家庭规模对父母劳动力市场结果的负面影响在扩展家庭中并未观察到，尤其是在没有祖父母年龄达到65岁或以上的情况下。

records.title_en: Imports of key capital goods and quality upgrading: Evidence from China's import subsidy policy
records.title_cn: 关键资本品进口与质量升级：来自中国进口补贴政策的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of capital goods imports on firms' export quality upgrading with a subsidy policy for advanced capital imports implemented in China since 2008. Using a matched dataset of firms' production and custom data, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy that exploits firms' differential pre-event exposures to the policy. We find that the subsidy policy increases firms' imports of subsidized products, and improves their export quality. Furthermore, export quality improvements due to capital goods imports are larger if (1) firms are more productive; (2) the exporting product is the firm's core product; (3) the product is a differentiated good; and (4) the destination market is larger and richer. Further analysis suggests that capital goods imports can also boost firms' total exports and the number of exporting destinations and products. The mechanism tests reveal that capital-skill complementarity can explain improved export product quality through capital goods imports. Capital goods imports also lead to increased skill management that can improve export quality as well.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国自2008年起实施的先进资本品进口补贴政策，考察了资本品进口对企业出口质量升级的影响。通过匹配的企业生产与海关数据，我们采用双重差分策略，利用企业在政策前不同的暴露程度。我们发现补贴政策增加了企业对补贴产品的进口，并提高了其出口质量。此外，资本品进口带来的出口质量提升在以下情况下更大：（1）企业生产率更高；（2）出口产品是企业核心产品；（3）产品为差异化产品；（4）目的地市场规模更大且更富裕。进一步分析表明，资本品进口还能促进企业总出口以及出口目的地和产品数量的增加。机制检验显示，资本技能互补性可以解释通过资本品进口带来的出口产品质量提升。资本品进口还导致技能管理增加，这同样能提高出口质量。

records.title_en: Multi-generational educational mobility in China in the twentieth century
records.title_cn: 二十世纪中国多代教育流动性
records.abstract_en: Two essential strategies to understand the mechanisms of intergenerational mobility are to compare mobility across countries and across time. However, for multi-generational mobility, estimates for developing countries are mostly missing, and trend studies are rare. This paper uses education to measure social status and provides nationally representative estimates of social mobility over three generations in China that are suitable for international comparison. Results show that grandparents’ education positively correlates with children’s education, controlling for the parents’ education. This grandparent effect is comparable to what is found in Western countries, despite differences in cultures and institutions. During the sample period, the correlation between grandparent and child education is relatively stable. When exploring mechanisms, we find that the observed grandparent effect is primarily due to omitted information from the parents’ generation, not direct interactions between grandparents and children.
records.abstract_cn: 理解代际流动性机制的两种基本策略是比较不同国家和不同时期的流动性。然而，对于多代流动性，发展中国家的估计大多缺失，趋势研究也很少。本文使用教育来衡量社会地位，提供了中国三代人社会流动性的全国代表性估计，适合国际比较。结果表明，在控制父母教育的情况下，祖父母的教育与子女的教育呈正相关。这种祖父母效应与西方国家发现的效应相当，尽管文化和制度存在差异。在样本期间，祖父母与子女教育之间的相关性相对稳定。在探索机制时，我们发现观察到的祖父母效应主要归因于父母一代的遗漏信息，而非祖父母与子女之间的直接互动。

records.title_en: Buy now, pay later as liquidity insurance: Evidence from an early experiment in China
records.title_cn: 先买后付作为流动性保险：来自中国早期实验的证据
records.abstract_en: This study explores the liquidity insurance role of Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL). As a complementary study to Bian et al. (2023), we provide institutional background and mechanism analysis of BNPL's consumption-boosting effects. Since a significant consumption boosting effect exists even for individuals who did not draw on the BNPL credit line, we argue that BNPL provides liquidity insurance by releasing preexisting precautionary liquidity reserves into consumption. We also explore several robustness checks and heterogeneity analyses.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了先买后付（BNPL）的流动性保险作用。作为对Bian等人（2023）的补充研究，我们提供了BNPL消费促进效应的制度背景和机制分析。由于即使对于未动用BNPL信用额度的个人也存在显著的消费促进效应，我们认为BNPL通过释放先前存在的预防性流动性储备进入消费来提供流动性保险。我们还进行了若干稳健性检验和异质性分析。

records.title_en: Does polycentric spatial structure narrow the urban-rural income gap? – Evidence from six urban clusters in China
records.title_cn: 多中心空间结构是否缩小了城乡收入差距？——来自中国六大城市群的证据
records.abstract_en: As urbanization and economic development continue to accelerate, social equity issues are becoming increasingly prominent and the urban–rural income gap is an important manifestation of this. This study uses the data of urban clusters from 2010 to 2019 and focuses on the relationship between the polycentric spatial structure of urban clusters and the urban–rural income gap. The findings show that the development of urban cluster polycentricity can reduce the urban–rural income gap, and the higher the degree of polycentricity in morphology, the smaller the gap. However, the relationship between polycentric spatial structure and the urban–rural income gap is “U” shaped, indicating the need for rational planning of urban polycentric development patterns rather than simple expansion. In addition, the polycentric spatial structure of urban clusters can reduce regional disparities by promoting factor mobility and industrial structure optimization. However, this depends on the level of industrial development and infrastructure. This study highlights the importance of a balanced approach to urban development that takes into account regional disparities and issues of social equity.
records.abstract_cn: 随着城市化和经济发展的不断加速，社会公平问题日益突出，城乡收入差距是这一问题的重要表现。本研究利用2010年至2019年城市群的数据，关注城市群多中心空间结构与城乡收入差距之间的关系。研究结果表明，城市群多中心性的发展可以缩小城乡收入差距，形态上的多中心程度越高，差距越小。然而，多中心空间结构与城乡收入差距之间的关系呈“U”形，表明需要合理规划城市多中心发展模式，而非简单扩张。此外，城市群的多中心空间结构可以通过促进要素流动和产业结构优化来缩小区域差异。然而，这取决于产业发展水平和基础设施状况。本研究强调了平衡城市发展方法的重要性，该方法需考虑区域差异和社会公平问题。

records.title_en: Educational differences in parental time devoted to childcare in China
records.title_cn: 中国父母育儿时间投入的教育差异
records.abstract_en: The intergenerational transmission of education in China has drawn extensive public and academic attention. This paper explores the differences in the amount of time Chinese parents spend on childcare stratified by education level and investigates the factors driving these differences. The analysis shows that more educated parents devote more time to childcare than less-educated parents. The educational differences in parental childcare time are particularly pronounced among working parents, parents with school-age children, and parents in the provinces where educational institutions are relatively scarce. Much of the extra childcare time is directed to educational care and travel with children. Compared to households in which the mother has less than a junior high school education, households with university-educated mothers spend 74 min more per day on childcare, with 58% of the extra time devoted to children's learning and education.
records.abstract_cn: 中国教育的代际传递引起了公众和学术界的广泛关注。本文探讨了中国父母按教育水平分层的育儿时间投入差异，并研究了导致这些差异的因素。分析显示，受教育程度更高的父母比受教育程度较低的父母投入更多的育儿时间。父母育儿时间的教育差异在职父母、有学龄子女的父母以及教育机构相对稀缺省份的父母中尤为明显。额外育儿时间的大部分用于教育关怀和与子女同行。与母亲教育水平低于初中学历的家庭相比，母亲受过大学教育的家庭每天在育儿上多投入74分钟，其中58%的额外时间用于子女的学习和教育。

records.title_en: Rural centralized residences and the health of the acting heads of rural households: The case of China
records.title_cn: 农村集中居住与农村户主健康：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: The rural centralized residence (RCenR) has been adopting to promote rural development in 24 provinces in China. Acting heads of rural households are older and their health is worse than average rural residents. However, their health has greater externalities since they play a central role in families and in daily village operations. It is therefore important to investigate the causal effect of RCenR on the health of the acting heads, which remains econometrically underexplored. This study controls for cross-prefecture contiguous-villages group fixed effects and uses the expected once-off government housing subsidy as the instrumental variable to estimate the causal effect of RCenR on the health of acting heads. It is found that RCenR significantly improves acting heads' health through increased income, reduced strenuous agricultural activities, greater use of clean energy and clean water, as well as easier access to local medical services. These findings are important because they can guide developing countries to improve their rural development policies.
records.abstract_cn: 农村集中居住（RCenR）已被中国24个省份采用以促进农村发展。农村户主年龄较大，健康状况比一般农村居民差。然而，他们的健康具有更大的外部性，因为他们在家庭和日常村庄运营中扮演核心角色。因此，研究RCenR对户主健康的因果效应非常重要，而这一效应在计量经济学上尚未得到充分探索。本研究控制了跨地级市相邻村庄组固定效应，并使用预期的一次性政府住房补贴作为工具变量来估计RCenR对户主健康的因果效应。研究发现，RCenR通过增加收入、减少繁重农业活动、增加清洁能源和清洁水的使用以及更容易获得当地医疗服务，显著改善了户主的健康。这些发现很重要，因为它们可以指导发展中国家改进其农村发展政策。

records.title_en: Efficiency or equity? The effect of an exogenous agricultural commercial shock: Evidence from Manchuria in the 1930s
records.title_cn: 效率还是公平？外生农业商业冲击的影响：来自满洲的证据1930
records.abstract_en: The adoption of high-value cash crops (HVCs) is considered an efficient way to improve farmers' productivity and welfare, although the systematic empirical evidence is limited. By exploiting an exogenous commercial shock for soybeans and microlevel rural survey data from Manchuria of China in the 1930s, where factor markets were relatively well functioning, this study investigates the influence of HVC cultivation on farmers' agricultural performance, welfare, and inequality both theoretically and empirically. We find that (i) larger farms devote a larger proportion of land to HVCs and that (ii) farmers who cultivate a larger proportion of HVCs have higher agricultural productivity, profit, net income, and expenditure. Furthermore, the adoption of HVCs lowers profit, income, and expenditure inequality by enhancing income from wages relative to land rents, which benefits households with less land.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管系统的经验证据有限，但采用高价值经济作物（HVC）被认为是提高农民生产力和福利的有效途径。通过利用大豆的外生商业冲击和中国满洲里要素市场运转相对良好的微观农村调查数据1930，本研究从理论上和实证上探讨了高价值种植对农民农业绩效、福利和不平等的影响。我们发现，(i) 较大的农场将更大比例的土地用于 HVC，并且 (ii) 种植更多 HVC 的农民拥有更高的农业生产率、利润、净利润和支出。此外，高价值价值的采用通过提高相对于土地租金的工资收入来降低利润、收入和支出不平等，这有利于土地较少的家庭。

records.title_en: How is Fintech reshaping the traditional financial markets? New evidence from InsurTech and insurance sectors in China
records.title_cn: 金融科技如何重塑传统金融市场？来自中国保险科技与保险业的新证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the effect of Fintech on the market structure of traditional financial markets, and focus particularly on InsurTech and the insurance sector. We find that InsurTech has significantly reduced the non-life insurance sector's market concentration but plays a limited role in the life insurance sector's market structure. The results are not driven by potential reverse causality and remain unchanged when we employ an instrumental variables approach and use an alternative supply-side InsurTech index. We further explore the underlying mechanisms and find that, instead of competing directly with insurance companies, Fintech companies provide insurance technologies to traditional insurers and help them lower entry barriers and reduce operating costs. Our paper sheds light on how InsurTech is reshaping traditional insurance sectors, and the results are generalizable to Fintech and financial markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了金融科技对传统金融市场市场结构的影响，并特别关注保险科技与保险业。我们发现，保险科技显著降低了非寿险部门的集中度，但对寿险部门的市场结构作用有限。这些结果并非由潜在的反向因果驱动，并且在使用工具变量方法和替代的供给侧保险科技指数时保持不变。我们进一步探讨了潜在机制，发现金融科技公司并非直接与保险公司竞争，而是向传统保险公司提供保险技术，帮助其降低进入壁垒和运营成本。我们的论文揭示了保险科技如何重塑传统保险业，且结果可推广至金融科技与金融市场。

records.title_en: The backfiring effects of monetary and gift incentives on Covid-19 vaccination intentions
records.title_cn: 货币和礼品激励对 Covid-19 疫苗接种意愿的适得其反的影响
records.abstract_en: We provide evidence that material inducements for Covid-19 vaccination may backfire. Results from a hypothetical survey experiment in China (N = 1365) show incentives of 8–125 USD reduce vaccine uptake intentions compared to simply offering vaccination for free. Ours is the first Covid-19 vaccine study to separately consider and directly compare the effects of monetary and goods-based incentives, both of which have been widely employed by countries seeking to increase uptake; we demonstrate that both types backfire equally. Results are compared against the burgeoning literature on Covid-19 vaccine incentives.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供的证据表明，针对 Covid-19 疫苗接种的物质诱因可能会适得其反。中国的一项假设调查实验结果 (N = 1365) 显示，与简单地免费提供疫苗接种相比，8-125美元的激励措施降低了疫苗接种意愿。我们的研究是第一项针对新冠病毒19疫苗的研究，该研究单独考虑并直接比较货币激励措施和基于商品的激励措施的效果，这两种激励措施已被寻求增加接种的国家广泛采用；我们证明这两种类型都会适得其反。将结果与有关 Covid-19 疫苗激励措施的新兴文献进行比较。

records.title_en: Multi-province comparisons of digital financial inclusion performance in China: A group ranking method with preference analysis
records.title_cn: 中国数字普惠金融绩效的多省比较：一种带有偏好分析的群体排序方法
records.abstract_en: The Peking University Digital Financial Inclusion Index of China (PKU-DFIIC) measures the digital financial inclusion (DFI) performance in China from three dimensions: breadth of coverage, depth of use and level of digitalization. This paper extends the PKU-DFIIC to measure and compare the provincial DFI performance in terms of proposing a group ranking method with preference analysis. Specifically, we identify a panel of experts by comprehensively considering all possible importance orders of three dimensions, and formulate a preliminary group decision matrix. Then the preference analysis is carried out with respect to preferential difference and preferential priority. A revised group decision matrix is derived with the expert-specific ranking as the inputs. Finally, a group ranking method is given based on the half-quadratic theory, in conjunction with the consensus index and trust level denoting the level of agreement and reliability of the group ranking. An empirical study using the PKU-DFIIC data from 2016 to 2020 is conducted to demonstrate our method, along with the spatial-temporal analysis of the results and a set of policy implications to promote the DFI development in China.
records.abstract_cn: 北京大学数字普惠金融指数（PKU-DFIIC）从覆盖广度、使用深度和数字化程度三个维度衡量中国数字普惠金融（DFI）绩效。本文扩展了PKU-DFIIC，通过提出一种带有偏好分析的群体排序方法来衡量和比较省级DFI绩效。具体而言，我们通过综合考虑三个维度的所有可能重要性顺序来确定一组专家，并构建初步的群体决策矩阵。然后，针对偏好差异和偏好优先级进行偏好分析。以专家特定排序作为输入，得出修正后的群体决策矩阵。最后，基于半二次理论，结合共识指数和信任水平（表示群体排序的一致性和可靠性），给出一种群体排序方法。利用2016年至2020年的PKU-DFIIC数据进行实证研究，以展示我们的方法，并对结果进行时空分析，提出一系列促进中国DFI发展的政策启示。

records.title_en: Health-seeking behavior and patient welfare: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 就医行为与患者福利：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: The inefficient use of healthcare resources is a persisting challenge to almost all healthcare systems, making it imperative to understand the underlying factors of healthcare demand. This paper investigates patients' health-seeking behavior in rural China using a random coefficients logit model. We further perform a counterfactual simulation and welfare analyses to evaluate the inefficiencies in health services utilization. The counterfactual simulation reallocates patients to more efficient health providers following the principles of the hierarchical medical system. Our analysis suggests that out-of-pocket expenses and distance to providers discourage patients from utilizing healthcare, while quality of care has a positive effect on patients' hospital choices. However, significant heterogeneity exists in patient preferences over quality of care, out-of-pocket expenses, and distance to providers. The simulation results show that the overall welfare change may have masked variations related to the hypothetical change, with societal welfare loss from switching to higher-tier providers. Our analysis provides support for policies to improve hospitals and assist rural patients in financing healthcare in China.
records.abstract_cn: 医疗资源利用效率低下是几乎所有医疗体系面临的持续挑战，因此理解医疗需求背后的因素至关重要。本文利用随机系数logit模型研究了中国农村患者的就医行为。我们进一步进行了反事实模拟和福利分析，以评估医疗服务利用中的低效率问题。反事实模拟根据分级诊疗体系的原则，将患者重新分配给更高效的医疗服务提供者。我们的分析表明，自付费用和就医距离阻碍了患者利用医疗服务，而医疗质量对患者的医院选择有正向影响。然而，患者对医疗质量、自付费用和就医距离的偏好存在显著异质性。模拟结果显示，总体福利变化可能掩盖了与假设变化相关的差异，转向更高级别医疗机构会导致社会福利损失。我们的分析为改善医院条件和帮助农村患者获得医疗融资的政策提供了支持。

records.title_en: Carbon pricing, carbon equity, and the RCEP framework
records.title_cn: 碳定价、碳公平与RCEP框架
records.abstract_en: Trade liberalization in the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) not only contributes to regional economic growth but also leads to an increase in energy consumption and carbon emissions, which may exacerbate climate change risks. This study aims to explore the carbon pricing issue in the context of the RCEP framework. Additionally, for the sake of carbon equity, we introduce a differentiated carbon pricing scheme based on the cost fairness principle (CPCF), and the unified carbon pricing was used for a cost effectiveness analysis. The empirical analysis was conducted with a global multi-regional computable general equilibrium model. The results show that with the help of trade liberalization, the RCEP's GDP, energy consumption, and carbon emissions may increase by 0.639%, 1.962%, and 1.897%, respectively. The CPCF scheme, wherein developed countries assume the primary abatement burden, can be used to offset the increase in carbon emissions from trade liberalization while RCEP members maintain positive economic growth. The total abatement cost of the CPCF for carbon offsets in the RCEP can be reduced via unified carbon pricing, and the cost-saving effect approaches 24.24%. Unified carbon pricing may result in a carbon price of US $5.83 within the RCEP. As such, this study explores carbon pricing in the context of trade liberalization, and its findings will be valuable for the RCEP to achieve a win-win situation in terms of economic growth and climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 区域全面经济伙伴关系协定（RCEP）中的贸易自由化不仅促进了区域经济增长，也导致了能源消耗和碳排放的增加，这可能加剧气候变化风险。本研究旨在探讨RCEP框架下的碳定价问题。此外，为了碳公平，我们引入了基于成本公平原则的差异化碳定价方案（CPCF），并采用统一碳定价进行成本效益分析。实证分析采用全球多区域可计算一般均衡模型进行。结果表明，借助贸易自由化，RCEP的GDP、能源消耗和碳排放可能分别增加0.639%、1.962%和1.897%。CPCF方案中，发达国家承担主要减排负担，可用于抵消贸易自由化带来的碳排放增加，同时RCEP成员保持正经济增长。通过统一碳定价，可以降低RCEP中用于碳抵消的CPCF总减排成本，成本节约效应接近24.24%。统一碳定价可能导致RCEP内部碳价为US $5.83。因此，本研究探讨了贸易自由化背景下的碳定价问题，其发现将有助于RCEP实现经济增长与气候变化的双赢局面。

records.title_en: Environmental consequences of fuel price shocks in China
records.title_cn: 中国燃油价格冲击的环境后果
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the environmental consequences of fuel price shocks, using a rich dataset from the Chinese megacity of Hangzhou. Our identification strategy is mainly aided by instrumenting fuel price using exogenous global oil prices. We find that a 10% increase in fuel price leads to a 10.29%–11.45% decrease in driving demand, reflected by road congestion index, and a 17.6%–20.27% decrease in industrial activities, measured by electricity consumption. The decreases in driving demand and industrial activities are indeed correlated with air quality improvement and decline in major pollutant concentrations. While the findings shed light on the short-term environmental outcomes of price-based measures, the negative effects of fuel price increases on industrial activities may generate undesirable impacts on macroeconomy in the long-term perspective. Despite ample evidence demonstrating that drivers respond to fuel price changes, considerably fewer studies investigate their environmental and economic consequences. This study addresses this gap in the literature and contributes to a better understanding of the effects of fuel price shocks on air pollution and economic activities.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国大城市杭州的丰富数据集，探讨了燃油价格冲击的环境后果。我们的识别策略主要借助外生全球油价作为燃油价格的工具变量。我们发现，燃油价格每上涨10%，会导致出行需求下降10.29%–11.45%（以道路拥堵指数衡量），以及工业活动下降17.6%–20.27%（以电力消耗衡量）。出行需求和工业活动的减少确实与空气质量改善及主要污染物浓度下降相关。虽然这些发现揭示了基于价格措施的短期环境效果，但燃油价格上涨对工业活动的负面影响可能在长期视角下对宏观经济产生不良影响。尽管有充分证据表明驾驶员对燃油价格变化有反应，但研究其环境和经济后果的研究却少得多。本研究填补了这一文献空白，有助于更好地理解燃油价格冲击对空气污染和经济活动的影响。

records.title_en: Information acquisition and the adoption of improved crop varieties
records.title_cn: 信息获取与改良作物品种的采用
records.abstract_en: Inadequate information on the benefits of and knowledge about innovative agricultural technologies continue to be a major constraint to technology adoption among smallholder farmers in developing countries. The low adoption of new technologies is one of the causes of low productivity and high poverty incidence among smallholder farmers, particularly in Africa. In this paper, I briefly review the literature on social networks and technology diffusion, and argue that the diffusion potential of social networks is underexplored. I then present results from two empirical studies on the impact of social networks on the adoption of improved crop varieties in Ghana and Ethiopia. The results reveal that farmers' peer adoption decisions and experiences, as well as information from trained development agents positively and statistically influence their adoption decisions. I also find that network structural characteristics such as lower segmentation within networks, high credibility of the information, and high effectiveness and efficiency of the amount of information flow tend to improve information acquisition and speed up diffusion of improved crop varieties.
records.abstract_cn: 关于创新农业技术益处和知识的信息不足，仍然是发展中国家小农户采用技术的主要制约因素。新技术的低采用率是导致小农户生产力低下和贫困发生率高的原因之一，尤其是在非洲。本文简要回顾了关于社会网络和技术扩散的文献，并认为社会网络的扩散潜力尚未得到充分开发。随后，我展示了两项关于社会网络对加纳和埃塞俄比亚改良作物品种采用影响的实证研究结果。结果表明，农户同伴的采用决策和经验，以及经过培训的推广人员提供的信息，对其采用决策具有统计上显著的正向影响。我还发现，网络结构特征，如网络内较低的分割程度、信息的高可信度以及信息流动量的高有效性和高效率，往往能改善信息获取并加速改良作物品种的扩散。

records.title_en: What is free food worth? A nonmarket valuation approach to estimating the welfare effects of food pantry services
records.title_cn: 免费食品的价值是多少？一种估算食品储藏室服务福利效应的非市场价值评估方法
records.abstract_en: Food pantries provide groceries to millions of households in the United States every year. Although there is research and information on many other aspects of food pantries, including financial information such as tax valuations for donated food, there is not a literature establishing the economic value of food pantry access for clients and potential clients. We use a valuation approach from environmental economics, revealed preference travel cost modeling, in a novel application to estimate food pantry value. We use a rich administrative dataset from a food bank system in Colorado and estimate demand for pantry visits, exploiting the move of a local pantry to correct for endogeneity bias. We find that the annual value of pantry access to pantry client households is between $600 and $1000, and the value per pantry visit is between $40 and $60. If we assume these values hold nationally, our localized results imply that the collective value of food pantry access among pantry client households may be between $19 billion and $28 billion dollars annually.
records.abstract_cn: 食品储藏室每年为美国数百万家庭提供食品杂货。尽管已有关于食品储藏室许多其他方面的研究和信息，包括诸如捐赠食品的税收估值等财务信息，但尚无文献确立食品储藏室服务对客户和潜在客户的经济价值。我们采用环境经济学中的一种价值评估方法——揭示偏好旅行成本模型，在一项新颖的应用中估算食品储藏室的价值。我们使用来自科罗拉多州一个食品银行系统的丰富行政数据集，并利用当地一家食品储藏室的搬迁来纠正内生性偏差，从而估计对储藏室访问的需求。我们发现，食品储藏室对客户家庭的年度价值在600美元至1000美元之间，每次访问的价值在40美元至60美元之间。如果我们假设这些数值在全国范围内成立，那么我们的局部结果意味着，食品储藏室客户家庭中获取食品储藏室服务的集体价值每年可能在19亿美元至28亿美元之间。

records.title_en: Adapting the designated area of geographical indications to climate change
records.title_cn: 适应气候变化的地理标志指定区域调整
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the agricultural supply relocation of products under geographical indication (GI) labels as an option to adapt to climate change. I develop a stylized framework that endogenously relates the delineation of the production area of the GI product to the distribution of specific geographical characteristics and their influence on the quality of the product and the corresponding comparative advantages. The model can then study how the GI production area responds to climate‐related changes in the production conditions. The model shows that the GI production area can marginally expand as climate change worsens the production conditions, but it may disappear under more severe degradations. This opportunity to relocate current GIs hinges on striking a careful balance between mitigating climate‐induced yield losses and altering quality, but it is also threatened by political economy barriers that govern the redistribution of GI rents.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了地理标志（GI）标签下产品农业供应迁移作为适应气候变化的一种选择。我构建了一个程式化框架，将GI产品生产区域的划定与特定地理特征的分布及其对产品质量和相应比较优势的影响内生地联系起来。该模型随后可以研究GI生产区域如何应对与气候相关的生产条件变化。模型显示，随着气候变化使生产条件恶化，GI生产区域可以边际扩张，但在更严重的退化下可能消失。这一迁移现有GI的机会取决于在减轻气候引起的产量损失和改变质量之间取得谨慎平衡，但也受到管理GI租金再分配的政治经济障碍的威胁。

records.title_en: The accuracy and informativeness of agricultural baselines
records.title_cn: 农业基线的准确性与信息量
records.abstract_en: Agricultural baselines facilitate policy and investment decisions by governments and market participants by providing long‐term projections about the farm sector. Despite their importance in shaping agricultural policy, the agricultural baselines have not been rigorously evaluated. This study evaluates the accuracy and informativeness of two widely used baselines for the US farm sector published by the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the Food and Agricultural Policy Research Institute (FAPRI) in three steps. First, we examine the average percent errors of the projections and perform tests of bias. Second, we use a testing framework based on the encompassing principle to test the predictive content of the projections for each horizon, determining the longest informative projection horizon. Third, we compare the USDA and FAPRI baseline projections using a multi‐horizon framework that considers all projection horizons jointly. We find that prediction error and bias increase with the horizon's length. The predictive content of the baselines projections for most variables diminishes after 4–5 years. The multi‐horizon comparison suggests that neither USDA nor FAPRI projections have uniform or average superior predictive ability over the other for most variables. Our findings are useful for the agencies producing these baselines and for the policymakers, agricultural businesses, and other stakeholders who use them. The study contributes to the recent literature on long‐term agricultural projections and establishes the groundwork for future research inquiries.
records.abstract_cn: 农业基线通过提供农业部门的长期预测，为政府和市场参与者的政策与投资决策提供便利。尽管其在塑造农业政策方面具有重要意义，但农业基线尚未得到严格评估。本研究分三步评估了美国农业部（USDA）和食品与农业政策研究所（FAPRI）发布的两个广泛使用的美国农业部门基线的准确性和信息量。首先，我们检查预测的平均百分比误差并进行偏差检验。其次，我们使用基于包含原则的检验框架来测试每个预测期限的预测内容，确定最长的信息性预测期限。第三，我们使用考虑所有预测期限联合的多期限框架比较USDA和FAPRI的基线预测。我们发现预测误差和偏差随期限长度增加而增加。大多数变量的基线预测的预测内容在4-5年后减弱。多期限比较表明，对于大多数变量，USDA和FAPRI的预测在统一或平均优越预测能力方面均无显著差异。我们的发现对编制这些基线的机构以及使用它们的政策制定者、农业企业和其他利益相关者具有参考价值。本研究为近期关于长期农业预测的文献做出贡献，并为未来的研究探索奠定基础。

records.title_en: Tariffs, agricultural subsidies, and the 2020 US presidential election
records.title_cn: 关税、农业补贴与2020年美国总统大选
records.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence on the effects of US and Chinese trade policies on the 2020 US presidential election. In response to a series of US tariffs imposed on Chinese goods, China imposed retaliatory tariffs, especially on US agricultural products, which largely affected Republican‐leaning counties. The US government then subsidized US farmers by providing direct payments through the Market Facilitation Program (MFP) to mitigate the Chinese retaliatory tariffs. Using the universe of actual county‐level MFP disbursement data, we document that MFP payments relative to the Chinese retaliatory tariff exposure were higher in solidly Republican counties, implying that the Trump administration allocated rents in exchange for political patronage. We also find that MFP payments outweighed the estimated impact of Chinese retaliatory tariffs and led to an increase in the Republican vote share in the 2020 presidential election. Finally, we uncover evidence that China's retaliatory trade policy and the corresponding US agricultural policy exacerbated political polarization in the US, especially the rural–urban divide.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了美国和中国的贸易政策对2020年美国总统大选影响的证据。针对美国对中国商品征收的一系列关税，中国实施了报复性关税，尤其是针对美国农产品，这主要影响了倾向共和党的县。随后，美国政府通过市场促进计划（MFP）向美国农民提供直接补贴，以减轻中国报复性关税的影响。利用县级实际MFP支付数据的全集，我们发现相对于中国报复性关税暴露程度，MFP支付在坚定共和党县更高，这表明特朗普政府分配了租金以换取政治支持。我们还发现，MFP支付超过了中国报复性关税的估计影响，并导致2020年总统大选中共和党选票份额增加。最后，我们发现了证据表明，中国的报复性贸易政策和相应的美国农业政策加剧了美国的政治极化，尤其是城乡分歧。

records.title_en: Quality and quantity incentives under downstream contracts: A role for agricultural cooperatives?
records.title_cn: 下游合同下的质量与数量激励：农业合作社的作用？
records.abstract_en: This article provides a new explanation for the positive role of cooperatives in quality provision along the agri‐food chain. We study the economic rationale for cooperative acting as an intermediary between producers and a downstream (DS) firm when the DS firm cannot observe the individual quality of producers but only the average quality. We derive the optimal contract to elicit the quality and quantity incentives for producers, depending on whether the DS firm directly deals with producers or indirectly deals with them through a producer‐owned cooperative. We find that when the DS firm directly deals with producers via secret contracts, the opportunistic behavior of the DS firm on producers leads to lower quality and quantity levels. The opportunistic behavior is prevented when the DS firm deals with the producer cooperative. However, the contract should offer a sufficiently high quality payment to overcome the free‐riding inefficiency of the producer members.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为合作社在农产品供应链中质量供给的积极作用提供了新的解释。我们研究了当下游（DS）企业无法观察生产者的个体质量而只能观察平均质量时，合作社作为生产者与下游企业之间中介的经济学原理。我们推导出最优合同，以激发生产者的质量与数量激励，这取决于下游企业是直接与生产者交易，还是通过生产者所有的合作社间接与生产者交易。我们发现，当下游企业通过秘密合同直接与生产者交易时，下游企业对生产者的机会主义行为会导致较低的质量和数量水平。当下游企业与生产者合作社交易时，机会主义行为得以避免。然而，合同应提供足够高的质量支付，以克服生产者成员之间的搭便车低效率问题。

records.title_en: Why agricultural insurance may slow down agricultural development
records.title_cn: 为什么农业保险可能减缓农业发展
records.abstract_en: How does agricultural insurance affect the modernization of farming in low income countries? We focus on institutional contexts without formal contract enforcement, where smallholders cannot access modern inputs via markets. Instead, farmers can engage in relational contracting with traders to sell their crop and gain access to inputs (as an advance in‐kind payment). Although conventional theory assumes that insurance “crowds in” modern inputs by attenuating investment risk, we demonstrate that insurance reduces the number of farmers receiving modern inputs from traders. Insurance also reduces the quantity of inputs that traders provide to farmers who remain in a relationship. Insurance may impede the uptake of modern inputs when institutions are imperfect.
records.abstract_cn: 农业保险如何影响低收入国家农业的现代化？我们关注没有正式合同执行的制度环境，在这种环境中，小农户无法通过市场获得现代投入品。相反，农民可以与贸易商进行关系型合同交易，出售他们的作物并获得投入品（作为实物预付款）。尽管传统理论假设保险通过减轻投资风险来“挤入”现代投入品，但我们证明保险减少了从贸易商那里获得现代投入品的农民数量。保险还减少了贸易商向保持关系的农民提供的投入品数量。当制度不完善时，保险可能会阻碍现代投入品的采用。

records.title_en: A novel modeling framework for quantifying spatial spillovers on total factor productivity growth and its components
records.title_cn: 一种量化全要素生产率增长及其组成部分空间溢出效应的新型建模框架
records.abstract_en: This article presents a novel modeling framework that quantifies spatial spillovers on firm total factor productivity (TFP) growth and its components in a single‐stage setting. A random parameters frontier model is specified to measure firm efficiency and calculate TFP growth and its components while allowing for the random parameters and the inefficiency term to be functions of individuals' and neighbors' characteristics. In this manner, the dependence of TFP growth and its components on these characteristics is built into the model, and the corresponding marginal effects are calculated. The empirical application concerns specialized Dutch dairy farms observed over the 2009–2016 period. Apart from the conventional input–output quantities, information on farms' latitudes and longitudes is available, thus allowing the identification of neighboring producers and testing for the existence of spatial spillovers. The empirical findings suggest that farms surrounded by more intensive neighbors experience faster technical progress and TFP growth, which highlights the existence of positive spatial spillovers in Dutch dairy farming.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新型建模框架，可在单阶段设置中量化企业全要素生产率（TFP）增长及其组成部分的空间溢出效应。文中设定了一个随机参数前沿模型，用于衡量企业效率并计算TFP增长及其组成部分，同时允许随机参数和无效率项成为个体及邻居特征的函数。通过这种方式，TFP增长及其组成部分对这些特征的依赖性被纳入模型，并计算相应的边际效应。实证应用涉及2009-2016年期间观察到的专业化荷兰奶牛场。除了常规的投入产出数量外，还获得了农场经纬度信息，从而能够识别邻近生产者并检验空间溢出效应的存在。实证结果表明，周围邻居更集约化的农场经历了更快的技术进步和TFP增长，这凸显了荷兰奶牛养殖中正向空间溢出效应的存在。

records.title_en: “Fast money” around Federal Statistics Releases
records.title_cn: “快钱”与联邦统计发布
records.abstract_en: Many public statistics are closely followed by the public as they provide valuable information for decision making. Although economic theory suggests that low‐latency traders (LLTs) can earn excess arbitrage profits from trading on public statistics releases due to their speed advantage, the empirical literature fails to find meaningful LLTs' stock market profits when trading on macroeconomic statistical releases. Here we confirm previous findings with improved techniques, but also show that excess profits can be earned quickly in agricultural commodity futures markets around United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) statistical releases. We attribute differences in the magnitude of the profits to the straightforward nature of the information and to the direct relevance of the reports to traders for the markets considered. Motivated by market concerns, USDA and the United States Department of Labor recently changed their news media prerelease lockup policy to mitigate LLTs' speed advantage. However, we find the policy change had little effect on the speed advantage as no significant reduction in LLTs' profits occurred. Implications of the research are relevant for government agencies concerned with mitigating LLT speed advantages particularly during the release of public statistical information.
records.abstract_cn: 许多公共统计数据因其为决策提供宝贵信息而受到公众密切关注。尽管经济理论表明，低延迟交易者（LLTs）凭借其速度优势，可以在公共统计数据发布时通过交易赚取超额套利利润，但实证文献未能发现LLTs在宏观经济统计发布时交易股票市场能获得有意义的利润。在此，我们用改进的技术确认了先前的研究结果，但也表明在美国农业部（USDA）统计发布前后，农产品期货市场可以迅速赚取超额利润。我们将利润幅度的差异归因于信息的直接明了性以及报告对交易者所考虑市场的直接相关性。出于市场担忧，USDA和美国劳工部最近改变了其新闻媒体预发布锁定政策，以削弱LLTs的速度优势。然而，我们发现政策变化对速度优势影响甚微，因为LLTs的利润并未显著减少。研究的意义与关注削弱LLT速度优势（尤其是在公共统计信息发布期间）的政府机构相关。

records.title_en: Adapting network theory for spatial network externalities in agriculture: A case study on hemp cross‐pollination
records.title_cn: 将网络理论应用于农业空间网络外部性：以工业大麻异花授粉为例
records.abstract_en: Growers have increasingly expressed frustration over the negative externalities created by their neighbor's production practices. These spatial agricultural network problems include issues such as cross‐pollination and herbicide drift. We develop novel methods for estimating parameters that allow us to adapt and apply general network diffusion models to these spatial agricultural network problems. Doing so allows us to calculate externality damage within a region and calculate cost‐effective policies for alleviating that externality. We empirically illustrate, motivate, and test this approach by applying it to hemp. We find that network structure is an important factor in externality size and cost‐effective policy response for spatial agricultural network problems. We also find that policies that are implemented early and proactively are more likely to be successful and cost effective than policies implemented retroactively. Finally, we find that in our application of limiting the cross‐pollination damage experienced by growers of feminized hemp from non‐feminized hemp growers, the most cost‐effective policy is to establish a regional quota on non‐feminized production combined with intertemporal cultivar spacing. This policy response will likely change across time and region as economic and network variables evolve.
records.abstract_cn: 种植者越来越对邻居的生产实践所产生的负外部性表示不满。这些空间农业网络问题包括异花授粉和除草剂漂移等问题。我们开发了估计参数的新方法，使我们能够将一般网络扩散模型适应并应用于这些空间农业网络问题。这样做使我们能够计算区域内的外部性损害，并计算缓解该外部性的成本效益政策。我们通过将其应用于工业大麻来实证说明、激励和测试这种方法。我们发现，对于空间农业网络问题，网络结构是外部性规模和成本效益政策响应的重要因素。我们还发现，早期主动实施的政策比追溯实施的政策更有可能成功且具有成本效益。最后，我们发现，在我们限制雌性化工业大麻种植者遭受非雌性化工业大麻种植者异花授粉损害的应用中，最具成本效益的政策是建立非雌性化生产的区域配额，并结合跨期品种间隔。随着经济和网络变量的演变，这种政策响应可能会随时间和地区而变化。

records.title_en: Contextual reference price in choice experiments
records.title_cn: 选择实验中的情境参考价格
records.abstract_en: A reference price depends on the context of purchase. For prices in preference elicitation experiments to be interpreted by respondents exactly as prices in real purchases, a condition must be met: Contextual reference prices in experiments and real purchases must equal. Using a choice experiment, we found that the willingness to pay estimates tend to be smaller when the respondents are reminded about their self‐reported reference price of the product. This shows that the equality of reference price between experiments and real purchases may not hold. Thus, willingness to pay estimated from a choice experiment may only be contextually specific to its setting. The theory of contextual reference price may offer a fresh perspective on hypothetical bias, and it may be useful in refining choice experiments.
records.abstract_cn: 参考价格取决于购买情境。为了使偏好诱导实验中的价格被受访者准确理解为真实购买中的价格，必须满足一个条件：实验和真实购买中的情境参考价格必须相等。通过一项选择实验，我们发现当受访者被提醒其自我报告的产品参考价格时，支付意愿估计值往往更小。这表明实验与真实购买之间的参考价格相等性可能不成立。因此，从选择实验估计的支付意愿可能仅对其设定具有情境特异性。情境参考价格理论可能为假设偏差提供新的视角，并可能有助于改进选择实验。

records.title_en: Sin Taxes and Self-Control
records.title_cn: 罪恶税与自我控制
records.abstract_en: According to theory, “sin taxes” are welfare improving if consumers with low self-control respond at least as much to the tax as consumers with high self-control. We investigate empirically if demand response to soft drink and fat tax variations in Denmark depends on consumers’ self-control. We use a unique home-scan panel that includes a survey measure of self-control. When taxes increase, consumers with low self-control reduce purchases less strongly than consumers with high self-control. When taxes decrease, both groups increase their purchases similarly. The results show an asymmetry in price elasticities by self-control that is more pronounced when taxes increase. (JEL D12, D91, H25, H31, I12, I18, L66)
records.abstract_cn: 根据理论，如果自我控制能力低的消费者对税收的反应至少与自我控制能力高的消费者一样大，那么“罪恶税”就能提高福利。我们通过实证研究，探讨丹麦软饮料税和脂肪税的变化对消费者需求的影响是否取决于消费者的自我控制能力。我们使用了一个独特的家庭扫描面板，其中包含自我控制的调查测量。当税收增加时，自我控制能力低的消费者减少购买的程度低于自我控制能力高的消费者。当税收减少时，两组消费者的购买增加情况相似。结果表明，价格弹性在自我控制方面存在不对称性，这种不对称性在税收增加时更为明显。(JEL D12, D91, H25, H31, I12, I18, L66)

records.title_en: Special Economic Zones and Human Capital Investment: 30 Years of Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 经济特区与人力资本投资：来自中国的30年证据
records.abstract_en: By exploiting the large quantity and rich variety of special economic zones (SEZs) in China, this study investigates how such zones affect human capital investment. Results show that SEZs significantly increase the local high school enrollment rate, but the impact varies across zone types: technology-oriented zones encourage education, while export-led zones discourage it. The increased job opportunities and wage premiums inside SEZs for employees with high school education increase high school enrollment, while such opportunities and wages for employees with middle school education decrease enrollment. A very small portion of the impact, if any, can be attributed to increased income. (JEL I21, I26, J24, J31, O15, P23, R32)
records.abstract_cn: 通过利用中国经济特区数量多、种类丰富的特点，本研究考察了这些特区如何影响人力资本投资。结果表明，经济特区显著提高了当地高中入学率，但影响因特区类型而异：技术导向型特区鼓励教育，而出口导向型特区则抑制教育。特区内为高中教育程度员工提供的更多工作机会和工资溢价提高了高中入学率，而为初中教育程度员工提供的此类机会和工资则降低了入学率。影响中极小部分（如果有的话）可归因于收入增加。（JEL I21, I26, J24, J31, O15, P23, R32）

records.title_en: Common Practice: Spillovers from Medicare on Private Health Care
records.title_cn: 常见实践：医疗保险对私人医疗保健的溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Efforts to raise US health-care productivity have proceeded slowly, potentially due to the fragmentation of payment across insurers. Each insurer’s efforts to improve care could influence how doctors practice for other insurers, leading to unvalued externalities. We study a randomized letter intervention by Medicare to curtail overuse of antipsychotics. The letters did not mention private insurance but reduced prescribing to these patients by 12 percent, much like the 17 percent effect in Medicare. We cannot reject onefor-one spillovers, suggesting that physicians use similar medical practice styles across insurers. Our findings establish that insurers can affect health care well outside their direct purview. (JEL D24, G22, I11, I13, I18)
records.abstract_cn: 提高美国医疗保健生产力的努力进展缓慢，这可能是由于各保险公司之间支付的碎片化。每个保险公司改善护理的努力可能会影响医生对其他保险公司的实践方式，导致未被重视的外部性。我们研究了医疗保险为遏制抗精神病药物过度使用而进行的随机信件干预。这些信件未提及私人保险，但将这些患者的处方减少了12%，与医疗保险中17%的效果非常相似。我们不能拒绝一对一溢出效应，这表明医生在不同保险公司之间使用相似的医疗实践风格。我们的发现确立了保险公司可以影响其直接管辖范围之外的医疗保健。(JEL D24, G22, I11, I13, I18)

records.title_en: Spending Responses to High-Frequency Shifts in Payment Timing: Evidence from the Earned Income Tax Credit
records.title_cn: 支出对付款时间高频变化的反应：来自劳动所得税抵免的证据
records.abstract_en: This study explores the spending response to tax refunds for Earned Income Tax Credit recipients using a novel dataset combining transaction-based measures of retail spending with administrative IRS data on tax refunds. Our dataset allows us to exploit variation in the timing of EITC refunds, including changes related to the 2017 PATH Act, along with cross-state differences in refund magnitudes to identify spending responses. Results show EITC recipients spend about $0.30 per refund dollar ($1,150 for the average refund) within just two weeks of issuance, suggesting stimulus targeted at this population may provide a quick boost to aggregate demand. (JEL D12, E32, G51, H24, I38, K34)
records.abstract_cn: 本研究使用一个新颖的数据集，将基于交易的零售支出指标与国税局的行政退税数据相结合，探讨了所得税抵免受益人对退税的支出反应。我们的数据集使我们能够利用 EITC 退款时间的变化，包括与 2017 PATH 法案相关的变化，以及退款幅度的跨州差异来确定支出反应。结果显示，EITC 领取者在发放后的短短两周内，每美元退款支出约为 0.30 美元（平均退款为 $1,150 美元），这表明针对这一人群的刺激措施可能会迅速提振总需求。 (JEL D12、E32、G51、H24、I38、K34)

records.title_en: How Social Security Reform Affects Retirement and Pension Claiming
records.title_cn: 社会保障改革如何影响退休和养老金领取
records.abstract_en: A reform increasing the full retirement age (FRA) by one year leads to larger than expected delays in pension claiming and retirement, while making late claiming more lucrative leads to a smaller than expected delay in pension claiming. Survey evidence shows people view the FRA as the “normal” retirement age and prefer to couple pension claiming and retirement decisions together, even though these two decisions are not coupled through social security provisions. Two mechanisms are at work: reference dependence with loss aversion in pension claiming, and spillovers from pension claiming on retirement choices. The FRA increase leads to large government savings. (JEL H55, J26)
records.abstract_cn: 一项将完全退休年龄（FRA）提高一年的改革导致养老金领取和退休的延迟幅度大于预期，而提高延迟领取的吸引力则导致养老金领取的延迟幅度小于预期。调查证据显示，人们将FRA视为“正常”退休年龄，并倾向于将养老金领取和退休决策结合起来，尽管这两项决策在社会保障条款中并未相互关联。两种机制在起作用：养老金领取中的参考依赖与损失厌恶，以及养老金领取对退休选择的溢出效应。FRA的提高带来了巨大的政府储蓄。（JEL H55, J26）

records.title_en: Investing in Ex Ante Regulation: Evidence from Pharmaceutical Patent Examination
records.title_cn: 投资于事前监管：来自药品专利审查的证据
records.abstract_en: We explore how the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office may improve the quality of issued patents on “secondary” drug features by giving examiners more time to review drug patent applications. Our findings suggest that current time allocations are causing examiners to issue low-quality secondary patents on the margin. To assess the merits of expanding ex ante scrutiny of drug patent applications at the agency, we set forth estimates of the various gains and losses associated with giving examiners more time, including reduced downstream litigation costs and added personnel expenses, along with both the static gains and dynamic innovation losses associated with earlier generic entry. (JEL K11, L65, O31, O34, O38)
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了美国专利商标局如何通过给予审查员更多时间审查药品专利申请，来提高“次要”药物特征专利的质量。我们的研究结果表明，当前的时间分配正导致审查员在边际上颁发低质量的次要专利。为了评估在该机构扩大药品专利申请事前审查的利弊，我们提出了与给予审查员更多时间相关的各种收益和损失的估计，包括减少下游诉讼成本和增加人员开支，以及早期仿制药进入带来的静态收益和动态创新损失。（JEL K11, L65, O31, O34, O38）

records.title_en: The Impact of Organizational Boundaries on Health Care Coordination and Utilization
records.title_cn: 组织边界对医疗协调和利用的影响
records.abstract_en: We measure organizational concentration—the distribution of a patient’s health care across organizations—to examine how firm boundaries affect health care efficiency. First, when patients move to regions where outpatient visits are typically concentrated within a small set of firms, their health care utilization falls. Second, for patients whose primary care providers (PCPs) exit the market, switching to a PCP with 1 standard deviation higher organizational concentration reduces utilization by 21 percent. This finding is robust to controlling for the spread of health care across providers. Increases in organizational concentration predict improvements in diabetes care and are not associated with greater use of emergency department or inpatient care. (JEL D22, D23, D24, I11, J14, R32)
records.abstract_cn: 我们衡量组织集中度——患者在不同组织间医疗服务的分布——以考察企业边界如何影响医疗效率。首先，当患者迁移到门诊就诊通常集中在一小部分企业的地区时，其医疗利用下降。其次，对于其主要护理提供者（PCP）退出市场的患者，转向组织集中度高出1个标准差的PCP会使医疗利用减少21%。这一发现在控制医疗服务在提供者间的分散程度后依然稳健。组织集中度的提高预示着糖尿病护理的改善，并且与急诊或住院护理的更多使用无关。（JEL D22, D23, D24, I11, J14, R32）

records.title_en: Corporate Tax Breaks and Executive Compensation
records.title_cn: 公司税收减免与高管薪酬
records.abstract_en: I analyze the effect of two corporate tax breaks, bonus depreciation and the Domestic Production Activities Deduction (DPAD), on executive compensation in publicly traded US firms. I find both tax breaks significantly increase executive compensation. For every dollar a firm benefits from the tax breaks, compensation of the firm’s top five highest-paid executives increases by $0.17 to $0.25. The tax breaks increase compensation primarily in firms with weaker governance structures, suggesting the compensation response is driven by executive rent extraction. (JEL D22, G34, H25, M12, M52)
records.abstract_cn: 我分析了两种公司税收减免，即奖金折旧和国内生产活动扣除（DPAD），对美国上市公司高管薪酬的影响。我发现这两种税收减免都显著增加了高管薪酬。公司从税收减免中每受益一美元，其薪酬最高的五位高管的薪酬就会增加0.17至0.25美元。税收减免主要在治理结构较弱的公司中增加薪酬，这表明薪酬反应是由高管租金提取驱动的。（JEL D22, G34, H25, M12, M52）

records.title_en: Incentivizing School Attendance in the Presence of Parent-Child Information Frictions
records.title_cn: 在亲子信息摩擦存在的情况下激励上学
records.abstract_en: Many countries use CCTs targeted to parents to promote schooling. Attendance conditions may work through two channels: incentivization and information. If children have private information, (i) providing attendance information to parents may increase attendance inexpensively relative to CCTs and (ii) it may be more effective to incentivize children, who have full information, than parents. Tackling both questions in a unified experimental setting, we find that information alone improves parental monitoring and has a large effect relative to our CCT. Incentivizing children is at least as effective as incentivizing parents––importantly, not because parents were able to appropriate transfers to children. (JEL D82, D83, I21, I22, I28, L31, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 许多国家使用针对家长的现金转移支付（CCT）来促进就学。出勤条件可能通过两个渠道起作用：激励和信息。如果儿童拥有私人信息，（i）向家长提供出勤信息可能相对于CCT以较低成本增加出勤率，（ii）激励拥有完全信息的儿童可能比激励家长更有效。在统一的实验环境中解决这两个问题，我们发现仅信息就能改善家长监督，并且相对于我们的CCT具有较大的效果。激励儿童至少与激励家长同样有效——重要的是，这不是因为家长能够挪用转移给儿童的资源。（JEL D82, D83, I21, I22, I28, L31, O15）

records.title_en: The Costs of Misaligned Incentives: Energy Inefficiency and the Principal-Agent Problem
records.title_cn: 激励错位的成本：能源效率与委托-代理问题
records.abstract_en: In many settings, misaligned incentives and inadequate monitoring lead employees to take self-interested actions. This paper identifies and quantifies the costs of this principal-agent problem in the context of an energy efficiency appliance replacement program. I show that contractors (agents) hired by the electric utility (the principal) increase their compensation by intentionally misreporting program data to authorize the replacement of nonqualified refrigerators. I estimate that each unqualified replacement reduces program benefits by $106 and saves 30 percent less electricity than replacements that follow program guidelines. The same program without a principal-agent distortion would increase program benefits by $60 per replacement. (JEL D82, L68, L94, L98)
records.abstract_cn: 在许多情境下，激励错位和监管不足导致员工采取自利行为。本文在能效电器更换项目的背景下，识别并量化了这种委托-代理问题的成本。我展示了由电力公司（委托人）雇佣的承包商（代理人）通过故意虚报项目数据以授权更换不合格冰箱，从而增加其报酬。我估计，每次不合格更换使项目收益减少106美元，并且比遵循项目指南的更换节省的电力少30%。没有委托-代理扭曲的同一项目，每次更换将使项目收益增加60美元。（JEL D82, L68, L94, L98）

records.title_en: Interregional Contact and the Formation of a Shared Identity
records.title_cn: 跨区域接触与共同身份的形成
records.abstract_en: We study the long-run effects of contact with individuals from other regions in early adulthood on preferences, beliefs, and national identity. We combine a natural experiment, the random assignment of male conscripts to different locations throughout Spain, with tailored survey data. Being randomly assigned to complete military service outside of one’s region of residence fosters contact with conscripts from other regions and increases sympathy and trust toward people from the region of service, as measured decades later. We also observe a long-lasting increase in identification with Spain for individuals originating from regions with strong peripheral nationalism. (JEL D12, D83, D91, J45, R23, Z13.)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了成年早期与来自其他地区的个体接触对偏好、信念和国家认同的长期影响。我们将一个自然实验——男性应征者被随机分配到西班牙各地服役——与定制的调查数据相结合。被随机分配到居住地区以外的地方完成兵役，促进了与来自其他地区的应征者的接触，并在数十年后测量时，增加了对服役地区人群的同情和信任。我们还观察到，对于来自具有强烈地方民族主义地区的个体，其对西班牙的认同感出现了持久的增强。(JEL D12, D83, D91, J45, R23, Z13。)

records.title_en: More than Words: Leaders’ Speech and Risky Behavior during a Pandemic
records.title_cn: 不止于言辞：疫情期间领导人的讲话与风险行为
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether the anti-scientific rhetoric of modern populists can induce followers to engage in risky behavior. We gather electoral information, credit card expenses, and geo-localized mobile phone data for approximately 60 million devices in Brazil. After the president publicly dismissed the risks of the COVID-19 pandemic and challenged scientific recommendations, social distancing in pro-government localities declined. Consistently, credit card expenses increased immediately. Results are driven by localities with higher media penetration levels, active Twitter accounts, and a larger proportion of evangelical Christians, a critical electoral group. (JEL D72, D91, I12, I18, L82, O15, Z12)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了现代民粹主义者的反科学言论是否会诱导追随者从事风险行为。我们收集了巴西约60百万台设备的选举信息、信用卡支出和地理定位手机数据。在总统公开淡化COVID-19疫情风险并挑战科学建议后，亲政府地区的社交距离措施有所减少。与此一致，信用卡支出立即增加。结果由媒体渗透率较高、活跃推特账户较多以及福音派基督徒（一个关键的选举群体）比例较大的地区驱动。（JEL D72, D91, I12, I18, L82, O15, Z12）

records.title_en: ACE—Analytic Climate Economy
records.title_cn: ACE——分析性气候经济
records.abstract_en: I study optimal carbon taxation in an analytic quantitative integrated assessment model (IAM) that links IAM components, parametric assumptions, and calibration approaches directly to their policy impacts. I show how temperature’s tax impact differs from that of previously analytically modeled carbon dynamics. Novel to analytic IAMs are a general economy, energy sectors including capital, varying degrees of substitutability across energy sources, an approximation of capital persistence, objective functions that include CES preferences and population weighting, and an explicit model of the greenhouse effect and ocean-atmosphere temperature dynamics. The paper enables economists to develop better-informed opinions about the social cost of carbon. (JEL H23, H43, Q54, Q58)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个分析性定量综合评估模型（IAM）中的最优碳税，该模型将IAM组成部分、参数假设和校准方法直接与其政策影响联系起来。我展示了温度对税收的影响与先前分析性建模的碳动态有何不同。分析性IAM的新颖之处包括：一般经济、包括资本在内的能源部门、能源来源之间不同程度的可替代性、资本持续性的近似、包括CES偏好和人口加权的目标函数，以及温室效应和海洋-大气温度动态的显式模型。本文使经济学家能够对社会碳成本形成更明智的观点。（JEL H23, H43, Q54, Q58）

records.title_en: Immigrant Integration in the United States: The Role of Adult English Language Training
records.title_cn: 美国移民融合：成人英语培训的作用
records.abstract_en: The ability to speak and understand a host country’s primary language is strongly associated with measures of immigrant integration. We estimate the causal effects of English language training for adult immigrants on participants’ civic and economic outcomes using randomized enrollment lotteries from a public adult education program in Massachusetts. Participation doubles voter participation and increases annual earnings by $2,400 (56 percent). Increased tax revenue from earnings gains cover program costs over time, generating a 6 percent return for taxpayers. Ours is the first randomized evaluation of adult English language training as a standalone intervention in the United States. (JEL D72, H75, I21, I26, J15, J24, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 掌握东道国主要语言的听说能力与移民融合的衡量指标密切相关。我们利用马萨诸塞州一项公共成人教育项目的随机入学抽签，估计了成人移民英语培训对参与者公民和经济结果的因果效应。参与使选民参与率翻倍，并使年收入增加2,400美元（56%）。收入增长带来的税收增加随时间推移覆盖了项目成本，为纳税人带来6%的回报。这是美国首次对成人英语培训作为独立干预措施进行的随机评估。（JEL D72, H75, I21, I26, J15, J24, J31）

records.title_en: Voting for Democracy: Chile’s Plebiscito and the Electoral Participation of a Generation
records.title_cn: 为民主投票：智利的全民公决与一代人的选举参与
records.abstract_en: This paper assesses the long-term consequences of voting for democracy. We study Chile’s 1988 plebiscite, which ended 15 years of dictatorship and reestablished democracy. Taking advantage of individual-level voting data, we implement an age-based regression discontinuity design comparing long-run registration and turnout rates across marginally eligible and ineligible individuals. We find plebiscite eligibility increased electoral turnout three decades later. The magnitude of the initial mobilization emerges as the mechanism. Plebiscite eligibility induced a sizable share of less-educated voters to register compared to other upstream elections. The event contributed to the emergence of one-party rule the 20 years following democratization. (JEL D72, D82, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了为民主投票的长期后果。我们研究了智利1988年的全民公决，该公决结束了15年的独裁统治并重建了民主。利用个人层面的投票数据，我们实施了一种基于年龄的断点回归设计，比较了勉强符合资格和不符合资格的个体的长期登记率和投票率。我们发现，公决资格在三十年后提高了选举投票率。初始动员的规模是其中的机制。与其他上游选举相比，公决资格促使相当大比例的受教育程度较低的选民进行登记。这一事件在民主化后的20年中促成了一党统治的出现。（JEL D72, D82, O17）

records.title_en: College Enrollment and Mandatory FAFSA Applications: Evidence from Louisiana
records.title_cn: 大学入学与强制FAFSA申请：来自路易斯安那州的证据
records.abstract_en: I estimate the impact of a Louisiana state policy that mandated Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) applications as a high school graduation requirement. I find significant increases in FAFSA completion rates (19 percentage points), and my estimates imply an increase of 1–2 percentage points in college enrollment. There is suggestive evidence that these effects were more concentrated among lower-income students/schools, and merit-based state financial aid applications also increased. The design of this mandate implies that pushing students into action may be more effective than informational nudges and that localized support systems such as counselors are important for the success of a top-down policy. (JEL D91, H75, I21, I22, I23, I28)
records.abstract_cn: 我评估了路易斯安那州一项将联邦学生援助免费申请（FAFSA）作为高中毕业要求的州政策的影响。我发现FAFSA完成率显著提高（19个百分点），我的估计表明大学入学率提高了1-2个百分点。有提示性证据表明，这些影响在低收入学生/学校中更为集中，且基于成绩的州财政援助申请也有所增加。这项任务的设计表明，推动学生采取行动可能比信息提示更有效，而辅导员等本地化支持系统对于自上而下政策的成功至关重要。（JEL D91, H75, I21, I22, I23, I28）

records.title_en: Competition for Attention and News Quality
records.title_cn: 注意力竞争与新闻质量
records.abstract_en: Over the past decades the number of news outlets has increased dramatically, but the quality of news products has declined. We propose a model to reconcile these facts where consumers’ attention allocation decisions not only depend on but also affect news outlets’ quality choices. When competition is intensified by new entries, the informativeness of the news industry rises. Thus, attention is diverted from existing outlets, reducing their incentives to improve news quality, which begets a downward spiral. Furthermore, when attention becomes cheaper, a larger number of news outlets can be accommodated in equilibrium, but news quality still falls. (JEL D83, L15, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，新闻机构的数量急剧增加，但新闻产品的质量却有所下降。我们提出了一个模型来调和这些事实，其中消费者的注意力分配决策不仅取决于新闻机构的质量选择，而且影响这些选择。当新进入者加剧竞争时，新闻业的信息量上升。因此，注意力从现有机构转移，降低了它们改进新闻质量的激励，从而引发恶性循环。此外，当注意力变得更便宜时，均衡中可以容纳更多的新闻机构，但新闻质量仍然下降。(JEL D83, L15, L82)

records.title_en: Working for References
records.title_cn: 为推荐信而工作
records.abstract_en: We analyze the incentive and welfare consequences of job references in a large economy marked by moral hazard, limited liability, exogenous job separation, and structural unemployment. In the firm-optimal equilibrium, employers provide references whenever production is successful, and workers holding references are hired with certainty in the ensuing period. Compared to a setting without references: the bonus-contract offers are lower, yet the workers’ equilibrium effort is higher. Profits and welfare are higher, yet aggregate worker welfare is lower. Also, firms do not fully internalize the incentive effect of references and could typically increase profits and welfare by jointly raising bonuses. (JEL D82, D86, E24, J33, J41, L25, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个以道德风险、有限责任、外生离职和结构性失业为特征的大型经济体中，工作推荐信的激励和福利后果。在厂商最优均衡中，雇主在生产成功时提供推荐信，持有推荐信的工人在随后的时期被确定雇佣。与没有推荐信的情况相比：奖金合同报价更低，但工人的均衡努力水平更高。利润和福利更高，但工人总福利更低。此外，厂商并未完全内化推荐信的激励效应，通常可以通过联合提高奖金来增加利润和福利。(JEL D82, D86, E24, J33, J41, L25, M51)

records.title_en: Information Spillover in Multi-Good Adverse Selection
records.title_cn: 多商品逆向选择中的信息溢出
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes information spillover in a multi-good adverse selection model in which a privately informed seller trades two different goods in two different markets. Buyers learn the seller’s information from both the market they participate in and the trading outcomes in the other market. We identify a sufficient negative correlation condition under which information spillover reduces efficiency loss. We also discover a novel type of coordination friction that leads to multiple equilibria, which can be welfare-ranked by the number of initial no-trade periods. When the sufficient negative correlation condition fails, the efficiency loss is the same as in the case without information spillover. (JEL D82, D83, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了多商品逆向选择模型中的信息溢出，在该模型中，拥有私人信息的卖方在两个不同市场上交易两种不同商品。买方从他们参与的市场以及其他市场的交易结果中了解卖方的信息。我们识别出一个充分的负相关条件，在该条件下信息溢出减少了效率损失。我们还发现了一种新型的协调摩擦，导致多重均衡，这些均衡可以根据初始无交易时期的数量进行福利排序。当充分的负相关条件不成立时，效率损失与没有信息溢出时的情况相同。(JEL D82, D83, L15)

records.title_en: A Buyer Power Theory of Exclusive Dealing and Exclusionary Bundling
records.title_cn: 买方势力下的排他交易与排他性捆绑理论
records.abstract_en: We develop a unified theory of exclusive dealing and exclusionary bundling. In a framework with two competing manufacturers that supply their product(s) through a monopolist retailer, we show that buyer power restores the profitability of such practices involving inefficient exclusion. The mechanism underlying this exclusion is that the compensation required by the retailer to renounce selling the rival product erodes with its buyer power. We further show that our theory holds when buyer power differs across manufacturers or when the retailer can strategically narrow (or expand) its product assortment. (JEL D42, D43, K21, L42, L60, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个统一的排他交易与排他性捆绑理论。在一个由两家竞争性制造商通过垄断零售商供应其产品的框架中，我们表明买方势力恢复了涉及低效排他的此类做法的盈利能力。这种排他背后的机制是，零售商放弃销售竞争对手产品所需的补偿随着其买方势力的增强而减少。我们进一步表明，当买方势力在不同制造商之间存在差异，或者当零售商可以战略性地缩小（或扩大）其产品种类时，我们的理论仍然成立。（JEL D42, D43, K21, L42, L60, L81）

records.title_en: Equilibrium Screening and Categorical Inequality
records.title_cn: 均衡筛选与类别不平等
records.abstract_en: We analyze equilibrium outcomes under costly screening of candidates from distinct categories. Candidates choose how much effort to invest in skill acquisition, and the screener decides how carefully to screen each candidate. Typically, there are multiple equilibria, and ex ante identical individuals in different categories can receive different equilibrium treatment. The imposition of a quota for an initially disadvantaged group can result in increased screening intensity and skill investment by destabilizing the least active equilibrium. The endogeneity of screening enables powerful comparative statics, which we use to unify different strands in the literature on discrimination. (JEL D63, D82, D83, J24, J31, J71, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在来自不同类别的候选人进行昂贵筛选下的均衡结果。候选人选择在技能获取上投入多少努力，而筛选者决定对每位候选人进行多仔细的筛选。通常存在多重均衡，且事前相同的个体在不同类别中可能受到不同的均衡待遇。对初始弱势群体实施配额可以通过破坏最不活跃的均衡来增加筛选强度和技能投资。筛选的内生性使得比较静态分析具有强大的力量，我们利用这一点来统一歧视文献中的不同分支。（JEL D63, D82, D83, J24, J31, J71, M51）

records.title_en: Judicial Mechanism Design
records.title_cn: 司法机制设计
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a mechanism-design approach to study criminal justice systems. We derive properties of optimal mechanisms for two notions of welfare distinguished by their treatment of deterrence. These properties provide insights into the effects of defendants’ private information about their guilt; highlight forces that may underlie certain features of existing systems, such as plea bargaining and binary verdicts and the separation of fact-finding and sentencing; and indicate directions for possible improvements of criminal trials, such as varying the standard for conviction across crimes. (JEL D82, K41, K42)
